jobs.title: Sykepleier/vernepleier i Hjemmetjenester
jobs.description:
Hjemmetjenester i Sola består av tre geografiske soner, spesialiserte tjenester i hjemmet, dagsenter på Sola sykehjem og nattpatrulje samt arbeidslag demens.

Nå er det ledige stillinger på sone Nord, ett vikariat og en fast stilling. Vi ser etter deg som er utdannet sykepleier/vernepleier med norsk autorisasjon og som brenner for å gi gode tjenester i hjemmesykepleien.

Hjemmetjenesten er en arbeidsplass hvor arbeidsmengde- og belastning er svært varierende og du må like å jobbe i skiftende arbeidstempo og i en tjeneste som er i konstant endring. Vi ønsker å være fremoverlent og utvikle oss i takt med våre tjenestemottakere. Du må derfor ha evne til å tenke positivt og være løsningsorientert selv når det koker som mest. Fokuset er på kommunens innbyggere og hvordan en kan løse utfordringene en møter daglig på best mulig måte, både for tjenestemottakere, pårørende og for helsepersonell.

Våre tjenestemottakere er av varierende alder og med stort spenn i diagnoser og helseutfordringer, både somatikk, psykiatri- og rusrelaterte utfordringer. 

Det er høy fagkompetanse i våre soner, og vi ønsker enda flere dyktige sykepleiere/vernepleiere som kan være med å skape et godt og lærende arbeidsmiljø. Hverdagsmestring for hver enkelt bruker står i sentrum og skal vise igjen i tjenestene vi gir.

Arbeidstid er på dag/kveld og hver 3. helg med unntak av dem som jobber langvakter med helg hver 4. helg. Vi planlegger i stor grad vakter, møter og kompetansehevende tiltak inn i årsplan. 

Vil du være en del av vårt engasjerte teamet? Da vil vi høre fra deg.


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Sykepleie/vernepleie til tjenestemottakere i eget hjem. Dette kan innebære medisinske oppgaver, stell, observasjoner, veiledning og dokumentasjon m.m.
  • Utarbeide, iverksette, følge opp og evaluere tiltaksplaner, iplos og individuell plan via Gerica.
  • Oppfølging av brukere sammen med andre tjenester, internt og eksternt.
  • Primærkontakt til brukere.
  • Samarbeid med kolleger på tvers av arbeidsgrupper.
  • Bruker- og pårørendesamarbeid.
  • Veilede studenter og kollegaer.
  • Hjemmetjenesten jobber ut i fra hjemmerehabiliteringprinsippet og hva som er viktig for hver enkelt innbygger.
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Norsk autorisasjon som sykepleier / vernepleier.
  • Gode norskkunnskaper både skriftlig og muntlig.
  • Hvis norsk ikke er morsmålet ditt må du dokumentere språkkunnskaper tilsvarende B2-nivå; dette gjelder ikke søkere med et skandinavisk språk som morsmål.

jobs.title: Graduate Deployment Strategist
jobs.description:
TL;DR: Our graduate roles are about who we believe you can become, not your previous experiences and qualifications. Everyone has to take the first step somewhere and we’re excited about creating this environment.

You'll walk into some of the world's most complex enterprise systems and deploy Conduct against the challenges our customers face. You build the kind of trust that turns an initial pilot into a long-term partnership - and the product insights you bring back will directly shape what we build next.

Why Conduct

We believe the world's largest companies should move at the speed of their ideas, not the speed of the decade-old systems they run on. Today they don't.

Every process change, every new product line runs into SAP systems layered with decades of custom code and complexity no human mind can fully comprehend. New requirements take months to ship, system migrations cost $100M+ and years of pain.

We're building the AI operating system that absorbs this complexity and gives enterprises back their speed and ambition. Major enterprises already trust us with their most critical systems, we've closed game-changing SI partnerships, just raised a $60M Series A, and demand is outpacing what we can service.

We're a small, talent-dense team doing our life's work out of London and NYC. Extreme ownership, high velocity, low-ego collaboration. What you build here shapes the company and how the world's largest companies operate. We sponsor visas and are convinced diverse teams build better products, so we especially encourage underrepresented groups in tech to reach out.

What you'll own

You will make sure Conduct lands and sticks. You join strategic accounts early, run the technical deployment hands-on, and fully take over post-sale.

No two days look the same: you fly out to customers when it counts, you onboard hundreds of end users, surface expansion signals, and eventually turn a single entry point into a multi-year partnership.

Most importantly, you will have a direct line into product and shape Conduct’s product roadmap as we further build out the platform.

This is a very entrepreneurial role, our GTM team is still small and lean. You'll build the engine behind everything: onboarding flows, tooling, reusable playbooks — enough that customer capacity compounds without headcount scaling linearly.

Who we hire

We're looking for sharp, driven, high potential graduates who share our obsession with understanding how software works.

You'll fit right in if your peers describe you are one of the sharpest people they have met, you’re hungry to work at pace and at your best in an environment which intersects technical and commercial enterprise.

In practice that tends to look like:

  • Recent graduate with a strong academic background.

  • Exceptional communication skills. You can build positive and strong relationships from CIO’s to professors and peers.

  • Entrepreneurial instinct. You spot expansion, you can hold an early commercial conversation, and you understand that a great deployment is also how accounts grow.

  • A builder with genuine hunger. You want to build the process and do the hands-on customer work, not just one or the other.

  • Low ego and self-aware. You're comfortable saying "I don't know" in a technically complex environment, then going and figuring it out.

Compensation: £50K – £55K • Offers Equity

jobs.title: Kundansvarig till L2 Fastigheter, Göteborg
jobs.description:
Om rollen
Som Kundansvarig hos oss arbetar du med hela uthyrningsprocessen – från första kontakt med potentiella kunder till visning, behovsanalys, förhandling och kontraktsskrivning. Du har även ett nära och löpande samarbete med våra befintliga hyresgäster och är med och utvecklar våra lokaler i takt med deras verksamheter.

En viktig del av rollen är att aktivt söka upp, bearbeta och bygga relationer med framtida kunder, ofta genom ett eget nätverk eller via marknadsinsatser. Du är även delaktig i omförhandlingar, hyresgästanpassningar och i att ta fram uthyrningsstrategier och koncept tillsammans med resten av teamet.

Hos oss får du stort ansvar – men också stor frihet att forma din roll och bidra till hur vi bygger bolaget vidare.

Vem är du?
Vi söker dig som har ett starkt eget driv, ett genuint affärsintresse och en förmåga att bygga långsiktiga relationer. Du tycker om att skapa värde för kunden och hitta kreativa lokallösningar som passar deras verksamhet – samtidigt som du har god koll på marknaden och gillar att få affärer i mål.

Vi ser gärna att du har:

    Minst 2 års erfarenhet av kommersiell uthyrning
    Förmåga att förstå kunders affär och matcha behov med lösningar i vårt bestånd
    Vana att arbeta självständigt och ta initiativ
    God förståelse för hyresavtal och relevanta lagar
    Eftergymnasial utbildning inom fastighet, ekonomi eller försäljning är ett plus

Du uttrycker dig obehindrat på svenska och har god förmåga att kommunicera även på engelska.

Varför L2?
Hos oss får du vara med och påverka – på riktigt. Vi är ett litet, sammansvetsat team med stort engagemang och korta beslutsvägar. Här värdesätts initiativtagande, affärsmannaskap och vilja att bidra till helheten. Du får en nyckelroll i ett bolag där idéer snabbt kan bli verklighet, och där du är med och formar både din egen roll och företagets utveckling.

Ansökan
I den här rekryteringen samarbetar L2 Fastigheter med Jerrie. Vid frågor kontakta gärna ansvarig rekryteringskonsult Cecilia Jarlsmark på 0723-05 33 43 eller cecilia.jarlsmark@jerrie.se Annonsen kommer att vara öppen tills tjänsten är tillsatt, men då urval sker löpande så är ett tips att söka tjänsten så snart som möjligt.

Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig, varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Vi på Jerrie arbetar med en rättvis urvalsprocess som är kopplad till en kravprofil. Vi använder inte AI i screening och urval – alla ansökningar läses av en människa. Läs om Jerries rekryteringsprocess här: https://jerrie.se/rekryteringsprocess

jobs.title: Assistant Kitchen Manager – EGON Brygga, Tromsø
jobs.description:
Are you ready to take the next step in your kitchen career and be part of opening a brand-new EGON restaurant?

 

EGON is one of Norway’s strongest and most successful restaurant concepts. We are now looking for a motivated and ambitious Assistant Kitchen Manager to join the leadership team at the new EGON Brygga in Tromsø.

 

Located directly on the waterfront in the heart of Tromsø, EGON Brygga will be a large new restaurant with approximately 300 seats. This is an exciting opportunity to join from the beginning, help build a strong kitchen team and contribute to establishing the standards, culture and daily operations of a brand-new restaurant.

About the Role

As Assistant Kitchen Manager, you will be the Kitchen Manager’s right hand and an important part of the restaurant’s leadership team. You will work closely with the Kitchen Manager and General Manager and take active responsibility for daily kitchen operations, quality, structure and team development.

 

The position combines hands-on kitchen work with leadership, planning and follow-up. You will also play an important role in creating a strong team and ensuring that EGON’s routines and standards are implemented from day one. For the right candidate, this can also be an excellent step toward becoming a Kitchen Manager within EGON in the future.

Main Responsibilities
  • Support the Kitchen Manager in the daily operation of the kitchen
  • Take responsibility for kitchen operations when the Kitchen Manager is absent
  • Ensure consistently high food quality and presentation
  • Participate actively in food preparation and à la carte service
  • Follow up routines related to HACCP / food safety and hygiene
  • Help train, motivate and develop kitchen employees
  • Contribute to efficient staffing, planning and organization
  • Follow EGON’s routines, systems and operational standards
  • Help create a positive, structured and professional working environment
  • Contribute to building a strong kitchen team at the new restaurant
Who Are We Looking For?

We are looking for someone who enjoys responsibility and thrives in a busy restaurant environment.

 

You preferably have:

  • Relevant experience from a professional kitchen
  • Experience from high-volume restaurants or similar operations
  • Previous leadership experience, or a strong motivation to develop into a leadership role
  • Good organizational and communication skills
  • A hands-on approach and willingness to lead by example
  • The ability to remain structured and focused during busy services
  • A positive attitude and strong work ethic
  • A genuine interest in food, people and restaurant operations
  • Good communication skills in English. Speaking Norwegian is a big plus.

Experience as a Sous Chef, Assistant Kitchen Manager, Shift Leader, Team Leader or similar is an advantage.

What We Offer

At EGON Brygga, you will have the opportunity to join a completely new restaurant from the beginning and become part of building the team and operation. EGON offers a structured working environment with established systems, training and opportunities for professional development. As part of a large and growing restaurant group, there are also good opportunities for further career development for employees who want more responsibility.

 

You will become part of an ambitious leadership team in one of Tromsø’s most exciting new restaurant openings.

If you are an experienced kitchen professional who wants more responsibility and the opportunity to develop as a leader, we would like to hear from you.

 

Apply today and become part of the team opening EGON Brygga in Tromsø!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

EGON Brygga will be a brand-new EGON restaurant opening at the historic Bangsundbrygga, directly on the waterfront in central Tromsø. The restaurant will have around 300 seats, including both indoor and outdoor seating. With its spectacular waterfront location and views of Tromsø’s surrounding mountains, EGON Brygga aims to become a natural meeting place for locals and visitors alike. The restaurant will offer EGON’s broad à la carte menu in a warm and informal atmosphere, while the design will preserve the historic character and architecture of Bangsundbrygga.

jobs.title: Tender Manager / Project Manager - EU/NATO
jobs.description:
Want to influence the bigger picture? At Saab, you can realise amazing innovations that keep people and societies safe. Together, we can truly make an impact - and your part matters.

We are looking for a Tender Manager / Project Manager with a few years of relevant experience who wants to take an active role in supporting EU and NATO-related initiatives within Saab Dynamics.

The position is primarily based in Solna. For the right candidate, another Saab Dynamics location in Sweden may also be considered.

As Saab Dynamics operates across several locations in Sweden and the role involves collaboration with European and NATO partners, travel will be a natural part of the position, both within Sweden and internationally.

Your Role

You will join our newly established NATO/EU Affairs team and work closely with the Head of NATO/EU Affairs at Saab Dynamics. In this hands-on role, you will support our Business Units in assessing and pursuing relevant opportunities, from early opportunity assessment through capture and proposal activities.

As part of a new team, you will also help us build the processes, tools, templates and ways of working needed to support our Business Units effectively. This is an opportunity to combine day-to-day execution with helping develop a new capability within Saab Dynamics.

In short, you will help our Business Units turn EU and NATO opportunities into structured capture and bid activities, while helping us build the tools and ways of working needed to support them.

Your Responsibilities

    Support Business Units in assessing and pursuing relevant EU and NATO opportunities.
    Coordinate capture and bid activities from early opportunity assessment through proposal submission.
    Develop and maintain capture plans, stakeholder maps, action plans, proposal timelines and other supporting material.
    Contribute to building the NATO/EU team's processes, tools, templates and ways of working.
    Develop practical tools and guidance to help Business Units navigate EU and NATO opportunities.
    Capture feedback and lessons learned to continuously improve how the team supports the Business Units.
    Prepare decision material and recommendations for senior stakeholders regarding bid participation.
    Help ensure compliance with applicable EU and NATO funding, reporting and audit requirements.
    Build strong working relationships across Saab and with relevant external stakeholders.

Your Profile

We are looking for someone who is structured, proactive and collaborative. You enjoy creating clarity in complex situations, taking ownership of activities and driving them forward.

You combine analytical thinking with a practical, hands-on approach and are comfortable working in an environment where not everything is already defined. You enjoy creating structures, developing new tools and improving ways of working, and you are motivated by the opportunity to help build a new team and capability.

You are self-driven and comfortable working independently, while understanding that success in this role depends on close collaboration with our Business Units and other stakeholders.

We believe you have:

    A few years of relevant experience in tender management, bid management, capture management, project management or a similar coordinating role.
    Experience working with multiple stakeholders, preferably in an international environment.
    An interest in, and preferably some understanding of, the defence sector, military customer requirements and European defence cooperation.
    An understanding of, or strong interest in learning about, EU and NATO funding and cooperation programmes within defence and security.
    Strong communication and analytical skills, combined with a structured approach to planning and follow-up.
    Fluency in English, both spoken and written. Swedish is considered an advantage.

Experience with EU, NATO-funded programmes or similar international initiatives is considered an advantage but is not a requirement.

This position requires that you pass a security vetting based on the current regulations around/of security protection. For positions requiring security clearance additional obligations on citizenship may apply.

What You Will Be Part Of

Explore a wealth of possibilities. Take on challenges, create smart inventions, and grow beyond. This is a place for curious minds, brave pioneers, and everyone in between. Together, we achieve the extraordinary, each bringing our unique perspectives. Your part matters.

Saab is a leading defense and security company with an enduring purpose, to help nations keep their people and society safe. Empowered by its 28,000 talented people, Saab constantly pushes the boundaries of technology to create a safer and more sustainable world.

Saab designs, manufactures and maintains advanced systems in aeronautics, weapons, command and control, sensors and underwater systems. Saab is headquartered in Sweden. It has major operations all over the world and is part of the domestic defense capability of several nations.

jobs.title: Family medicine specialist opportunities across Sweden
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time.

Family medicine specialist career opportunities across Sweden

Sweden has a growing demand for specialists in General Practice / Family Medicine within primary healthcare. Through Dignus Medical, a Scandinavian medical recruitment company with more than 20 years of experience, physicians from across Europe can explore long-term career opportunities within Swedish primary care.

We collaborate with modern primary care centres across Sweden, from smaller community clinics to larger multidisciplinary healthcare centres. Our role is to help you find a position that matches your professional interests, preferred location and work-life balance.

Primary care physicians in Sweden play a central role in the healthcare system and work with a broad variety of cases, long-term patient relationships and close collaboration with other healthcare professionals.

Professional Development

General practitioners in Sweden work in a clinically focused environment with opportunities to develop areas of special interest. Many clinics also offer opportunities to participate in teaching or supervision of junior doctors, particularly in larger healthcare centres.

Relocation and Support

Relocating to another country is a major step. Dignus Medical supports you throughout the entire process from the first conversation to being fully established in Sweden.

Your personal advisor will assist with:

    medical licensing
    relocation planning
    practical matters related to moving and settling in

Our services are completely free of charge for physicians.

Support for Your Family

Many physicians relocate with their families. We therefore provide guidance regarding schools, childcare, housing and everyday life in Sweden.

We can also offer support for partners seeking employment, including opportunities within healthcare where relevant.

Language Training

To work independently as a physician in Sweden, Swedish language proficiency at C1 level is required.

Dignus Medical provides intensive online Swedish language training with experienced instructors. The training is flexible and adapted to your schedule.

Language courses can also be offered to accompanying partners and older children to support their integration.

Living in Sweden

Sweden offers a high quality of life, safe communities and excellent public services.

Physicians often appreciate the balance between professional responsibility and personal life, with structured working hours and good opportunities for outdoor activities, sports and family life.

Families benefit from high-quality childcare, subsidized preschool and free school meals for children.

Requirements

We are looking for physicians who:

    Hold an EU-recognised specialist certification in General Practice / Family Medicine
    Have good communication skills in English
    Are motivated to learn Swedish and relocate to Sweden

Interested in learning more?

We’d love to hear from you. Submit your application or contact us today to explore current openings.

Let us help you take the next step in your career as a general practitioner specialist in Sweden!

Send your CV and specialist certificate, and we will discuss suitable opportunities within our network of hospitals across Sweden. Dignus Medical will help match your profile with the right position and guide you throughout the entire process.

We look forward to receiving your application!

You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

jobs.title: 🏔️ WORK IN THE HEART OF THE NORWEGIAN FJORDS!
jobs.description:
🏔️ WORK IN THE HEART OF THE NORWEGIAN FJORDS!

Kinsarvik Fjordhotel, BW Signature Collection is recruiting an international team for the 2027 season.

📅 Season: 26 April--3 October 2027

📍 Kinsarvik, Hardanger, Norway

👥 20 seasonal positions available

WE ARE HIRING

🧹 HOUSEKEEPING

• 4 Housekeeping Attendants

• 1 Housekeeping Supervisor

🍳 KITCHEN

• 1 Breakfast Chef

• 1 Sous Chef / Head Chef

• 2 Chefs

🍽️ RESTAURANT & BAR

• 1 F&B Supervisor

• 5 Waiters

🛎️ RECEPTION

• 2 Receptionists

• 2 Night Receptionists / Night Auditors

Rotation for night team: one week on / one week off

🔧 MAINTENANCE

• 1 Maintenance Employee

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

We are looking for reliable, positive and flexible people who are ready to contribute during a busy and exciting hotel season.

You enjoy working with people, take responsibility and understand the importance of excellent guest service.

Good spoken and written English is required for all positions. Norwegian is a significant advantage, particularly for reception, supervisory and other guest-facing roles.

Relevant experience is required for supervisory and senior kitchen positions. For several other roles, motivation, reliability and the right attitude may be just as important as formal qualifications.

⚠️ RIGHT TO LIVE AND WORK IN NORWAY

All applicants must already have the legal right to live and work in Norway at the time of application and must maintain this right throughout the agreed employment period.

Applicants from outside the EU/EEA must hold a valid Norwegian residence permit granting them the right to work in Norway when applying. Being eligible to apply for a permit is not sufficient. A residence permit issued by another European country does not automatically grant the right to work in Norway.

EU/EEA citizens must comply with applicable Norwegian registration requirements.

Applicants must provide documentation of their right to live and work in Norway with their application. Applications from candidates who do not meet these requirements will not be considered.

No employee may start work without the necessary legal right and valid documentation.

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

✨ A unique season in beautiful Hardanger

✨ A professional and international working environment

✨ Competitive pay based on experience and responsibility

✨ A proper Norwegian employment contract

✨ Training and support

✨ Staff accommodation available for rent, subject to availability

✨ Staff meal arrangements

✨ Opportunities to develop and return for future seasons

IMPORTANT AVAILABILITY INFORMATION

As we are a seasonal hotel, applicants must be available throughout the agreed employment period.

Employees should not expect to take holidays during the operating season. Any planned holiday or absence must be disclosed during recruitment and discussed and approved in accordance with Norwegian legislation and the hotel's staffing requirements.

HOW TO APPLY

Send your CV and a short application in English.

Please include:

• The position you are applying for

• Relevant experience and references

• Your English and Norwegian proficiency

• Confirmation of your availability for the season

• Confirmation of your legal right to live and work in Norway

• Your nationality and current residence/work permit status, where applicable

Please write the position you are applying for in the email subject line.

Applications will be reviewed continuously.

💙 Come for the job. Stay for the people, the fjord and an unforgettable season!

Kinsarvik Fjordhotel, BW Signature Collection

Operated by Kinsarvik Hotelldrift AS

#KinsarvikFjordhotel #JobsInNorway #HotelJobs #SeasonalJobs #Hardanger #VisitNorway #HospitalityJobs #ChefJobs #HousekeepingJobs #ReceptionJobs #RestaurantJobs #WorkInNorway

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Kinsarvik Fjordhotel, BW Signature Collection is a seasonal hotel located in beautiful Hardanger -- one of Norway's most spectacular fjord regions.

With 70 rooms, a restaurant, bar and conference facilities, we welcome guests from Norway and around the world. Our location offers an exceptional combination of fjords, mountains, waterfalls and outdoor experiences right outside the hotel.

We are an international and close-knit team where teamwork, responsibility and good guest service are important. Working with us is an opportunity to gain valuable hospitality experience, meet people from different countries and spend a memorable season in the heart of the Norwegian fjords.

Come to Norway for the experience -- and become part of our team in Hardanger.

jobs.title: Avdelingsleder
jobs.description:
Brenner du for gode tjenester til hjemmeboende eldre og personer med psykiske helseutfordringer?
Et viktig bidrag til dette er å sikre at ansatte blir sett, ivaretatt og fulgt opp, slik at de kan yte gode tjenester til brukerne.
Huset aktivitetssenter og dagaktivitetstilbudene for eldre trenger ny leder. Er du den rette? Her får du en spennende og utfordrende jobb med flere lokasjoner, flotte ansatte og en ledergruppe med dyktige, rause og hjelpsomme kollegaer.
Huset aktivitetssenter er et aktivitetstilbud og en møteplass for personer med psykiske helseutfordringer. Her er det 4,6 årsverk fordelt på fem ansatte. Tilbudet har drift på dagtid, og du vil ha kontorsted her.
Dagaktivitetstilbudene for eldre er fordelt på fire lokasjoner og ivaretar hjemmeboende eldre som ikke kan benytte andre tilbud på egen hånd.
  • Havnaberg har fokus på opptrening og er for de friskeste brukerne.
  • Haraldsvang ivaretar personer med demensdiagnose.
  • Udland har en blandet brukergruppe.
  • Bjørgene har også en blandet brukergruppe, men ivaretar i hovedsak brukere med behov for noe tettere oppfølging.
Til sammen er det 9,63 årsverk fordelt på 12 faste ansatte, i tillegg til noen vikarer. All drift foregår på dagtid.


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Fag-, personal- og økonomiansvar for avdelingen.
  • Lede og videreutvikle dagaktivitetstilbud for eldre og Huset aktivitetssenter i tråd med kommunens mål og strategi.
  • Sikre kvalitet, kontinuitet og brukermedvirkning i tjenestene.
  • Bidra til innovasjon og utviklingsarbeid i tråd med kommunens strategier.
  • Rekruttere, motivere og utvikle medarbeidere.
  • Samarbeide med interne og eksterne aktører.
  • Følge opp budsjett, rapportering og administrativ drift.
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Relevant helse- og sosialfaglig utdanning på høyskole- eller universitetsnivå.
  • Ledererfaring, lederutdanning eller relevant videreutdanning er ønskelig.
  • Ønskelig med erfaring innen bruk av kommunens systemer, som Notus/visma ressurs, visma enterprise, og gerica.
  • Gode IT-kunnskaper.
  • Førerkort klasse B er påkrevd, og du må disponere egen bil.
  • Det stilles krav om tilfredsstillende politiattest for personell i helse- og omsorgstjenesten.
Personlige egenskaper
  • Du glir godt inn i ulike miljøer og ønsker å være med på å «eie» alle avdelingene sammen med de ansatte.
  • Du er åpen og raus, og klarer å sette grenser når det er behov for det.
  • Du fremstår som rolig, men trives med å snakke med brukere og ansatte.
  • Du er ryddig, strukturert, faglig fokusert og opptatt av å levere gode resultater.
  • Du involverer ansatte og bidrar til forutsigbarhet og inkludering i prosesser.
  • Du trives med å se andre lykkes og med å hjelpe dem til å utvikle seg og nå sitt potensial.
  • Du er en trygg støtte og kan håndtere de mest krevende sakene ved behov.
  • Du har god forståelse for offentlig forvaltning, lov- og avtaleverk samt kommunal styring.
  • Du har evne til strategisk og helhetlig ledelse, samtidig som du ivaretar drift og oppfølging.
  • Det er krav om norskferdigheter tilsvarende nivå C1 muntlig og B2-C1 skriftlig.  

     Personlig egnethet vil bli tillagt stor vekt
Vi tilbyr
  • Fast 100% stilling med dagarbeid og fleksitidsordning.
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger.
  • IA-bedrift.
  • Gode muligheter for faglig og personlig utvikling.
  • God mulighet til å legge opp egen arbeidshverdag.
  • Konkurransedyktige lønnsbetingelser.
  • God seniorpolitikk.
  • Bilavtale tilbys.
KontaktinformasjonMarianne Kolstø Knutsen, Enhetsleder, +47 488 68 376, marianne.kolsto@haugesund.kommune.no

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Vi former byen ilag, nabolag for nabolag – blir du med på laget?
Haugesund kommune er en av byens største arbeidsgivere. Her jobber vi sammen mot visjonen å utvikle Haugesund til en god by å leve i for innbyggerne, et sterkt regionsenter for hele Haugalandet, og en konkurransedyktig aktør mellom Stavanger og Bergen.

I Haugesund kommune får du et meningsfullt arbeid samtidig som du bidrar til utviklingen av lokalsamfunnet. Hos oss møter du tydelige strukturer, kvalitet og gode systemer som gir forutsigbarhet og stabile rammer i arbeidshverdagen. Samtidig har vi fokus på god balanse mellom arbeid og fritid.

Haugesund kommune er opptatt av å gjenspeile mangfoldet i samfunnet og måten å være menneske på - vi trenger alle! Vi oppfordrer derfor kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke jobb hos oss uansett alder, kjønn, funksjonshemming, nasjonal eller etnisk bakgrunn.

jobs.title: HSE Engineer, Customer Projects and Sites
jobs.description:
Are you the enthusiastic, self-driven and result-oriented service professional who wants to move our customer’s performance forward by Leading the way?

We are looking for an HSE Engineer to be based in Gothenburg, Karlstad or Sundsvall. As an HSE Engineer you will have an opportunity to secure health, safety, environmental and social responsibility implementation and development of our Global Customer projects and construction sites around the world. We are seeking a dynamic team player to join our team.  

Key responsibilities:

    Provide project HSE engineer services in nominated EPC and high-risk EPS sales and delivery projects, including readiness for ad hoc and pre-planned site presence typically 1 to 4 weeks.
    Provide on-site safety supervisor services in nominated large shutdown work and short projects.
    Train and coach Valmet project and site organizations, including partners contracted as supervisors for site work, on Valmet project and site HSE management and social responsibility process and practices.
    Identify and coordinate the HSE partner network.
    Arrange sub-contractor HSE Days.
    Participate in sub-contractor audits and lead site HSE audits.
    Ensure HSE incidents on customer sites are investigated and communicated and lead serious incident investigations.
    Contribute to developing Valmet project and site HSE management and social responsibility process and practices.

To succeed in this role, you will need:  

    Minimum 5-7 years of experience working in HSE and several years of experience in multi-cultural customer projects and site HSE work.
    Experience in leading complex, cross-functional projects in a global environment.
    Technical competence in customer site HSE management practices including risk identification and mitigation, especially in EPC projects.
    Relevant academic degree, for example in Occupational Health & Safety, Environmental Science, or other scientific fields. Professional HSE qualifications such as NEBOSH, CSP, or similar will be considered an asset.
    Incident investigation skills.
    Knowledge of multi-site ISO 14001, 45001 and 9001 management system standards, as well as internal auditing skills.
    Fluent verbal and written communication skills in English and Swedish. Knowledge of additional languages is considered an asset.
    Working knowledge of Microsoft Office-Suite, Power BI, M-Files, Sharepoint and Teams.

You are an HSE role model with integrity and a strong moral compass, which is the fundament of the position. We are looking for a person with a positive and energetic service mindset who can communicate transparently with clarity and authority. You are a person who influences and negotiates to find solutions and achieve results. At the same time, you build strong networks and engagement towards priorities. You have strong decision-making skills and can make the right decisions at the right time.

We offer

In return, we offer you an interesting work environment and a challenging position within a global industry leader, supported by Valmet's global network. With us, you will work in a team that contributes to the success of the organization, as well as find opportunities for personal development.  

Additional information

To be included in the recruiting process, please complete our online application form as soon as possible but no later than October 19, 2026.

Do you want to know more? For further information about the position, please contact Stefan Hallgren, Manager, Customer Projects and Sites HSE, +46725641403.  

For further information regarding the recruitment process, please contact Isabelle Lindow, Talent Acquisition Partner, at isabelle.lindow@valmet.com. Please note that we do not accept applications via email.

We perform background checks and alcohol/drug testing for all employees, in line with our commitment to a safe and secure workplace.

When everything works together

Valmet is where the best talent from a wide variety of backgrounds comes together. We work together with our customers throughout the entire lifecycle, delivering cutting-edge technologies and services as well as mission-critical automation and flow control solutions. Backed by more than 225 years of industrial experience and a global team of over 19,000 professionals close to customers, we are uniquely positioned to transform industries toward a regenerative tomorrow.

At Valmet, diversity of thought drives innovation. We are committed to a respectful and inclusive environment, where people can be themselves and are supported to contribute at their best. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make hiring decisions based on skills, experience, and potential, never on personal characteristics such as gender, gender identity, age, ethnicity, nationality, disability, neurodiversity, religion, sexual orientation, or political views.

Join the team – and lead the way with us!

jobs.title: Biträdande rektor till Landvetterskolans högstadium
jobs.description:
1 plats(er).


Din arbetsplats

Välkommen till Härryda, en kommun som vågar! Här siktar vi mot att ha Sveriges bästa skolor och näringslivsklimat, omsorg av högsta kvalitet och attraktivt samhällsbyggande. Tillsammans är vi 3000 medarbetare som gör mötet med Härryda kommun enkelt. Med mod, nytänkande och handlingskraft inspirerar vi varandra och levererar service med kompetens och kvalitet. Härryda kommun har de fyra senaste åren placerat sig i topp i Dagens Samhälles årliga ranking av Årets superkommun.

Vi söker dig som är engagerad, öppen för olika perspektiv och vill skapa lösningar som håller för kommande generationer. Du hittar oss mellan Göteborg och Borås med Landvetter flygplats mitt i kommunen. Tillsammans åstadkommer vi mer!

Härryda kommun har som skolkommun gjort sig känd för goda resultat och ett systematiskt arbete för likvärdighet med bland annat gemensam kompetensutveckling. Härryda kommun har ett friskvårdsbidrag på 3000kr.

Landvetterskolan är en kommunal grundskola för årskurs 4 - 9 med cirka 640 elever, centralt belägen i Landvetter. Nu söker vi en biträdande rektor som vill ta ett tydligt operativt ansvar för verksamheten i årskurs 7 - 9.

Ditt uppdrag

I ditt uppdrag ingår den dagliga ledningen av verksamheten inom årskurs 7 - 9 med ansvar för struktur, trygghet och goda förutsättningar för undervisning, lärande och trivsel. Du leder arbetet nära medarbetarna och elevernas vardag och har ett tydligt personalansvar inom ditt område.

Du samverkar med elever, vårdnadshavare och kollegor och bidrar aktivt till skolans elevhälsoarbete och systematiska kvalitetsarbete. Rollen passar dig som vill kombinera ett närvarande vardagsledarskap med ett långsiktigt utvecklingsperspektiv.

Du kommer att ha ett nära samarbete med rektor för 7 - 9 samt ingå i vår ledningsgrupp tillsammans med rektor och biträdande rektor på mellanstadiet.

Ditt ledarskap:
Vi söker dig som leder med både riktning och relation. Du har ett starkt och välutvecklat professionellt omdöme. Du är trygg, tydlig och strukturerad, samtidigt som du möter andra med lyhördhet och ödmjukhet samt inger förtroende hos elever, vårdnadshavare och medarbetare.

Du trivs i ett uppdrag där du behöver vara både operativ, lösningsfokuserad och utvecklingsdriven. Du tar ansvar, fattar beslut och driver utvecklingsarbetet i en tydlig riktning.

Det här krävs för tjänsten

Vi söker dig som har pedagogisk högskoleexamen, lärarutbildning eller annan utbildning som arbetsgivaren bedömer som relevant och som har flerårig erfarenhet av arbete i grundskola, god kunskap om skolans styrdokument och erfarenhet av att leda, samordna eller driva utvecklingsarbete i skolverksamhet. Du uttrycker dig mycket väl på svenska i tal och skrift.

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av skolledaruppdrag eller annat ledningsansvar i skola, liksom erfarenhet av personalansvar, elevhälsoarbete och systematiskt kvalitetsarbete. Vi ser också gärna att du har arbetat som lärare eller skolledare i årskurs 7 - 9. Genomförd eller påbörjad rektorsutbildning är meriterande. Stor vikt läggs vid personlig lämplighet.

För att erhålla anställning ska utdrag ur Polisens belastningsregister uppvisas. Utdrag ur misstankeregistret kan även bli aktuellt utifrån tjänst.

Dina personliga egenskaper är viktiga för oss

Som biträdande rektor är ditt ledarskap avgörande. Vi söker dig som har ett starkt omdöme och som leder på ett motiverande, inkluderande och förtroendefullt sätt. Du har stor självinsikt, är ödmjuk i mötet med andra och har god förmåga att förstå människors olika perspektiv och behov.

Du bygger tillitsfulla relationer och skapar delaktighet, samtidigt som du leder tydligt och strukturerat med fokus på kvalitet, uppföljning och resultat. Du kommunicerar klart, anpassar dig efter mottagare och situation och fattar välgrundade beslut, även i komplexa sammanhang.

Du är lösningsfokuserad, tar initiativ och driver arbetet framåt, men gör det med respekt för dem du leder och tillsammans med dem omkring dig. Du delar vår övertygelse om att goda relationer, kvalitativ undervisning och höga förväntningar på varandra skapar de bästa förutsättningarna för elevers lärande och utveckling.

Vad vi erbjuder dig

Läs mer på vår hemsida om vad vi erbjuder dig. (https://www.harryda.se/arbete/arbetaiharrydakommun/detharerbjudervidig.4.4bd770a51817ff14fcd13400.html)

Övrig information

I denna rekrytering kan intervjuer komma att ske löpande under ansökningstiden. Slutkandidater kommer att genomgå testning som en del av urvalsprocessen. Provanställning kan komma att tillämpas.
Vi vill upplysa om att din ansökan är en allmän handling enligt offentlighetsprincipen. Om du som sökande har skyddade personuppgifter så skickar du din ansökan i pappersform till: Härryda kommun, Personalfunktionen, Sofia Götberg, 435 80 Mölnlycke. jobs.title: Tullverket söker gruppchef för spaningsgrupp
jobs.description:
Vill du ha ett ansvarsfullt och intressant arbete där du har möjlighet att bidra till att skapa ett tryggt och säkert samhälle? Då är jobbet inom Tullverkets Tullkriminalenhet något för dig!

Tullverket har som uppdrag att begränsa den organiserade och storskaliga brottsligheten och förhindra den illegala införseln av narkotika- och dopingpreparat, alkohol, tobak, vapen och andra varor som hotar liv, hälsa och miljö. Tullverket ska bidra till att minska antalet kriminella nätverk som ägnar sig åt narkotika-, alkohol- eller tobakssmuggling eller ekonomisk brottslighet.

Tullverket består av fyra operativa avdelningar; kontrollavdelningen, uppbördsavdelningen, underrättelseavdelningen och tullkriminalavdelningen. Tullkriminalavdelningen ansvarar för Tullverkets brottsutredande verksamhet och teknisk inhämtning. Verksamheten arbetar inom ramen för förundersökning av brott eller åtgärder som ska leda till förundersökning av brott i syfte att lagföra huvudmän bakom brottslighet, minska lönsamheten av brottslighet samt påtagligt störa kriminella aktiviteter.

Tullkriminalavdelningen består av ett nationellt IT- och teknikcentrum med ansvar för hemliga tvångsmedel, spaningsteknik och IT-forensik, Tullverkets laboratorium samt fyra tullkriminalenheter som ansvarar för var sitt geografiskt område, Syd, Väst, Öst och Nord. Enheterna är uppdelade i verksamhetsområden: spaning, utredning grova brott samt utredning mängdbrott.



Om tjänsten

Som gruppchef för en spaningsgrupp ska du operativt styra, leda, följa upp och utveckla verksamheten genom att säkerställa att din grupp fungerar väl och levererar goda resultat i linje med mål, strategier och aktivitetsplan. Du ska strukturerat och genom ett coachande ledarskap leda och fördela arbetet inom gruppen.

Som gruppchef förväntas du stödja dina medarbetares utveckling genom bl.a. medarbetarsamtal och lönesamtal samt arbeta med lärande och erfarenhetsutbyte, som en del i ett kontinuerligt förbättrings- och utvecklingsarbete. I chefsuppdraget ingår även utveckla rutiner, metoder och processer enligt fattade beslut. Som gruppchef ansvarar du också för ledning arbetsplatsträffar samt ansvarar för arbetsmiljöarbetet som följer av särskild delegering.

Som gruppchef krävs att du företräder uppdragsgivaren, är arbetsgivare och verkställer fattade beslut. Ditt chefsuppdrag utövas genom ledarskapet som handlar om att styra verksamheter och leda människor. Det grundläggande uppdraget för myndighetens chefer är att utöva ett gott ledarskap och därigenom åstadkomma goda resultat genom sina medarbetare, i linje med uppdraget och utifrån tillgängliga resurser. För Tullverkets chefer och dess ledarskap är tre centrala utgångspunkter formulerade; uppdraget, samverkan och prioritering.

Som chef förväntas du vara en god förebild med gott omdöme.

Är du den vi söker?  

Vi söker dig som har:

    Godkänd grundläggande utbildning inom Tullverkets brottsbekämpande verksamhet eller motsvarande utbildning i annan brottsbekämpande myndighet som av Tullverket bedöms likvärdig.
    Genomförd och godkänd konflikthanteringsutbildning, inklusive kommunikation, självskydd, OC-spray och batongutbildning
    Genomförd och godkänd vapenutbildning avseende tjänstepistol Glock.
    Genomförd och godkänd spaningsutbildning- NPS fördjupad
    Genomförd och godkänd förarutbildning inom Tullverket (TNF) eller motsvarande förarutbildning som av Tullverket bedöms likvärdig samt mycket god körvana
    Minst 5 års erfarenhet av aktivt arbete med målinriktad spaning inom brottsbekämpande verksamhet
    Svenskt medborgarskap.
    Svenskt körkort, klass B manuell växellåda

Det är meriterande om du har:

    Erfarenhet av arbetsledning
    Erfarenhet som gruppchef
    Erfarenhet från Tullkriminalens verksamhetsområde

Personliga egenskaper

    Mod – att fatta och fullfölja beslut, ta tag i utmaningar och pröva nya idéer.
    God kommunikativ förmåga – som tydliggör riktning och ramar, och skapar mening och samförstånd genom inkluderande, inlyssnande och engagerande dialog.
    Psykologisk trygghet – i termer av integritet och förmåga att hantera såväl egna som andras reaktioner, tankar och känslor.
    Nyfikenhet och prestigelöshet – genom att utforska och utmana sig själv och andra i att tänka nytt och göra annorlunda i syfte att stimulera lärande och innovation.
    Ha förmåga att tillvarata mångfald – vad gäller kompetens, erfarenheter och perspektiv för att utveckla verksamheten och hantera den ökande komplexiteten vi agerar i.
    Strukturerad – Planerar, organiserar och prioriterar aktiviteter effektivt.
    Samarbetsförmåga – säkerställa god samverkan inom gruppen och i relation till andra grupper och enheter.
    Ha förmåga att aktivt arbeta för en god arbetsmiljö.
    Gott omdöme – Kunna uppträda som en god representant för Tullverket såväl internt som externt.

Vi kommer lägga stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper.

Vi erbjuder dig

Genom att jobba på Tullverket bidrar du till ett tryggt och säkert samhälle. Vi värderar trivsel och kompetensutveckling högt och är vi strävar efter att du som anställd ska kunna ha en bra balans mellan arbete och fritid. Hos oss får du såväl trygga anställningsvillkor och våra förmåner omfattar bland annat friskvårdsbidrag, subventionerade läkemedel och goda semester- och pensionsvillkor.

Övrigt:

Placeringsort: Göteborg

Vi ställer höga krav på våra medarbetares säkerhets- och sekretessmedvetenhet. Innan beslut om anställning kommer du att få genomgå drogtest och bakgrundskontroll. Säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen genomförs före anställning, då tjänsten är placerad i säkerhetsklass. Tullverket är en totalförsvarsmyndighet och vid anställning kommer du att krigsplaceras i Tullverket.

Tullverket värdesätter de kvaliteter som tillförs verksamheten genom att ha en jämn könsfördelning samt etnisk mångfald.

jobs.title: Digitalization Lead
jobs.description:
Company description:





Trucks Technology & Industrial Division hire team players who are ready to create real customer impact. Our decentralized teams work close to our customers, with speed and autonomy, to build what they truly need. Join us to collaborate on innovative, sustainable technologies that redefine how we design, build, and deliver value. Bring your curiosity, your expertise, and your collaborative energy, and together, we’ll turn bold ideas into tangible solutions for our customers and contribute to a more sustainable tomorrow.

Job description:





The role



Our digitalization journey is transforming how we develop the competence of our co-workers, how we work internally, and how we interact with dealers across Europe and customers worldwide. As Digitalization Lead, you will set direction, build alignment and accelerate the delivery of digital improvements that create measurable business value.



You will combine strategic leadership with hands-on delivery. You will challenge existing ways of working, translate complex business needs into clear digital priorities, and lead cross-functional collaboration from opportunity identification through implementation, adoption and value realization.







You will be located in Gothenburg, Sweden and report to Head of Service Operations Development.







What you will do




    

Own and lead the digitalization roadmap for Service Operations Ghent & EU, governing priorities and execution in line with our strategic ambitions for 2030,

  
    

Provide direction and thought leadership on digitalization, advising stakeholders on where technology can create the greatest business value and ensuring that initiatives support strategic objectives.

  
    

Turn business needs into scalable digital opportunities by clarifying problems, scope, users, expected outcomes, dependencies, risks and value, and by guiding solution choices.

  
    

Lead and facilitate digitalization networks and communities of practice across functions and locations. Set purpose and agenda, connect experts and stakeholders, enable knowledge sharing, align priorities and drive joint actions to completion.

  
    

Build strong cross-functional partnerships across business stakeholders, Digitalization & IT, developers, data teams, automation teams and relevant Group functions.

  
    

Build and govern a structured digitalization portfolio and pipeline, creating transparency of requests, initiatives, priorities, ownership, resources, dependencies, benefits and status.

  
    

Explore, evaluate and apply technologies such as automation, data analytics, AI and machine learning, dashboards, applications and emerging digital capabilities.

  
    

Guide the development and continuous improvement of digital solutions using technologies such as Python, Power BI, Databricks, Power Platform and automation tools, including testing, validation and implementation follow-up.

  
    

Drive process standardization, automation and smarter ways of working through RPA, AI solutions and orchestration of digital assets.

  
    

Enable access to the right data through collaboration with Digitalization & IT within SO&T and at Group level, while promoting sound data governance and responsible use of technology.

  
    

Lead change and adoption by building engagement, strengthening digital capability and supporting leaders and teams in embedding new solutions and ways of working.

  
    

Communicate roadmap priorities, progress, business value, risks and decisions through clear executive-level presentations, status updates and visualizations.

  



  



Ready for the next move?



We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via email. Last application 15th of October.

Profile description:

Who you are



You are a lead digitalization professional who combines strategic perspective, business acumen and technical understanding. You are comfortable taking ownership in an evolving environment, creating structures where it is needed and influencing decisions across organizational boundaries.







You bring people together around a shared direction and turn ideas into coordinated action. You communicate with clarity, build trust with senior and operational stakeholders, and balance ambition with pragmatic delivery. You are curious, inclusive and committed to enabling others to succeed.







Required knowledge and experience




    

An MSc in Engineering, Economics, Computer Science, Management or Logistics, or equivalent knowledge gained through proven experience.

  
    

Significant experience leading digitalization, business transformation, process improvement or technology-enabled change in a complex organization.

  
    

Proven ability to shape roadmaps, prioritize initiatives, establish governance and lead cross-functional delivery from idea to adoption and value realization.

  
    

Experience leading networks, communities of practice or cross-functional forums, with the ability to create alignment, mobilize contributors and drive decisions and actions.

  
    

Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, including confidence in engaging senior leaders and translating complex topics into clear recommendations.

  
    

Knowledge or experience in areas such as process design, information analysis, robotic process automation, agentic automation and AI, Python, cloud technology and data management.

  
    

The ability to connect business requirements with scalable digital solutions, assess trade-offs and guide appropriate technology choices.

  
    

Strong communication and change leadership skills, with enthusiasm for building capability, sharing knowledge and enabling adoption.

jobs.title: Vil du jobbe med et ja-menneske, som elsker strikking og baking.
jobs.description:
Hei 🌟

Jeg er ei dame, i min beste alder, som etter en hjernebetennelse i 2018, har fått varig nedsatt funksjonsnedsettelse. Sitter i dag i rullestol, men det hindrer meg ikke å leve mitt beste liv. Jeg er ei aktiv dame, gift og har 4 voksne barn og den yngste bor fremdeles hjemme. Er stort sett i godt humør, smilende og imøtekommende, liker å utforske nye ting.

Jeg har flere interesser som jeg gjerne gjør sammen med andre. Kino, se på film og gjerne en kafe tur eller to. Elsker å strikke og har alltid ett (les flere) prosjekt liggende. Baker når muligheten tillater. Så snart været tillater det, så tilbringer jeg gjerne tiden ute, enten rullende eller syklende.

Det er hyggelig om du deler noen av mine interesser, men dette er ikke et krav så lenge du er åpen for å være med. Jeg kan tilby deg en meningsfull og morsom arbeidshverdag, der du er mine armer og bein. En jobb der du sjeldent behøve å stresse eller være redd for å gjøre noe galt, fordi du sannsynligvis gjør de samme tingene hjemme hos deg selv. Stillingsstørrelse kan tilpasses, alt fra 40 til 70 %, det finner vi ut sammen. 💌 Blir du med på laget mitt?

jobs.description:
Company Description

Inter IKEA Group brings together three areas: Retail Concept, Range and Supply. Together we work constantly to improve the IKEA home furnishing offer and make it more accessible for the many people. You will be part of IKEA Supply and the Supply Chain Development organisation. IKEA Supply is responsible for securing that the product offer is produced, procured and delivered to our customers. We lead the supply agenda across many functions and work together with all range areas, different business units, but also retail markets to secure customer availability in all markets and sales channels at lowest total cost.

We strive to create a workplace where everyone feels free to be themselves – explore, try new ways, and dare to ask, “What if…?” At IKEA we have a vibrant culture where ideas are heard, we encourage learning new skills, where the goal always is "to create a better everyday life for the many people". We give down-to-earth, straightforward people the possibility to grow, both as individuals and in their professional roles in a fast-paced, global environment with an endless supply of challenges and opportunities.

We set the development and innovation agenda to keep IKEA leading in a fast-changing world. Through our operating model, agile ways of working and empowered teams, we develop, run and innovate IKEA capabilities, processes, digital products & platforms. IKEA Supply leads four capabilities: Manufacturing, Supply Chain Planning, Procurement and Logistics Operations.

In this context we are looking for You who has passion for people and supply chain, who enjoys working in an internationally diverse & complex environment and is driven by leading the work with Capability Area development roadmap, integrated planning, prioritization, sequencing. Doing so can lead through others, easily build strong relationships, create an atmosphere of trust, respect and togetherness.

We are now looking for a Capability Area Planning Leader.

Job Description

You will be:

    Accountable for development and continuous management of the Capability Area roadmap in close alignment with the Process dimension, Core businesses and other IKEA companies
    Hold together the highest level of plan-making over the mid-long term, including prioritization, sequencing, and financial frame.
    Maintain awareness of the objectives and movements to be achieved by the different Capability areas within Inter IKEA through having a good understanding of the roadmaps for each area and the contribution to the E2E processes.
    Enable monitoring, tracking and report on the Capability area roadmap in collaboration with Operations management Roadmap
    Work across Capability Areas and initiatives within Inter IKEA, steering a successful development that meets business objectives and drives IKEA business results
    Lead the development of strategic analysis for the Capability Area to facilitate sequencing, scenario modeling and pace in roadmap.
    Orchestrate implementation of pre-requisites and help Capability area to define OKR's that contribute to strategic goals
    Lead the monitoring of execution and progress follow-up of roadmap initiatives.
    Regularly educate/communicate the progress of the Capability portfolio to the Business line/Line organizations and external touchpoints as necessary in close collaboration with partners in Process management, Core businesses and other IKEA companies following Inter IKEA governance and year cycle.
    Support the Operations Management Roadmap in developing the Roadmap/planning capabilities through frameworks, tools, ways of working and ways to track progress of the overall roadmap in terms of effort, costs, people and results. (Example Value stream analysis, Capability framework, breakdown of work...)

Qualifications

For the role of a Capability Area Planning Leader, your main capabilities, knowledge, and skills are:

    Deep understanding of the IKEA value chain, organisation, operating model, ways of working and total cost approach.
    Extensive knowledge of the assigned Capability Area and its contribution to end-to-end value creation.
    Strong capability to develop, align, maintain and embed roadmaps that deliver business objectives.
    Extensive knowledge of business planning, prioritisation, sequencing and portfolio management.
    Experience with product management teams, development processes and agile or Scrum ways of working.
    Strong analytical, tactical and planning skills, including scenario modelling, business architecture and value-chain optimisation.
    Ability to bring together complex information and translate business needs, strategies, data and technology into clear development plans.
    Proven ability to lead change, take ownership and deliver strong results with persistence and a positive mindset.
    Clear communicator and collaborative team player who synchronises development across capabilities, processes and countries.
    Strong interpersonal and networking skills, with the ability to build trustful relationships and alliances at all levels.

Additional Information

We always recruit based on values, competence, potential and diversity. We will first consider co-workers employed at Inter IKEA Group impacted by organizational changes. For this specific recruitment priority will be given to impacted co-workers in IKEA Core Business Supply provided competence requirements are met for the role.

We look forward to receiving your application in English. Please note that we will be interviewing continuously, which means that we may close the application process earlier than stated if we find the right candidate. This position can be based in Älmhult, Sweden. We regret that we are unable to handle applications made by e-mail. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible, but no later than 19 Oct. 2026.

For more information about the position, please contact Hiring Manager Capability Area Manager Slawek Peter at slawomir.peter@inter.ikea.com. For questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact People & Culture Specialist Katie Pettersson at katie.pettersson2@inter.ikea.com.

At IKEA we believe that we’re better when we’re physically together for collaboration, dialogues and conversations. We believe in the power of human interactions; the informal chats, the energy, belonging and creativity generated by people being in the same place. Our approach is that we spend majority of our time in the IKEA workplace and with flexibility to work from home when relevant.

jobs.title: Master Thesis: Productivity Enhancement of PBF-EB Through Porous Printing,
jobs.description:
Project Description
Powder Bed Fusion by Electron Beam (PBF-EB) normally aims to produce components with high density. However, productivity may be improved by creating only a gas-tight outer shell around a sintered or semi-melted porous core, followed by Hot Isostatic Pressing (HIP). In PBF-EB, internal pores are formed under vacuum, which is favorable for pore closure during HIP provided that the shell remains gas-tight. Previous studies in both PBF-EB and PBF-LB have demonstrated the feasibility of shell-core concepts, although validation for more complex geometries remains limited.[1]­,[2] If HIP is already required, the approach reduces energy input, build time, cost, and evaporation of sensitive alloying elements. The key challenges are to identify stable process parameters, verify shell integrity, and quantify porosity, densification, and dimensional shrinkage.
  
This master thesis will focus primarily on experimental work in the PBF-EB printer. The student will evaluate a limited set of process parameters to produce test parts with a dense shell and a porous sintered or semi-melted core. Samples will be characterized before and after HIP to determine process stability, shell integrity, density, pore morphology, microstructure, and dimensional change. The work will generate an initial dataset for shrinkage compensation and include a limited finite element modelling (FEM) task to predict and compensate shrinkage.
  
The aim is to determine whether a shell-core PBF-EB strategy can shorten build time while producing preforms suitable for HIP consolidation, and to establish an initial method for compensating predictable shrinkage. The scope is sized for one 30-credit master thesis: one material, simple coupon geometries, a few iterative test prints, 1-2 HIP cycles, basic sample characterization, FEM shrinkage modelling, and printing a more complex shape to evaluate the developed model and process parameters. Full constitutive model development, extensive mechanical qualification, and industrial-scale validation are outside the thesis scope.

Scope and Objectives
The student will:

    Review PBF-EB shell-core strategies, HIP densification, shrinkage compensation and relevant FEM approaches.
    Define a feasible specimen design with an airtight shell and a sintered and/or semi-melted core.
    Screen a small set of printer variables.
    Produce a dense reference condition and a number of shell-core conditions with varying initial density levels.
    Characterise shell integrity, density, pore morphology, dimensions, and microstructure before HIP.
    HIP and quantify densification and dimensional shrinkage.
    Create an initial shrinkage-compensation relationship based on FEM modelling.
    Estimate potential build-time and cost benefits relative to the dense reference using recorded machine data.

Expected outcomes

    A documented PBF-EB process window for manufacturing airtight shell-core structures with porous interiors.
    A dataset containing process parameters, density measurements, pore characteristics, shell integrity assessments, 3D scan dimensional measurements before and after HIP.
    Quantification of HIP-induced densification, shrinkage, and geometric deviation for selected shell-core conditions.
    A simplified FEM-based workflow for shrinkage prediction calibrated using experimental results.
    Validation of the methodology on a more complex geometry representative of practical applications.
    An optional comparison between PBF-EB and PBF-LB shell-core structures.
    An indicative assessment of productivity and cost benefits compared with conventional dense PBF-EB manufacturing.
    Recommendations for future work involving more complex geometries, wider process windows, and more advanced modelling approaches.

The student will refine the experimental matrix and FEM together with supervisors and colleagues at Swerim. A successful thesis is expected to prioritize robust PBF-EB processing, verification of shell airtightness, reliable HIP densification, and accurate shrinkage measurements. The FEM work will focus on practical shrinkage prediction and model calibration. Comparison with PBF-LB material is considered a stretch objective and will be included only if resources and project timing permit.

Qualifications
Master’s student in materials science, mechanical, manufacturing, aerospace engineering, applied physics, or a related field. A strong understanding of physical metallurgy and an interest in hands-on experimental work, systematic data analysis, and problem-solving are essential. Access to FEM software such as Abaqus or COMSOL through the university is required because Swerim has limited number of software licenses. Practical experience with metal powder bed fusion (PBF-EB/LB), metallurgical lab preparation, microscopy, finite element modeling (FEM), metrology, or Python/MATLAB is advantageous but not required.

Project time
The project is intended for a master thesis (30 credits). The planned start is January 2027, or another date agreed with the selected student.

Further information
This project is intended to be performed at Swerim in Stockholm. Swerim rewards the student with 50 000 SEK for an approved master thesis (30hp).

For further information please contact: Emil Strandh, emil.strandh@swerim.se

Application
Apply by using the application function below. The application can be written in English or Swedish. Latest date for application is 20th of November. You will receive a confirmation that Swerim has received your application. Please note that we fill the position as soon as we find a suitable applicant, which means we can fill the position before the deadline.

[2] Whitepaper | HIP for Free: Speed Printing Unleashed

jobs.title: Erfaren barnskötare sökes
jobs.description:
Verksamhetsidén är att skapa en förskola som ska lägga grunden för ett livslångt lärande. Verksamheten ska bedrivas med barnens intresse och behov som utgångspunkt där omsorg, utveckling och lärande bildar en helhet.

Småvisans förskola driver två verksamheter, Småvisans förskola Kirseberg och Småvisans förskola Västra Hamnen.

Vi jobbar systematiskt med 4 Fokusområden under ett läsår där vi väver in Läroplanens olika delar.

Vi söker 1 barnskötare som kan axla ett stort ansvar tillsammans med övriga kollegor. Tjänsten är först och främst till Småvisans förskola i Västra Hamnen men arbete i Småvisans förskola i Kirseberg kan förekomma.

Vill du ge barnen de bästa förutsättningar de kan få och samtidigt få stor möjlighet till personlig-och professionell utveckling? Då ska du söka dig till oss. Vi söker barnskötare som kan komplettera oss med sina erfarenheter, kunskaper, lösningar och positivitet. Vi förutsätter att du är kompetent, vetgirig och redo att axla ett stort ansvar.

Arbetsuppgifter

Som barnskötare arbetar du utifrån aktuella styrdokument och planerar, genomför, och utvecklar den pedagogiska verksamheten tillsammans med resten av arbetslaget. Du arbetar för att skapa en trygg, rolig och lärorik förskola. Du har lätt för att lära dig nya saker och kan ta egna initiativ och leda kollegor när det behövs. Ditt arbete präglas av en tydlig respekt för individen samt en bra relation till barn, vårdnadshavare och kollegor.

Kvalifikationer

Krav

Barnskötarutbildning och minst 2 års erfarenhet

Flytande svenska, i både tal och skrift.

Meriterande

Har arbetat med lågaffektivt bemötande

Utbildning och/eller erfarenhet av barn med särskilda behov

Vi söker dig som

Har en positiv inställning och god kommunikation och samarbetsförmåga med barn, vårdnadshavare och kollegor.

Är driven och inspirerar arbetslaget med ett stort engagemang.

Är nyfiken och lösningsfokuserad

Är aktiv, drivande och har ett stort intresse för barns lärande.

Övrigt

Tjänsten omfattas av registerkontroll. Sökande måste uppvisa utdrag från polisens belastningsregister innan anställning.

Sysselsättningen är 75%-100%.

Om anställningen

Lön: Enligt kollektivavtal  

Anställningsvillkor: Tillsvidareanställning med 6 månaders provanställning

Arbetsgivare: Utbildningsgruppen AOF AB/Småvisans Förskola AB

Kontakt: ansokan@smavisansforskola.se

Sista ansökningsdatum: 2026-10-23

Intervjuer sker löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas tidigare om rätt kandidat hittas.

ansokan@smavisansforskola.se ange “Barnskötare” som rubrik.

jobs.employer: BÆRUM KOMMUNE BARNEVERNVAKT, MOTTAK OG AKUTT
jobs.description:
Barnevernstjenesten i Bærum kommune er en av Norges største barnevernstjenester med cirka 160 ansatte og i underkant av 150 fosterhjem, besøkshjem og støttekontakter. Barnevernstjenesten består av seks fagavdelinger og en forvaltningsavdeling. Avdeling ungdom har ansvaret for oppfølging av ungdom i alderen 13-25 år og deres familier som har vedtak om tiltak fra barnevernstjenesten.

Barnevernstjenesten ønsker å gå foran innen kvalitetsutviklingsarbeid på barnevernsområdet, gjennomfører oppvekstreformen gjennom blant annet barnevernsfaglig tiltaksavdeling, drifter spesialiserte hjelpetiltak som RFT, MST-CAN, ABC og PMTO, har egne veilederteam for fosterhjem og for foreldre etter omsorgsovertakelse, og er vertskommune for Asker og Bærum barnevernvakt. Barnevernstjenesten i Bærum har formalisert samarbeid med flere forsknings- og kompetansemiljøer om utvikling og implementering av barnevernsfaglige tiltak etter barnevernsloven. Barnevernstjenesten i Bærum har de siste årene utviklet en forebyggende tjenesteprofil, med parallell nedgang i behovet for mer inngripende barnevernstiltak/plasseringer.

Barnevernstjenesten holder til i Kommunegården i Sandvika, med gode kollektivforbindelser og kort reisevei både til Oslo og Asker/Drammen.


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Saksbehandling og faglig oppfølging av barn, ungdommer og familier som har tiltak etter barnevernsloven
  • Utstrakt kontakt og samarbeid med barn, foreldre og samarbeidende instanser
  • Forvaltningsoppgaver og skriftlig dokumentasjon iht. barnevernsloven
  • Representere barnevernstjenesten i saker for barneverns- og helsenemnda
  • Delta i barnevernstjenestens utviklingsarbeid
  • Delta i, og følge opp, eget veiledningsforløp med fast fagleder etter utarbeidet plan og rollebeskrivelse
  • Bidra til veiledning av studenter etter barnevernsloven
  • Aktivt bidra til et trygt og positivt arbeidsmiljø og kollegafelleskap
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Relevant grunnutdanning/bachelor fra universitet eller høgskole. Aktuelle fagretninger er hovedsakelig barnevernspedagog eller sosionom. Andre relevante utdanninger på høyskolenivå i kombinasjon med relevant videreutdanning eller mastergrad kan unntaksvis vurderes
  • Relevant barnevernsfaglig videreutdanning tilsvarende minimum 30 studiepoeng er ønskelig
  • Oppdatert erfaring fra og/eller kompetanse i barnevernsfaglig arbeid og forvaltning er nødvendig
  • Erfaring fra arbeid med barn, unge og familier vil vektlegges
  • Erfaring fra saksbehandling i førstelinjetjeneste vil vektlegges
  • Spesifikk erfaring og eventuell videreutdanning/mastergrad relevant for barnevernsfaglig oppfølgingsarbeid i aldersgruppen 13-25 år vil vektlegges
  • God skriftlig og muntlig fremstillingsevne. Søkere fra land utenfor Skandinavia må ha bestått minimum norskprøve B2, skriftlig og muntlig
  • Gode engelskferdigheter muntlig og skriftlig
  • Førerkort klasse B
Personlige egenskaper
  • Evne til god og tillitsbyggende kommunikasjon med mennesker i vanskelige livssituasjoner, med kollegaer og samarbeidsinstanser
  • God rolleforståelse og samarbeidsevner
  • Evne til, og erfaring fra, å jobbe strukturert og planmessig
  • Selvstendig og initiativrik
  • Gode evner til faglig og etisk refleksjon
  • Stor arbeidskapasitet
  • Lærevillig, robust og trives med et variert og tidvis høyt arbeidstempo

Personlig egnethet tillegges stor vekt

Vi tilbyr
  • Arbeid i en av Norges største barnevernstjenester som:
    • aktivt deltar på en rekke utviklingsarenaer og etterstreber å være i forkant av den faglige utviklingen
    • satser og prøver ut nye veier og metoder innen barnevernsfaget, og arbeider strategisk og systematisk med kvalitetsutvikling
    • er utviklingsorientert og endringsrettet, og som fokuserer på et godt og trygt arbeidsmiljø
  • Mulighet for barnesamtalen DCM og nettverksmøteledelse
  • Offentlig tjenestepensjon
  • Mulighet for kompetanseutviklingsstipend

Annet

  • Bærum kommune legger vekt på mangfold på arbeidsplassen og oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke
  • Vi har et personalpolitisk mål om å oppnå en balansert alders- og kjønnssammensetning og rekruttere personer med flerkulturell bakgrunn
  • Bærum kommune er en IA (inkluderende arbeidsliv)-virksomhet
  • Originale vitnemål og attester vil etterspørres ved intervju


Gyldig politiattest iht. § 12-11 Barnevernsloven må fremlegges før ansettelse

KontaktinformasjonMargarete Vanderhill, Avdelingsleder, 906 19 857
Arbeidssted
1338 Sandvika
Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgiver: Bærum kommune

Referansenr.: 5187028377
Stillingsprosent: 100%
Fast
Søknadsfrist: 19.10.2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Sammen skaper vi et godt og inkluderende samfunn for over 130 000 innbyggere, både i dag og i årene som kommer. Vi skaper rammer som bidrar til at de aller minste kan leke og lære og at de som trenger en hjelpende hånd får en hverdag preget av mestring, mening og verdighet. Vi gjør et bredt spekter av arbeidsoppgaver, og felles for oss alle er at vi får tillit og myndighet til å påvirke vår egen arbeidshverdag for å skape et samfunn som er godt å leve i. Hos oss kan du bli med og sette spor. 

 

Etter søknadsfristens utløp vil det utarbeides offentlig søkerliste. Ber du om å bli unntatt fra denne listen, må det grunngis i søknadsportalen. Begrunnelsen vil bli vurdert i forhold til offentlighetsloven § 25, jfr §11. Hvis ditt ønske ikke imøtekommes, vil du få mulighet til å trekke søknaden før offentliggjøring.

 

Før ansettelse i Bærum kommune skal identitet dokumenteres og oppholdstillatelse være gyldig.
