jobs.title: ASRO: Project Manager, space radiation instrument projects
jobs.description:
**Type**: Full-time, permanent

**Location**: Lemminkäisenkatu 46, 20520 Turku

**Application deadline**: 13.10.2026

Are you ready to take ownership of technically demanding space projects and work closely with customers from development to delivery and beyond? Join ASRO and help bring Finnish space technology to customers around the world!

**Your role with us**

As a **Project Manager** at Aboa Space Research (ASRO), you will take responsibility for projects within ASROs space weather business area. Your focus will be on space radiation instruments, with several ongoing projects ranging from instrument deliveries to concept studies. You can read more about ASROs space weather monitoring solutions here.

You will independently manage typically one to three projects at a time, coordinating the work of multidisciplinary engineering teams and keeping schedules, deliverables, resources, and stakeholders aligned. You will follow project progress, make sure agreed actions move forward, and keep customers up to date throughout the project. Depending on the project, your work may range from managing straightforward instrument deliveries to coordinating more exploratory development where the technical solution is still taking shape.

Your role will also extend beyond traditional project management. You will work closely with customers, ESA, subcontractors and ASROs multidisciplinary engineering teams, with opportunities to contribute to systems engineering and technical development. As projects move from development to delivery, you may also continue working with customers around instrument data and future needs, as well as identify opportunities for follow-up projects. The exact scope can be shaped around your background and strengths.

**What makes you a great fit?**

You have experience managing technical projects and are comfortable taking ownership of complex projects involving both engineering teams and external customers. A technical background helps you understand what is happening beneath the project plan and work effectively with specialists across different disciplines.

At the same time, you are not looking for a narrowly defined Project Manager role. ASRO is a small and evolving company, and you are motivated by the opportunity to contribute where your expertise creates the most value. Depending on your strengths and wishes, in the future your role can also develop towards technical product ownership, broader project portfolio project management responsibilities, or a more customer-facing and commercial direction.

**We hope you have:**

- A Masters or PhD degree in engineering, natural sciences, or another relevant technical field

- Ideally, plus five years of relevant professional experience, including experience in project management or technical project environments

- Experience taking ownership of projects and coordinating multidisciplinary technical teams

- A strong technical understanding and the ability to work effectively with engineering specialists and customers

- Good English skills and confidence working with different internal and external stakeholders


**We consider as an asset:**

- Experience from the space industry, space instrumentation or other demanding technology environments

- Knowledge of radiation effects, detection technologies, embedded software or data-related solutions

- Experience from product development, product ownership, or bringing technical products into production

- Experience working in a smaller technology company or in customer-facing engineering projects

- Finnish language skills


**What ASRO offers you?**

- Take ownership of ambitious space projects where you can directly influence how projects and customer relationships develop.

- Work with space radiation technology across instrument development, deliveries and emerging data-driven services.

- Use your technical expertise beyond project management, with opportunities to contribute to systems engineering and product development.

- Shape your role in a small organization with minimal hierarchy as ASROs products, customers and business continue to develop.

- Flexible working methods and the possibility of partial remote work

- Healthcare insurance as an employment benefit


**Practicalities**

This is a permanent, full-time role, and you will be employed directly by ASRO. The position is based at ASROs office in Turku, and regular on-site presence is important for close collaboration with the project teams. Partial remote work is also possible. The role includes occasional travel to customers and other project stakeholders, typically a few trips per year depending on the projects.

Salary ranges between 4000–6500 €/month, with the final salary determined based on your experience and expertise and your readiness to take independent ownership of space radiation instrument projects. We are also happy to hear about your salary expectations.

**Recruitment process**

- Initial phone interviews with aTalent

- On-site interviews with ASRO


**Interested? Apply now!**

Please submit your CV and motivation letter in PDF-format in English by latest 13th of October via our application system here: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/386702/create/. In your motivation letter, we would especially like to hear what interested you in this role and ASRO, which aspects of your background and expertise you feel are particularly relevant to the position, and how you would like to develop or shape the role going forward.

Remember to use the application system, we do not accept applications by email. We want to ensure that all applicants can participate in the process equally, and we will take individual accessibility needs into account where necessary. For more information about ASRO, visit **https://asro.fi/**. For details about the profile & recruitment process, contact Senior Recruitment Consultant Sofia Latva-Koivisto (+358 50 321 4473, sofia.latva-koivisto(at)atalent.fi). If Im unable to answer your call right away, please leave a text message and Ill get back to you as soon as I can.

jobs.title: Psychiatrist wanted for position in adult psychiatry in Southern Norway
jobs.description:
On behalf of a well-established outpatient clinic in Southern Norway, we are recruiting a specialist psychiatrist for a permanent role in adult psychiatry.

You will become part of a competent interdisciplinary team in a region known for its mild climate and friendly communities.

 

Your role

  • Assessment, diagnosis, and treatment of adult patients with psychiatric conditions
  • Active participation in interdisciplinary collaboration and treatment planning
  • Supervision of junior doctors and contribution to internal training
  • Engagement in the clinic’s development and professional improvements

Qualifications

  • European medical authorization and specialist certification in psychiatry
  • Fluent in English and motivated to learn Norwegian (language training will be provided)
  • Broad competence in adult psychiatry and ability to work independently

The clinic offers

  • A permanent position in a stable and well-functioning outpatient unit
  • An interdisciplinary team with skilled and supportive colleagues
  • Flexible working hours and opportunities for extended shifts with extra pay
  • Access to professional courses, seminars, and specialist development days
  • Possibility to take part in acute care rotation (optional, extra pay)
  • Secure pension and insurance schemes via KLP

Why Southern Norway?

 

Southern Norway (Sørlandet) combines modern healthcare infrastructure with a high quality of life. The region is family-friendly, with good schools, kindergartens and accessible housing.

With a milder climate than most other parts of Norway, Sørlandet is especially known as a popular holiday destination during summer, attracting both Norwegians and international visitors to its charming towns and cultural scene. At the same time, the region offers a relaxed pace of life year-round, with plenty of opportunities for outdoor activities, sports and cultural events.

 

International airports and proximity to Oslo, make it easy to stay connected with the rest of Europe. You can read more about the area at Visit Southern Norway.

 

Benefits with Dignus Medical 

  • Free online Norwegian language course tailored to medical professionals
  • Personalized follow-up throughout the recruitment process
  • Comprehensive relocation support for you and your family (housing, schools, kindergartens, etc.)
  • Guidance on paperwork and authorization procedures

Interested?

 

Take the first step towards a new career and lifestyle in Norway. Contact us for a confidential and informal chat!

 

You can also register your CV or sign up for our newsletter to stay updated on future opportunities. 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. **Main responsibilities**

- Own and continuously develop CMDB and CSDM governance, standards and operating models.

- Ensure CMDB data quality, ownership, accountability and lifecycle management.

- Drive consistent modelling of services, applications and technology according to CSDM principles.

- Monitor CMDB health and CSDM maturity, leading improvements and remediation.

- Act as a CMDB and CSDM subject-matter expert for IT and business stakeholders.

- Lead selected service management processes, including documentation, implementation, training and continuous improvement.

- Promote harmonized ITSM processes and improvements through AI, automation, integrations and better data sources.


**Position requirements**

- Relevant academic degree or equivalent qualifications.

- At least 3–4 years of ServiceNow experience, including extensive hands-on CMDB work and practical CSDM implementation experience.

- ITIL 4 Foundation certification or equivalent IT Service Management experience; knowledge of Scrum or DevOps is an advantage.

- Strong analytical, process-design and leadership skills, with the ability to operate in a matrix organization.

- Fluent English and excellent communication, facilitation and relationship-building skills.


**What we offer**

- An international, diverse and collaborative working environment

- A flexible 50/50 hybrid working model

- Competitive salary and benefits (personel fund, ePassi etc.)


The position can be based at any main Outokumpu location in Europe. Some travel, primarily within Europe, may be required.

jobs.title: Customer Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Secappin kasvun ja kansainvälistymisen myötä haemme osaavaa ja kokenutta **Customer Operations Manageria** vahvistamaan joukkoamme. Työskentelypaikkakuntasi voi olla Helsinki, Jyväskylä tai Kuopio.

Haluatko merkityksellisen työn, jossa sinulla on tärkeä rooli? Secapp on kasvanut jo 15 vuotta peräkkäin ja haemme kasvun seuraavaan vaiheeseen uutta kollegaa, jolla on halu kehittää toimintaa ja kyky uudistaa toimintamalleja moderneilla työtavoilla ja ratkaisuilla. Arvostamme kiinnostustasi ja käytännön ymmärrystäsi siitä, miten AI:ta ja automaatiota voidaan hyödyntää oman työn ja prosessien kehittämisessä.

Sytytkö myös kouluttamisesta, asiakaskohtaamisista, teknisestä ongelmanratkaisusta ja asiakkaiden haasteiden taklaamisesta? Tässä roolissa yhdistyvät After Sales -tiimimme Technical Supportin ja Customer Successin monipuoliset tehtävät. Käytännön työn kautta pääset aktiivisesti kehittämään toimintatapoja yhdessä tiimin kanssa. Tavoitteenamme on löytää ratkaisuja, joissa tekoäly, automaatio ja toimivat prosessit helpottavat asiantuntijoidemme työtä ja auttavat toimintaamme skaalautumaan kasvun mukana.

**Aitoa tekemisen meininkiä ja osaamisen iloa**

Olet kokenut osaaja, jolla on oma-aloitteinen ja proaktiivinen työote sekä halu kantaa vastuuta ja viedä asioita määrätietoisesti eteenpäin. Arvostamme kokemuksesi mukana tuomaa näkemystä ja toivomme, että tuot aktiivisesti uusia ajatuksia ja parhaita käytäntöjä myös tiimimme käyttöön. Asiakastyössä pääset olemaan mukana käyttöönotoista ja käytön kehittämisestä aina haastavampien teknisten ongelmatilanteiden ratkaisemiseen.

Työpäiväsi sisältää:

- Haastavampien asiakastilanteiden ratkaisemista yhdessä tiimin, tuotekehityksen ja muiden teknisten asiantuntijoidemme kanssa

- Käyttöönottojen suunnittelua ja toteuttamista

- Asiakkaiden kouluttamista Secappin käyttöön parhaiden toimintatapojen mukaisesti

- Asiakkaiden teknisten tukipyyntöjen ja ongelmatilanteiden selvittämistä ja ratkaisemista sekä asiakkaiden tarpeiden kartoittamista sekä aktiivista lisämyyntiä

- Asiakkuuksien hoitoa

- Integraatioihin, käyttäjähallintaan ja asiakkaiden teknisiin ympäristöihin liittyvien asioiden ratkaisemista

- Dokumentaation, tukiprosessien ja käyttöönottokäytäntöjen jatkuvaa kehittämistä sekä työn sujuvoittamista AI:n, automaation ja muiden työkalujen avulla.


Odotamme sinulta:

- Kaupallista suuntautuneisuutta ja aiempaa kokemusta esimerkiksi SaaS-palveluiden käyttöönotoista, kouluttamisesta, teknisestä konsultoinnista tai muista asiakasrajapinnan teknisistä asiantuntijatehtävistä.

- Vahvaa ongelmanratkaisukykyä, teknistä ymmärrystä sekä kykyä ottaa haastavia asiakastilanteita hoitaaksesi.

- Erinomaisia vuorovaikutus- ja esiintymistaitoja, sillä asiakkaiden kanssa työskentely on merkittävä osa arkeasi. Osaat keskustella luontevasti niin asiakkaiden kuin teknisten asiantuntijoidenkin kanssa.

- Järjestelmällistä ja oma-aloitteista työskentelytapaa. Pystyt toimimaan systemaattisesti myös silloin, kun pöydällä on useampia asioita samanaikaisesti.

- Teknistä uteliaisuutta, ongelmanratkaisukykyä ja halua oppia uutta. Aiempi kokemus integraatioista, REST API -rajapinnoista, käyttäjähallinnasta tai esimerkiksi SSO-, AD- ja Entra ID -ympäristöistä auttaa sinua pääsemään tehtävässä nopeasti vauhtiin, mutta kaikkea ei tarvitse osata valmiiksi.

- Sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa niin suullisesti kuin kirjallisesti.

- Kykyä hyödyntää AI-työkaluja sujuvasti omassa työssäsi sekä kiinnostusta tunnistaa uusia tapoja, joilla tekoälyä voidaan hyödyntää asiakastyössä ja toimintamme kehittämisessä.

- Tehtävään soveltuvaa koulutusta (esim. IT-, tekninen tai kaupallinen koulutus) tai vastaavaa osaamista, jonka olet hankkinut työkokemuksen kautta.

- Matkustusvalmiutta tarvittaessa


**Ehtaa suunnan näyttämistä**

Tässä työssä pääset moneen mukaan, joten tarvitset kykyä priorisoida ja pitää langat käsissäsi. Roolissa käytännön asiakastyö ja toiminnan kehittäminen kulkevat rinnakkain. Tunnistat yhdessä tiimin kanssa kehityskohteita, kehität toimintatapojamme ja viet parannuksia käytäntöön vaiheittain. Huolehdit omalta osaltasi siitä, että asiakkaidemme asiat etenevät laadukkaasti korkea palvelutasomme huomioiden. Työsi tukena on osaava joukko eri alojen ammattilaisia, ja pääset aidosti vaikuttamaan siihen, miten teemme asioita Secappilla. Meillä kaveria ei jätetä: autamme toisiamme ja työskentelemme yhdessä kohti yhteisiä onnistumisia ja tavoitteita.

Kokeneena asiantuntijana pystyt työskentelemään itsenäisesti, hahmottamaan laajoja kokonaisuuksia sekä ottamaan vastuuta asiakkuuksien hoitamisesta ja asioiden edistämisestä. Tunnistat aktiivisesti tapoja kehittää asiakaskokemusta, tukiprosesseja, dokumentaatiota ja toimintamalleja – ja olet valmis viemään parannuksia myös käytäntöön. Pääset vaikuttamaan myös nykyaikaisten koulutusmenetelmien ja -sisältöjen kehittämiseen.

**Tarjoamme sinulle:**

- Monipuolisen asiantuntijaroolin, jossa pääset yhdistämään asiakastyön, teknisen ongelmanratkaisun, kouluttamisen ja toiminnan kehittämisen

- Mielenkiintoisen, merkityksellisen ja vastuullisen työtehtävän, jossa pääset hyödyntämään aiempia oppejasi laaja-alaisesti

- Mahdollisuuden vahvistaa osaamistasi tekoälyn ja automaation hyödyntämisessä osana käytännön asiantuntijatyötä.

- Vakituisen työn. Työ alkaa sopimuksen mukaan

- Monipuolisia henkilöstöetuja, koska olet meille tärkeä. Haluamme tukea työntekijöiden hyvinvointia, viihtymistä sekä ammatillista kehittymistä monin tavoin.

- Ajanmukaiset työvälineet ja hybridityömallin. Työskentelemme säännöllisesti myös toimistolla mutta työtä voi tehdä välillä myös etänä. Työpaikkasi voi sijaita Helsingissä, Jyväskylässä tai Kuopiossa.


**Kiinnostuitko?**

**Seuraavat askeleet**

jobs.title: Senior Embryologist for a Private Fertility Clinic in Aarhus
jobs.description:
Would you like to work as an embryologist at a private fertility clinic in Aarhus, where you will have supportive colleagues, sufficient time to perform your work and a high degree of influence?

We are looking for a skilled embryologist to join our clinic in Aarhus. You will become part of a multidisciplinary team united by a shared passion for making a difference to our patients.

About the position

The clinic is open five to seven days a week throughout the year. Many of our patients come from abroad, although we also treat a considerable number of Danish patients. We offer a full range of treatments within IUI, IVF/ICSI, egg donation and ROPA.

We are a straightforward and informal workplace guided by the principle of freedom with responsibility. Sellmer Klinik Aarhus is owned by Anette Sellmer, who forms the clinic's management team together with Clinic Manager Bodil Meldgaard. Our management is visible and committed and delegates responsibility to employees who thrive on it.

We place our patients and a positive working environment at the heart of everything we do. This means, among other things, that you will have sufficient time to carry out your duties properly and will be expected to take an active part in developing and implementing new ideas.

he laboratory team performs tasks including:

IVF and ICSI

Embryo transfer

Thawing and cryopreservation of oocytes and blastocysts

AHA

Sperm preparation and cryopreservation

Assessment of oocytes

Administrative duties, including tasks related to the export of tissues and cells

Your colleagues

We have an excellent working environment and work very well together across professional disciplines. We respect and make use of each other's expertise while keeping up with developments in the field and continuously improving our overall professional standards.

We also have a strong social community. We eat lunch together every day, enjoy spending time together and occasionally meet outside working hours. We value our positive working environment highly and make a genuine effort to protect it. It is therefore important to us that our new colleague feels at home and fits well within the team.

About you

You are a qualified embryologist.

You have experience within fertility treatment.

You enjoy working collaboratively with colleagues on patient-related tasks while also being comfortable working independently.

You speak and write Danish and English.

You are able to work 28-37 hours per week, including weekends and public holidays as part of a fixed rota.

We offer

A workplace with strong collegial support and professional sparring as part of a close multidisciplinary team. You can expect:

Sufficient time to carry out your daily duties and a high degree of influence

Opportunities for professional and personal development

Friendly and positive colleagues

An organisation with a short path from decision to action

The terms of employment will depend on your experience and qualifications. Employment is conditional upon your consent to the clinic obtaining a satisfactory child protection certificate and upon holding the required professional authorisation.

For further information about the position, please contact Bodil Meldgaard at bodil@sellmerklinik.dk.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Specialist/Consultant in Neurology looking for job opportunities in Denmark
jobs.description:
Newly Created Position at Mid- and West Zealand Hospital for an Emergency Neurology Profile in Partnership with Rigshospitalet, The University Hospital of Copenhagen.

We are expanding our team of specialists at Mid- and West Zealand Hospital, Denmark as we develop a new emergency neurology profile. You will have a direct professional influence on our future emergency services and become part of a new, close partnership with Rigshospitalet.

Why choose us?

Help shape the emergency services of the future: You will play a central role in developing and launching our upcoming emergency neurology profile (without a thrombolysis service).
New partnership with Rigshospitalet: The collaboration will open opportunities for professional exchange, knowledge sharing and research. For those interested, there will also be opportunities for attractive split appointments (e.g. one day per week at Rigshospitalet).
New professional opportunities from 1 January 2027: As a result of the healthcare reform in Denmark, we will take over specialised rehabilitation from the municipalities, creating exciting opportunities for professional development.
Scope for your subspecialty: Whether your interests lie in MS, movement disorders, headache, dementia, epilepsy or rehabilitation, we will adapt the framework to allow you to pursue your area of expertise.
A strong research environment: We focus on patients with multimorbidity and have our own Professor of Neurology. Research is primarily focused on multiple sclerosis.
Your profile

You are a specialist/consultant in neurology, whether you are newly qualified and eager to develop your skills or an experienced colleague looking for a new professional setting.

We imagine that you:

Are passionate about multidisciplinary collaboration and want to help shape the quality of the new emergency setup.
Value a strong professional network across hospitals.
Appreciate the opportunity to provide clinical guidance and supervision to our junior doctors.
Are decisive, flexible and actively contribute to our positive working environment and pioneering spirit.

Your working day and responsibilities

Our department provides primary-level neurological services in the hospital at Slagelse (inpatient ward for phase II rehabilitation, primarily for apoplexy cases, as well as specialist clinics), and in the hospital of Naestved, where we run the Centre for Neurorehabilitation (CNN), which provides services at regional level.

Your responsibilities will include:

Working in our outpatient department, specialist clinics or the interdisciplinary Memory Clinic, in collaboration with geriatricians, psychiatrists and neuropsychologists.
Supervising junior doctors and participating in the multidisciplinary environment across our hospital sites.
On-call duties: Our consultants currently cover the senior on-call function on site until 9.00 pm, followed by an on-call-from-home arrangement (there is junior on-call doctor is present on site around the clock).
About the department

Neurology is part of a combined department (Medicine 3 and Department of Physio- and Occupational Therapy) that works closely and efficiently alongside the Department of Geriatrics. We place a strong emphasis on professional dialogue and peer support within a group of doctors characterised by strong collegial relationships and a shared desire to develop the specialty.

Mid- and West Zealand Hospital is located around 60 min. by car from central Copenhagen.

Practical information and application

The seven medical roles: Your application should address the seven medical competencies specifically, supported by the best possible documentation.
Interests: If you have specific wishes regarding subspecialisation or are interested in a split appointment with Rigshospitalet, we would be pleased if you mention this in your application.

Relocation Assistance and Danish Language Tutoring

When you relocate to Denmark in connection with your employment, we offer free, professional assistance with relocation and settling in, either close to the hospital or anywhere on Zealand you might prefer. You will receive help with everything from finding accommodation to registration and arrangements for any accompanying family members.

An important part of working as a doctor in Denmark is communication between you and your patients and colleagues. For patient safety reasons, Region Zealand therefore requires our doctors to have a satisfactory level of Danish language proficiency. We therefore provide a language teacher for one-to-one tuition, enabling you to communicate with your patients as quickly as possible at a level where you can understand one another.

This means, that we expect you to be prepared to devote time to learning Danish, both spoken and written as part of your employment.

Find out more about what kind of assistance we offer, as well as watch interviews with other doctors that have relocated to Region Zealand at www.medicaljobsdenmark.com.

Would you like to know more?

You are very welcome to contact Chief Physician Benedikte Wanscher on mobile +45 93 57 62 51 or by email at bewa@regionsjaelland.dk for an informal and confidential conversation about the position.

Please upload your application and CV as soon as possible. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis.

jobs.title: Responsable Approvisionnement Biomasse H/F
jobs.description:
MISSIONS :
- Rédige et tient à jour les procédures concernant la mobilisation sur chantier de défriche agricole, urbaine ou forestière, de récupération de connexes de scieries, de bois en fin de vie ou autre sourcing biomasse,
- Assure la prospection et la recherche de fournisseurs/ sous traitant de biomasse ou transporteur de biomasse,
- Pilote le choix, la négociation, et la contractualisation des achats de biomasse ou de gestion de chantiers de défriches ou forestiers en concertation avec sa direction,
- Soumet à sa direction les choix d'achats de biomasse,
- A un œil vigilant sur la conformité réglementaire de l'origine de la biomasse en lien avec sa direction,
- Planifie et organise les livraisons de biomasse (hebdomadaire, mensuel, annuel) pour assurer un approvisionnement permettant le fonctionnement de la ou des centrales en production,
- Planifie, contrôle et coordonne les activités d'exploitation forestières (abattage, débardage, broyage, transport, stockage) pour les chantiers de l'équipe de mobilisation,
- Organise les opérations de stockage/déstockage sur parc de rupture le cas échéant,
- Suit les contrats en communication permanente avec la responsable de parc à bois,
- Informe le Responsable de parc en cas de difficultés d'approvisionnement ou de changement de volume livré au jour le jour pour permettre la coordination appro/réception,
- Réalise les calculs de coût de biomasse réel/ chantier,
- Programme et organise les chantiers de défriche selon une stratégie définie et validé par la direction,
- Recherche des solutions à toutes situations problématiques rencontrées sur le terrain ou avec les parties prenantes en créant de nouvelle procédure au besoin.
- Fais de chaque expérience une analyse permettant d'améliorer les procédures dans l'ensemble.

PILOTAGE FINANCIER ET ADMINISTRATIF DE L'APPROVISIONNEMENT BIOMASSE :
- S'assure du respect des objectifs budgétaires fixés par la direction Providex et des objectifs d'approvisionnement de biomasse, il engage et suit les commandes de biomasse auprès des fournisseurs en concertation avec la direction,
- Tient à jours les indicateurs de coûts sur la biomasse en concertation avec la responsable de parc à bois qui suit la réception de la biomasse,
- Analyse les indicateurs, pointe les écarts et dysfonctionnements, propose des solutions à la direction.

jobs.title: Data and AI Lead for Corporate Sustainability
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about data and AI technology — and excited by the opportunity to turn them into real-world sustainability impact?

Were looking for an ambitious and innovative Data & AI professional to work with us in the intersection of AI and corporate sustainability. Youll play a key role as an AI ambassador in building data & AI performance across our business units, from sustainability SaaS and data & AI products to the consultancy business.

If you want to work where data, AI technology, and sustainability meet — and help shape what comes next — wed love to hear from you.

The role

Were looking for a talented and forward-thinking Data & AI Engineer to help shape the next generation of AI-driven sustainability solutions at Ecobio.

Youll work with our data and AI capabilities end-to-end — from reliable data pipelines, integrations, APIs, and data foundations to machine learning, generative AI, and new AI-enabled products and services.

You are a member of our technology team, and you'll work with nature and sustainability experts, and sales to turn environmental and business challenges into scalable, impactful new solutions.

Beyond building technology, youll help shape and implement our AI strategy and practices, introduce emerging technologies, mentor colleagues, and act as an in-house ambassador for responsible and effective AI adoption.

In this role you will grow into technical owner of data and AI products.

At Ecobio, data and AI are tools for creating business value, solving environmental challenges, and protecting nature for future generations.



What you'll do with us

Build our data foundation — design and maintain data pipelines, integrations, APIs, master data, and data quality across our systems.

Develop new production-grade data and AI solutions — including machine learning, generative AI and taking solutions from prototypes to reliable, scalable SaaS features or specific products.

Leverage cloud and emerging technologies — your experience with Microsoft Azure and all related services highly valued. Experience with MLOps, Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD in Azure is considered a strong advantage. Experience from AWS or GCP is also relevant.

Enable trusted data and AI — ensuring our data, interfaces, and AI solutions are reliable, governed, and ready for use by customers and our own experts.

Drive automation and innovation — automate data-intensive processes and continuously explore new ways to apply data and AI.

Collaborate with customers and sustainability colleagues — work with product, development, sustainability, and commercial teams to turn needs into technical solutions.
Grow AI capabilities across Ecobio — share knowledge, mentor colleagues as an AI ambassador, and help advance our responsible and ethical use of AI.


What we hope you bring

* University-level education in data engineering or computer science.

* Understanding about modern AI and agentic products.

* Hands-on several years experience with AI/ML or data solutions (idea to production).

* Data engineering experience including ETL, data lakes, master data and data quality.

* Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure.

* A learning and innovative mindset — you actively follow developments in data technology and AI.

* A product and customer mindset — you enjoy turning technical capabilities into reliable solutions that create value for customers.

* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with confidence working with technical and sustainability colleagues.

* Fluent professional English.

None can do all. If you are confident in any technical issues, and you are a quick learner, please contact us and apply.



What we offer

At Ecobio, youll join a multinational, multidisciplinary team where data technology, AI, and sustainability converge. Youll have the opportunity to grow as an engineer while playing a key role in shaping how data and AI create the future of our products and business.

We offer a full-time position on a skilled, growing team, with our office in Kamppi, Helsinki. We support flexible working hours and remote work, and offer benefits including sports and lunch benefits, as well as a phone benefit.

Your work would start as a key member in our innovative Business Finland project.

Lets work together!



Compensation

The salary range for this position will be discussed during the initial interview. It depends on your background and experience.



How to apply

Please send your application and CV (in Finnish or English) along with your salary expectations by October 15, 2026. We will begin conducting interviews during the application period.

toni.suominen(at)ecobio.fi

jobs.title: KAPELLAN I TILLER SOKN
jobs.description:
Tiller er en bydel sør i Trondheim, med store næringsarealer og en relativt ung befolkning. Syv av ti er medlemmer i Den norske kirke. Kunne du tenke deg å være prest blant dem?

Tiller er både bygd og by, en del av Trondheim, men også et eget lokalsamfunn med et mangfold av butikker, bedrifter og virksomheter. Tiller kirke, fra 1901, ligger vakkert til i bydelen, omgitt av en stor og velstelt kirkegård. Her er en rekke skoler for alle alderstrinn, blant annet Kristen videregående skole Trøndelag. I bydelen finnes også Birgittaklosteret, et buddhistisk tempel, et hindutempel og Jehovas Vitner. I det hele er Tiller en mangfoldig bydel med nesten 15000 innbyggere og mange arenaer for samarbeid og utvikling.

Tiller menighet ønsker å være et felleskap i folkekirken der alle kan føle seg hjemme, og der det er rom for å søke mening og dybde i livet. Det er to prester i en relativt stor stab, med kateket, menighetspedagog, diakon, kantor, daglig leder og kirketjener, som holder til i kontorer på Menighetssenteret sentralt plassert i bydelen. Huset rommer også en åpen barnehage som drives i samarbeid med menigheten. I Tiller tilbys ulike aktiviteter for alle aldersgrupper: gudstjenester, småsprell, tweens, menighetstreff, KFUK-KFUM-speidergruppe, familiemiddag, formiddagstreff, vaffeltorsdag og kirkekor. Det er god oppslutning om dåp og konfirmasjon, med om lag 100 konfirmanter årlig. Den nye kapellanen vil ha et særskilt fokus på menighetens barn og unge. Oppgavene er varierte og du som søker vil få rom til å utforske hvilke av dine kvaliteter som passer best inn i helheten. Det er utstrakt og godt samarbeid i Kirkelig fellesråd i Trondheim og prostiet, på tvers av soknegrenser og bydeler.

Som ny prest blir du også del av et flott arbeidskollegium i Trondheim prosti, som dekker et område med om lag 175.000 av Trondheims innbyggere. Prostiet har 13 sokn og 27 prester. Det betyr et allsidig og robust prestekollegium i ett tjenesteområde, som innbyr til faglig utveksling og gode samarbeidsprosjekter.  I Trondheim har vi by-omfattende tilbud innen retreat, kurs og samtalegrupper og konfirmanttreff mm. Vi har kontekstuelle utviklingsprosjekter som Barnas katedral, U-kirke, Grønn katedral og Frivillighetsprosjekt, som kan inspirere og gi rom for differensierte tjenester som prest i byen.
Prestene har månedlige samlinger, tilbud om ukentlig tekstverksted, og fagdager i byen og bispedømmet. Trondheim er, med Nidarosdomen sentralt plassert, et senter for pilegrimsteologi og forvaltning av Olavsarv og olsokfeiring i Den norske kirke, og den kirkelige aktiviteten er utforskende og variert. Sørsamisk kirkeliv og nasjonaljubileet 2030 er et særlig ansvar i bispedømmet.

For mer informasjon: Se hjemmesidene til Trondheim kirkelige fellesråd, menigheten, Nidaros bispedømme og til Trondheim kommune når det gjelder bydelen.


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Kapellanen må påregne alle oppgaver i henhold til Tjenesteordning for menighetsprester.
  • Tjenesten er regulert gjennom arbeidsplaner og samarbeid med andre prester i prostiet.
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Søkere må fylle vilkårene i henhold til "Kvalifikasjonskrav for tilsetting som menighetsprest", jfr. § 3 i Tjenesteordning for menighetsprester.
  • Ved tilsetting blir det tatt forbehold om at den som tilsettes kan fremlegge tilfredsstillende politiattest.
  • Målformen i soknene er bokmål. Søkere må opplyse om de behersker begge målformer.
Personlige egenskaper

Vi søker en prest som:

  • vil bidra til gode samarbeidsforhold, trivsel og engasjement
  • vil bygge levende fellesskap rundt gudstjenester og kirkelige aktiviteter
  • ønsker å utforske mulighetene som ligger i møte med menighetens barn og unge
  • har sansen for at det er mange forskjellige arbeidsoppgaver i en menighet. 
Vi tilbyr
  • Stillingen er plassert i kode 0922 Kapellan. Lønnsfastsettelse skjer etter dokumentert krav om godskriving av ansiennitet.  
  • Medlemskap i offentlig pensjonsordning (KLP).
  • Bispedømmet har godt utbygde personaltiltak, herunder arbeidsveiledning.
*************************************************
Nidaros bispedømme skal være en arbeidsplass med rom og respekt for mangfold, uavhengig av etnisitet, alder, kjønnsidentitet, funksjonsevne og legning. Vi oppfordrer derfor alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke.

Tilsetting skjer på de vilkår som til enhver tid gjelder og den som tilsettes må rette seg etter følgende:
a) endring i lover, tariffavtaler, reglement m.v. herunder spørsmål vedrørende tjenesteordning og beredskapsordning.
b) avgjørelser som kan influere på tjenestens gjøremål.

Søkerne gjøres oppmerksom på at de kan bli ført opp på den offentlige søkerlisten, selv om de ber om ikke å bli det.
Søknad sendes elektronisk via https://kirkejobb.no - Nidaros bispedømme

jobs.title: Lähihoitaja, Pispan kotihoito
jobs.description:
Pispan kotihoidon moniammatillisen työyhteisömme yhteinen tavoite on tarjota asiakkaillemme laadukasta hoitoa ja tukea heidän omannäköistä arkeaan kotona. Hyödynnämme työssämme aktiivisesti hyvinvointiteknologiaa ja kehitämme kotihoidon palveluja yhdessä. Kotihoidon tavoitteena on edistää asiakkaan kokonaisvaltaista perusturvallisuutta, kuntoutumista sekä arjessa selviytymistä. Pitkät hoitosuhteet ovat arvokkaitta sekä asiakkaille että hoitajille.

Lähihoitajana teet tärkeää työtä kohdatessasi asiakkaan hänen omassa kodissaan ja mahdollistamalla hänen selviytymisensä arjessa. Työsi on itsenäistä, liikkuvaa ja päivät ovat erilaisia. Kotihoidossa tehtäviisi kuuluu mm. lääkehoito, kirjaaminen sekä muut monipuoliset ja ihmisläheiset hoito- ja hoivatyöt. Jokapäiväisessä käytössämme on myös työtä tukevaa teknologiaa, kuten lääkeautomaatteja ja kuvapuhelimia.

Miksi hakea meille?
Saat meillä hyvän perehdytyksen sekä tuen työkavereilta ja esihenkilöltä.
Pystyt vaikuttamaan omiin työvuoroihisi, jotta vapaa-ajan ja työn yhdistäminen olisi mutkatonta.
Tarjoamme hyvät työsuhde-edut kuten vuosittaisen liikunta-, kulttuuri-, työmatka- ja hyvinvointiedun Epassilla, työnantajan lounasedun ja tyhy- sekä Virkisty Vapaalla ry:n toimintaa.

Millaista osaajaa etsimme?
Olet nimikesuojattu lähihoitaja (sosiaalihuolto).
Puhut ja kirjoitat sujuvasti suomea.
Sinulla on B-luokan ajokortti, auton käyttömahdollisuus katsotaan eduksi. Käytössämme on leasing-autoja ja sähköpyöriä helpottamaan kulkemista asiakaskohteidemme välillä.
Sinulla on LOVe - lääkehoidon verkkotesti suoritettuna hyväksytysti (LOVe LOP, PKV, KIPU1, GER 1). Tarvittaessa voit suorittaa lääkehoidon osaamisen myös työpaikalla, heti työsuhteen alussa.
Katsomme eduksi aiemman työkokemuksen kotihoidosta sekä RAI-osaamisen.
Sinulla on hyvät työyhteisötaidot, toimit oma-aloitteisesti ja joustavasti.

Aloitus vakituisessa tehtävässä sopimuksen mukaan. Koeaika on kuusi kuukautta. Työaika on kokoaikatyö, keskimäärin 38 tuntia 15 minuuttia viikossa. Työhön sisältyy aamu- ja iltavuoroja. Tehtävään valitun on esitettävä rikosrekisterilain 6 §:n 4 momentin mukainen rikosrekisteriote ennen työsuhteen alkamista. Suosittelemme vahvasti tartuntatautilain (1227/2016) 48 §:n mukaista rokotesuojaa.

Jätä rohkeasti hakemuksesi ja liity Pispan rempseään ja huumorilla höystettyyn osaavaan tiimiin, joka ottaa avoimesti vastaan uusia työntekijöitä! Haastatteluun kutsuttaviin hakijoihin olemme yhteydessä henkilökohtaisesti.

Center for Pædagogik i Roskilde søger en adjunkt eller lektor til en fast stilling med henblik på at planlægge, gennemføre og evaluere undervisning på pædagoguddannelsen samt efter- og videreuddannelsesforløb. Vi søger en underviser, som kan styrke centerets kompetencer indenfor e-læring og digitale læringsformer. Det er et centralt krav, at du har erfaring med udvikling og gennemførelse af digitale læringsforløb. Derudover skal du kunne undervise på tværs af pædagoguddannelsens tre specialiseringer: dagtilbud, skole/fritid samt social- og specialpædagogik.

På Professionshøjskolen Absalon er det vores ambition at levere engagerende undervisning. Det er en del af vores uddannelsesløfte til de studerende, at du skal facilitere undervisning af høj kvalitet og samtidig brænde for at skabe læring og motivere de studerende. Det er vigtigt, at de studerende kan mærke deres uddannelse fra første dag. Det bidrager til en særlig uddannelseskultur, hvor du som underviser understøtter et fællesskab mellem de studerende, der bidrager til en samlet organisation, sætter de studerende først og har en stærk uddannelsesprofessionalisme.

Din profil
Du får en vigtig funktion i forhold til at undervise både på grunduddannelsen samt efter- og videreuddannelsesområdet. Det er derfor væsentligt, at du kan se dig selv i følgende:

Særlige faglige kompetencer. Vi lægger særligt vægt på, at du har solid erfaring med at udvikle, tilrettelægge og gennemføre e-læring og digitale læringsforløb samt dokumenterede kompetencer inden for digitale læringsdesigns, og digitale undervisnings- og vejledningsformer. Samtidig har du bred pædagogfaglig indsigt og har faglige forudsætninger for at undervise på tværs af pædagoguddannelsens tre specialiseringer: dagtilbud, skole/fritid samt social- og specialpædagogik. Vi ser gerne, at du kan dokumentere dine kompetencer gennem tidligere undervisnings-, udviklings- eller uddannelsesopgaver.

Praksiserfaring. Du har erfaring med at arbejde i pædagogiske praksisfelter indenfor dagtilbud, skole/fritid, social- og specialpædagogiske tilbud eller lignende. Du kan let supplere teoretisk stof med praksiseksempler, og du har flair for at inddrage de studerendes erfaringer som en naturlig del af undervisningen.

Didaktisk erfaring og kompetencer. Du står stærkt i mødet med studerende, hvor din undervisning bærer præg af variation, nærvær og engagement. Du kan facilitere og lede læreprocesser, og din undervisning bærer præg af at være varieret, nærværende og engagerende. Din tilgang til undervisningen er kendetegnet ved en ambition om inddragelse samt et højt fagligt niveau med øje for at skabe forskellige deltagelsesmuligheder for de studerende.

Stærke samarbejdsevner. Du er interesseret i at være en del af et læringsfællesskab, hvor undervisningen udvikles sammen med dine kolleger, og hvor faglig sparring er en fast bestanddel af hverdagen.

Fokus på kerneopgaven og gode studiemiljøer. Du har en høj faglighed, og du ser kerneopgaven som omdrejningspunktet for prioriteringen af dine arbejdsopgaver. Du kan derudover se dig selv bidrage til Absalons uddannelsesløfte, hvilket blandt andet indebærer at skabe inkluderende studiemiljøer.

Derudover forventer vi os, at:
  • du har en master-, kandidatuddannelse eller ph.d. relateret til det pædagogiske fagområde og/eller det social- og specialpædagogiske fagområde.

Dine arbejdsopgaver
Som underviser i Center for Pædagogik foregår dit arbejde inden for tre områder:

Grunduddannelsen. Du indgår i et team, der tilrettelægger og evaluerer undervisning og samarbejder om at udvikle kvaliteten i de moduler, du skal undervise på. Du kommer også til at arbejde på tværs af teams i forbindelse med overleveringer mellem moduler.

Efter- og videreuddannelsen. Du bliver en del af forskellige samarbejdskonstellationer omkring planlægning og gennemførelse af efter- og videreuddannelsesforløb. Du skal forvente at undervise flere forskellige steder i og uden for regionen og på Absalons andre lokationer. Det er derfor en fordel, at du har egen bil.

Forskning og udvikling. Du skal forvente at deltage i praksisnære og innovative forsknings- og udviklingsprojekter.

Du må forvente, at der i begrænset omfang kan forekomme undervisning til kl. 18.00 og om lørdagen.

Dine kolleger
Du bliver en del af Center for Pædagogik med omkring 140 medarbejdere fordelt på fem af Absalons campusser. Din primære arbejdsplads vil være på Campus Roskilde, der ligger i gåafstand fra Trekroner Station.

På pædagoguddannelsen i Roskilde er vi en dynamisk arbejdsplads med ca. 60 dygtige medarbejdere. Hver eneste dag arbejder vi sammen om at uddanne fremtidens pædagoger og gøre nuværende fagprofessionelle og ledere dygtigere.

Sådan ansøger du
  • Ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst på statens område.
  • For dig der er nyuddannet og ansættes som adjunkt, vil en forventet startløn være 40.994, - kr. inkl. pension. For dig der er en erfaren underviser og ansættes som lektor, vil en forventet startløn være 53.938 kr. inkl. pension. Alt efter erfaring og baggrund kan der evt. forhandles kvalifikationstillæg.
  • Stillingen er på fuld tid, og vi vil gerne have at du begynder senest den 1. december 2026.
  • Hvis du har nogle spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakte uddannelsesleder Jacob Guldager Søe på tlf. 7248 1482 eller uddannelsesleder Thue Friislund på tlf. 72 48 1486.
  • Ansøgning og relevante bilag sendes via vores rekrutteringssystem herhttps://phabsalon.dk/job-i-absalon/ledige-stillinger, eller ved at klikke på 'Søg stillingen' til højre på denne side senest mandag den 19. oktober klokken 12.00.
  • Vi forventer at holde 1. samtaler den 23. oktober og 2. samtaler den 26. oktober 2026.

Vi ønsker, at medarbejderstaben afspejler det omgivende samfund, og vi opfordrer derfor alle interesserede uanset køn, kulturel og etnisk baggrund til at søge stillingen.

Alt efter dine kvalifikationer vil du blive ansat som adjunkt eller lektor På Absalon er adjunkturet en 4-årig uddannelsesstilling. Det understøtter vi gennem Absalons lektorkvalificeringsforløb, som alle nyansatte adjunkter deltager i, og alle får tilknyttet en vejleder. For at blive ansat som lektor forudsætter det en positiv lektorbedømmelse inden for stillingstrukturens anvendelsesområde.

Ved ansættelse af lektorer der er lektorbedømt før 2013-stillingsstrukturen, sker ansættelse på hidtidige centralt fastsatte løn- og ansættelsesvilkår. Afhængig af dine kvalifikationer, afvejet med stillingens konkrete indhold, kan fornyet lektorbedømmelse efter den aktuelle stillingsstruktur (fast-track ordningen) eventuelt aftales. Læs mere her i kap. 5. https://www.retsinformation.dk/eli/lta/2020/673

Du kan læse mere om rammerne for ansættelse som adjunkt eller lektor i vores stillingsstruktur her. https://www.retsinformation.dk/eli/lta/2021/1458

Om Absalon
Professionshøjskolen Absalon er Region Sjællands største uddannelsesinstitution, hvor vi med vores 14 uddannelser uddanner mennesker, der med høj faglighed og professionalisme skaber værdi i det samfund, de er en del af. Vores uddannelser går tæt på den enkelte studerendes drømme og potentialer, tæt på den praksis de skal virke i og på de mennesker og fællesskaber, de skal gøre en mærkbar forskel for.

I en ny sjællandsk storregion er det afgørende at have blik for både de store linjer, det lokale og det nære. De mennesker, der uddanner sig på Absalon, løfter andre mennesker og skaber muligheder og udvikling dér, hvor de bor og arbejder.

Det er vores ambition at skabe praksisnære uddannelser af høj kvalitet og give de studerende de bedste forudsætninger for at udvikle sig til kompetente professionelle. Og vi vil styrke mulighederne for, at de kan skabe en karriere, der til enhver tid matcher deres faglige interesser og ambitioner - og det ansvar de tager i vores samfund.

Vi er 850 medarbejdere, vi har 8.000 studerende på vores grunduddannelser og vi efter- og videreuddanner 3.500 kursister hvert år.

jobs.title: D365FO System specialist, Helsinki
jobs.description:
Founded in 1909, Mehiläinen is a rapidly growing healthcare company that strongly invests in the possibilities of digitalisation and innovation. We are on a journey towards an ambitious goal: to be the leading healthcare company in Europe by 2030. Our growth story has already taken us to seven countries, as we are becoming the guiding star in rewiring European healthcare systems with digital- and AI solutions.

We are looking for a D365FO System specialist to join our Finance department in Helsinki, Kamppi.

As a D365FO System specialist, you will be part of our dynamic D365FO team, operating globally across the Mehiläinen Group. You will collaborate closely with finance colleagues and our IT department. Our team plays a crucial role in global finance system integration projects, providing essential support and adding value to our finance operations both in Finland and internationally. We are committed to developing and automating finance processes from a system perspective, striving to be a forerunner in leveraging AI and digitalization.

Key responsibilities
Actively participate in global D365FO system integration projects and implementations, representing the finance user perspective.
Contribute to developing and automating finance processes within D365FO and Power Platform, focusing on efficiency and usability.
Take part in defining requirements for new technical integrations in D365FO, together with IT and external consultants.
Provide support and guidance to finance teams in Finland and globally regarding D365FO functionalities.
Support testing, training and adoption of new D365FO features and processes among finance users.
Collaborate effectively with internal finance and IT teams, as well as external consultants.

Qualifications & experience
Work experience in finance, with hands-on experience using D365FO as a key user or in a similar role.
Experience participating in D365FO integration projects or system implementations is considered an advantage.
Good working knowledge of D365FO, alongside solid Excel skills
Familiarity with Power BI and Power Automate is considered an advantage.
Solid understanding of accounting and finance processes.
Interest in D365FO functionalities and integrations, even without deep technical or developer-level expertise.
Fluent English is required, Finnish is considered an advantage.
Relevant higher university degree (e.g., MSc Econ., MSc ICT).
The ability to work in a constantly changing environment across multiple development initiatives at the same time — you don't wait for ready-made assignments but identify development opportunities yourself and drive them forward.

Personal success factors
Self-driven and proactive — you take initiative and follow things through without waiting to be asked.
Curious mindset, eager to learn new technologies and processes.
Hands-on, can-do attitude, with strong project skills and a "get things done" approach.
Comfort with ambiguity — you stay adaptable and stress-tolerant in a dynamic environment.
Strong sense of ownership and accountability for quality and outcomes.
Collaborative spirit and excellent communication skills that bring out the best in the people around you.

Why join Mehiläinen?
We are all committed to acting in line with our values, and we believe the best results come from giving our experts responsibility, community and opportunities to grow. We offer you the opportunity to work with modern technologies and innovative solutions in a challenging, internationally oriented role, alongside a professional and supportive team.

Professional growth: excellent training opportunities and a strong commitment to personnel development.
Dynamic work environment: a hybrid work model, combining work from our modern office in Kamppi, Helsinki city centre, and the flexibility of home office.
Supportive culture: be part of a team with the best colleagues, fostering an inspiring work community.
Comprehensive benefits: versatile employee benefits focusing on health, exercise, and overall well-being.

Send your application via the link below by 14.10.2026. We review applications on a rolling basis and invite selected candidates to interview during the application period. Please note that we do not accept applications by email. Work starts per agreement.

Further Information:
Director of external accounting Jenni Immonen
jenni.immonen@mehilainen.fi

jobs.title: Tekniker / montør med flytteopgaver søges – deltid eller fuldtid
jobs.description:
Buchtrups Flytteforretning 2016 ApS

På grund af stigende aktivitet søger vi en dygtig og praktisk anlagt tekniker/montør, som har lyst til en alsidig hverdag med montage, demontering, tekniske opgaver og specialtransport.

Vores primære behov er en medarbejder til montage- og teknikeropgaver. Der vil også forekomme almindelige flytteopgaver, og derfor skal du være indstillet på at hjælpe til med flytning og fysisk arbejde, når opgaverne kræver det.

Stillingen kan være deltid eller fuldtid, afhængigt af dine ønsker, erfaring og kvalifikationer.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Montering og demontering af fitnessudstyr og træningsmaskiner

  • Samling, opstilling og justering af maskiner og teknisk udstyr

  • Nedtagning og klargøring af udstyr til transport

  • Indbæring og placering af maskiner og specialudstyr

  • Brug af almindeligt håndværktøj og elværktøj

  • Praktiske og tekniske opgaver hos vores erhvervskunder

  • Specialtransport og håndtering af tungt eller teknisk udstyr

  • Fejlfinding og mindre tekniske opgaver, hvor det er relevant

  • Flytteopgaver for private og erhvervskunder efter behov

  • Andre praktiske montage- og specialopgaver

Vi arbejder med mange forskellige typer opgaver og udstyr. Det kan eksempelvis være fitnessmaskiner, teknisk udstyr, maskiner, pengeskabe, klaverer, flygler og andet specialinventar.

Derfor er det vigtigt, at du er løsningsorienteret og ikke er bange for at tage fat.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Er praktisk anlagt og har god teknisk forståelse

  • Har erfaring med montage, teknik, mekanik eller lignende – eller stor interesse for området

  • Kan bruge almindeligt håndværktøj og elværktøj

  • Kan finde løsninger, når en opgave ikke altid går helt efter planen

  • Er omhyggelig og passer godt på kundernes maskiner og udstyr

  • Har god fysik og kan deltage i flytte- og løfteopgaver

  • Er mødestabil, fleksibel og ansvarsbevidst

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og sammen med kollegaer

  • Er serviceminded og kan kommunikere professionelt med vores kunder

  • Har kørekort B

Det er en fordel, hvis du har:

  • Erfaring som montør, servicetekniker, mekaniker eller lignende

  • Erfaring med fitnessmaskiner eller andet teknisk udstyr

  • Erfaring med flyttearbejde eller specialtransport

  • Kørekort C

  • Varebilschaufføruddannelsesbevis

Det er dog ikke et krav, at du kommer fra flyttebranchen.

Vi vægter teknisk forståelse, praktiske evner og den rette indstilling højt.

Vi tilbyder

  • Deltids- eller fuldtidsstilling

  • En alsidig arbejdsdag med hovedvægt på montage og tekniske opgaver

  • Oplæring i vores forskellige typer specialopgaver

  • Arbejde med mange forskellige maskiner og typer udstyr

  • Opgaver hos både mindre og større erhvervskunder

  • Mulighed for at udvikle dig inden for montage, teknik og specialtransport

  • Gode kollegaer og en uformel arbejdsplads

  • Ordentlige arbejdsforhold

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer

  • Mulighed for fastansættelse

Hvem leder vi efter?

Vi leder først og fremmest efter en tekniker/montør – ikke kun en traditionel flyttemand.

Du skal kunne lide at arbejde med hænderne, bruge værktøj og finde praktiske løsninger. Samtidig skal du være indstillet på, at vi er en flytte- og transportvirksomhed, og at der derfor også vil være dage, hvor du hjælper med almindelige flytteopgaver.

Hos Buchtrups Flytteforretning 2016 ApS er dagene forskellige. Den ene dag kan du demontere og montere fitnessmaskiner, og den næste dag kan du være med til at flytte og opstille tungt specialudstyr hos en erhvervskunde.

Kan du skrue, samle, montere og finde praktiske løsninger – og er du samtidig klar til at tage fat – så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Interesseret?

Send din ansøgning og CV til buchtrup2016@gmail.com.

Du er også velkommen til at kontakte os på 86 15 72 60, hvis du vil høre mere om jobbet.

Buchtrups Flytteforretning 2016 ApS

Arbejdstid: Deltid eller fuldtid
Kørekort: B (almindelig bil) – kørekort C er en fordel

jobs.title: Chief Commercial Officer
jobs.description:
About Memtrace

AI coding agents are fast, but they forget. They lose context between sessions, repeat mistakes, and don't understand the codebase around them. Memtrace builds the memory layer that fixes this: a deterministic knowledge graph of your code, built with AST parsing rather than guesswork, that any coding agent can use. Our products include MemDB, MemFleet, Cortex, and a code review engine. We are backed by Antler and Innovation Fund Denmark, and we work with Google, AWS, and Microsoft for Startups.

The role

You will own revenue end to end: strategy, pipeline, pricing, partnerships, and the first commercial team. We have developer interest and active pilots with enterprise customers. Your job is to turn that into repeatable, paying adoption. At this stage you will do the selling yourself while building the playbook that others will follow.

What you will do

  • Define and run the go-to-market motion: developers adopt, engineering leaders and budget-holders buy.

  • Own the revenue number and the pipeline. Run discovery, demos, pilots, and negotiations personally.

  • Convert pilots into contracts, with clear success criteria, pricing, and procurement paths.

  • Set pricing and packaging for individual, team, and enterprise tiers.

  • Build channel and ecosystem partnerships (cloud marketplaces, consultancies, industry bodies, AI-coding-tool vendors).

  • Feed customer and market insight back to product and research, and help decide what we build next.

  • Hire and lead the first commercial team (sales, solutions, customer success) when the time is right.

  • Report on pipeline, conversion, and retention to the founders and investors.

What we are looking for

  • 8+ years in B2B software sales or commercial leadership, with at least one role in developer tools, data/AI infrastructure, or open-source-led products.

  • A track record of closing enterprise deals yourself, ideally in the Nordics or wider Europe.

  • Experience selling to both technical champions and executive buyers, and knowing how those conversations differ.

  • Comfort with ambiguity: you have built a sales motion without an existing playbook, brand, or team.

  • Enough technical depth to talk credibly with engineers about codebases, CI/CD, and AI agents.

  • Strong written and spoken English; Danish or another Nordic language is a plus.

Nice to have

  • Experience with PLG, usage-based pricing, or open-core models.

  • Existing relationships with engineering leaders at Nordic enterprises.

  • Experience with EU procurement, security reviews, and data-residency requirements.

What we offer

  • A founding-team seat with real ownership of the commercial side of the company.

  • Direct influence on product, positioning, and company direction.

  • Hybrid work in Copenhagen, with a small and fast-moving team.

jobs.description:

jobs.title: Forskningsprojekt Arven i Landskabet
jobs.description:
Museum Odense søger en postdoc til en etårig stilling i forskningsprojektet Arven i Landskabet.

Forskningsprojektet

Det danske landskab står over for nogle af de største forandringer i nyere tid. Med Den Grønne Trepart og en række andre natur-, klima- og miljøtiltag skal store arealer i de kommende år ændre anvendelse. Landbrug, natur, biodiversitet, klima og lokale interesser skal finde nye balancer. Men det er ikke første gang, det danske landskab gennemgår en grundlæggende omstilling.

Arven i Landskabet undersøger det store brud i det danske landskabs udvikling ca. 1780-1914. I løbet af denne periode blev et varieret og mange steder ekstensivt udnyttet kulturlandskab forandret til et stadig mere intensivt landbrugslandskab. Gennem analyser af blandt andet historiske kort, nationale data og lokale kilder undersøger projektet, hvad der drev forandringerne, hvordan de udspillede sig forskelligt fra sted til sted, og hvilken betydning landskabets fysiske rammer, teknologiske muligheder, økonomiske interesser og menneskers valg havde.

Projektet stopper imidlertid ikke i 1914. Et centralt mål er at bringe den historiske viden i spil i den aktuelle grønne omstilling. Hvad kan tidligere tiders gennemgribende landskabsforandringer fortælle os om de processer, konflikter og muligheder, der præger omstillingen i dag? Og hvordan kan et langt historisk perspektiv kvalificere vores forståelse af de valg, der nu træffes om fremtidens landskab?

Projektet er støttet af Augustinus Fonden 2026-2029 og placeret på Museum Odense, Aarhus Universitet og Det Grønne Museum. Din arbejdsplads bliver på Museum Odense. Læs mere på https://museumodense.dk/forskningsartikler/arven-i-landskabet/.

Stillingen

Som postdoc får du en central rolle i den del af Arven i Landskabet, der forbinder projektets historiske undersøgelser med de landskabsforandringer, der finder sted i Danmark netop nu.

En væsentlig opgave bliver at undersøge, hvordan nutidens landmænd, lodsejere og andre lokale aktører oplever og forholder sig til den grønne omstilling og til konkrete forandringer i det landskab, de lever og arbejder i. Det gælder blandt andet processer og naturprojekter knyttet til Den Grønne Trepart. Gennem kvalitative interviews og, hvor det er relevant, surveys og andre analyser skal du undersøge aktørernes perspektiver, handlemuligheder og interesser samt de muligheder og konflikter, der opstår, når hensyn til landbrugsproduktion, klima, biodiversitet, natur og lokalsamfund mødes.

Undersøgelserne skal sættes i relation til projektets historiske forskning. Du kommer dermed til at arbejde med spørgsmål som: Hvordan gennemføres store landskabsforandringer lokalt? Hvad får mennesker til at medvirke til, modsætte sig eller forsøge at påvirke dem? Hvilken betydning har erfaringer, ejerskab, økonomi, natursyn og tilknytning til landskabet? Og hvad kan erfaringerne fra tidligere perioder med omfattende landskabsforandringer bidrage med til de beslutninger, vi træffer i dag?

Opgaven har således en klar ramme, men der er samtidig betydeligt forskningsmæssigt råderum. Afhængigt af din faglige profil og dine interesser får du mulighed for at præge undersøgelsens forskningsspørgsmål, teoretiske perspektiv, metode og konkrete empiriske fokus inden for projektets overordnede problemstillinger.

Du bliver en del af en tværfaglig forskningsgruppe på tværs af Museum Odense, Aarhus Universitet og Det Grønne Museum og vil arbejde tæt sammen med projektets øvrige forskere. Stillingen indebærer både selvstændigt forskningsarbejde og deltagelse i projektets fælles aktiviteter. Du forventes blandt andet at bidrage til projektets dataindsamling og analyser, videnskabelige publikationer, den afsluttende antologi og et fagligt symposium samt til formidling af forskningen til en bredere offentlighed og den aktuelle debat om fremtidens landskab.

Kompetencer

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har en ph.d.-grad eller tilsvarende inden for f.eks. etnologi, antropologi, historie eller tilsvarende relevante fag.
  • Har erfaring med interviews til forskningsundersøgelser.
  • Har interesse for landskabsforskning og -forvaltning.
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og struktureret.
  • Har kørekort B, da der kan forventes kørsel i arbejdstiden. 

Vi tilbyder

  • Et tværfagligt og spændende forskningsmiljø, heriblandt fire andre forskere ved Arven i Landskabet i Odense.
  • Deltagelse i den større tværfaglige projektgruppe med forskere på Aarhus Universitet, Det Grønne Museum og Museum Odense (heriblandt Den Fynske Landsby).
  • En kombination af klart definerede projektopgaver og forskningsmæssigt råderum til at udvikle egne spørgsmål og analyser inden for projektets ramme.

Ansøgning og ansøgningsproces

Ansøgningen skal indeholde:

  • En motiveret ansøgning (maks. 2 sider), hvor du redegør for:
    • din motivation for at søge stillingen
    • dine kvalifikationer i forhold til opslaget
    • en kort beskrivelse af, hvordan du vil tilgå projektet forskningsmæssigt
  • CV (maks. 2 sider)
  • En kopi af kandidatbevis og evt. ph.d.-bevis
  • Publikationsliste med angivelse af de vedhæftede publikationer, som ønskes taget i betragtning ved bedømmelsen
  • Maksimalt 2 vedhæftede publikationer til bedømmelse.
  • Ansøgningsfrist: 15. nov. 2026

Vi anvender shortlisting, hvor et antal ansøgere udvælges til bedømmelse af deres faglige kvalifikationer. På baggrund af bedømmelserne indkaldes en eller flere kandidater til samtale. De ansøgere, hvis ansøgning ikke sendes til bedømmelse, orienteres om dette umiddelbart efter shortlisting. Samtaler foretages i midten af december. Endeligt afslag sendes ved afslutningen af rekrutteringen.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår fastsættes i henhold til gældende forhandlingsberettigede overenskomst. Stillingen er på 37 timer om ugen i 12 måneder. Det primære arbejdssted er Forskningscenter CENTRUM ved Museum Odense og det forventes, at du som udgangspunkt er til stede på museet i arbejdstiden. Der vil dog forekomme feltarbejde, seminarer og projektmøder andre steder.

Tiltrædelse 1. feb. 2027 eller snarest derefter.

Uddybende spørgsmål om stillingen kan rettes til projektleder ved Arven i Landskabet Peder Dam tlf. 21493464 og mail pda@museumodense.dk.

Museum Odense er en selvejende institution og et af landets store statsanerkendte kulturhistoriske museer. Vi driver i alt seks museer og havde i 2025 et samlet besøgstal på over 400.000. Museets Vision 2026 og Strategi 2024-2026 sætter rammer og retning for museets ambitiøse udvikling i de kommende år. Se museets vision og strategi på Organisation - Museum Odense Museum-Odense_kort-strategi-2024-2026.pdf

Alle gældende regler om håndtering af persondata og fortrolighed overholdes i den forbindelse.

jobs.title: PhD Candidate in International Business
jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

The position is at NTNU in Ålesund at the School of International Business. We are looking for candidates with an educational background in international business or international management. However, other business and management degrees, including technology management, innovation management, organizational leadership and behavior, or human resource management, will also be considered.

Are you motivated to take a step towards a doctorate and open up exciting career opportunities? As a PhD Candidate with us, you will work to achieve your doctorate and, at the same time, gain valuable experience that qualifies you for a future career in higher education and research, both within and beyond academia.

Your immediate leader will be the Head of Department.


About the project

Digital technologies such as artificial intelligence, automation, and remote operations are transforming not only where people work, but also how work is organized. As technologies redistribute tasks, expertise, decision-making authority, and responsibility across people and locations, they can reconfigure established roles, relationships, and ways of working. These changes raise important leadership questions: How do leaders help employees navigate changing roles and responsibilities? How are trust, shared understanding, and coordination maintained when work becomes increasingly technology-mediated and geographically distributed? And how do leadership practices emerge as established authority structures are reshaped by technology?

These leadership challenges can become particularly pronounced in culturally diverse teams, where members may differ in their expectations regarding leadership, authority, autonomy, participation, communication, and responsibility. Such differences may reflect both the cultural composition of the team and the cultural values and orientations of individual members. The aim of this PhD project is to investigate how leadership and culture jointly shape responses to technology-driven changes in distributed work, with particular attention to how leaders navigate culturally diverse expectations as new ways of working emerge, and how these processes influence trust, role clarity, and coordination. 

The PhD project seeks to advance research on leadership, cross-cultural management, and technology-driven organizational change, potentially using remote maritime operations as a relevant empirical context in which geographically dispersed and culturally diverse actors must navigate shifting roles and authority while coordinating effectively in a safety-critical environment.

The successful candidate will have scope to develop the theoretical framework, research questions, and methodological design within the project's overall direction.


About the proposal

The PhD candidate should develop and submit a proposal within the scope of the topic, and, if selected as the preferred candidate, conduct research on the topic. Preferably, the PhD candidate’s research should focus on industries relevant to the Møre and Romsdal county, such as the marine and maritime industries.


Duties of the position
  • Complete the doctoral education until obtaining a doctorate
  • Carry out research of good quality within the framework described above
  • Academic publications and popular science dissemination
  • Participate in the research group on international business and innovation.
  • Participate in international activities such as conferences and/or research stays at foreign educational institutions

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.


Required selection criteria
  • You must have an academically relevant background, preferably within international business or international management. However, other business and management degrees including technology management, management of innovation, organizational leadership and behavior, or human resource management may also apply. 
  • You must have a master’s degree in international business, international management, business administration, or equivalent. Your course of study must correspond to a five-year Norwegian course in which 120 credits have been obtained at the master's level. Master's students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position. 
  • You must have a strong academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree studies, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker academic background, you may still be considered if you can demonstrate that you are particularly well-suited for a PhD program.
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty of economics and management doctoral programme (https://www.ntnu.edu/ok/research/phd)
  • Good oral and written presentation skills in English and/or Norwegian.

PLEASE NOTE: For detailed information about what the application must contain, see paragraph “About the application”.

 

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.


Preferred selection criteria
  • Good knowledge of industries represented in the region, such as the marine, maritime and furniture industry, both local and global.
  • Have strong motivation for advanced research work demonstrated by a motivation letter and a proposal within the scope of the project description above.
  • Good demonstrated theoretical and analytical skills.
  • Contribute to a positive work environment in general is emphasized.

Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

  • Work independently
  • Work in a structured way, set goals and make plans to achieve them
  • Present and discuss your research with other professionals
  • Get involved and contribute constructively with feedback
  • Work constructively under pressure or in the face of adversity 
  • Show curiosity and a strong motivation for the subject
  • Analyze data, assess different perspectives and draw well-founded conclusions 
  • Be flexible and open to adjusting the plan for the project as needed

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.


We offer

 

  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.


Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality. (delete if not applicable)


Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme through out the period of employment.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to bein conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.


About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in Norwegian or English. 

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include: 

  • Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees
  • CV 
  • Copy of Master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
  • Project outline containing proposals for an overall description of research questions, theoretical perspectives, methodological design for the project, and progress plan (maximum 2000 words/5 pages) 
  • Short letter of motivation (400 words/1 page)
  • Possibly publications, etc., other relevant research work
  • Possibly certificates
  • Possible letter(s) of reference/recommendation
  • Names and contact information of three relevant referees


If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.


Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.

NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).


General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact the Head of Department, Associate Professor Mark Pasquine (mapa@ntnu.no), Professor Ghulam Mustafa (guma@ntnu.no), or the Deputy leader, Research & Innovation, Professor Richard Glavee-Geo (rigl@ntnu.no). If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact HR Adviser Oddny Lyngvær at email: oddny.lyngvar@ntnu.no or telephone: +47 95011957. 

Application deadline: 25.10.2026
