jobs.title: Vi søger en lagermedarbejder til vores værksted i Dragør, der har gå-på-mod og overblik
jobs.description:
Hvad gør du, når du ser noget, der ligger og flyder? Vi har brug for en lagermedarbejder, der kan se, hvornår noget skal have tildelt en plads og som kan flytte det selvstændigt.

Har du et godt overblik og en naturlig glæde ved at skabe orden omkring dig? Trives du ved afvekslende arbejdsopgaver, et højt tempo og er du mødestabil?

Hos RENTEQ Automotive i Dragør, leder vi efter en lagermedarbejder, der kan bistå indkøbsafdelingen og sætte struktur på vores varer, lagerreoler og opbevaringsflader.

Om os

RENTEQ Automotive er en ung virksomhed i en rivende udvikling, som har en ambition om at reducere den samlede CO2-udledningen ved at skubbe til elektrificering af biler og entreprenørmaskiner. Hos os er der korte beslutningsveje, stor variation i hverdagen og en reel mulighed for at bidrage til, hvordan vi arbejder, mens vi vokser. Vi sætter pris på mennesker, der tager initiativ, kommunikerer åbent og går op i at gøre tingene ordentligt.

Om stillingen

Dine primære opgaver vil være:

  • Varemodtagelse: Modtage indgående varer, tjekke for fragtskader og registrere dem i vores ERP-system

  • Plukning til produktionen: Plukke materialer til produktionen og sikre, at forbruget bliver afskrevet korrekt

  • Orden og struktur på lageret: Sørge for, at alle varer har en fast lokation, at reoler og opbevaringsflader er overskuelige samt deltage i lageroptællinger.

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har god ordenssans og tager ejerskab for dine opgaver

  • Er pligtopfyldende og mødestabil

  • Er fysisk til rådighed for lagerarbejde (løft, stå/gå)

  • Har truckcertifikat – eller har mod på at komme på truck-kursus.

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og i et team.

 Du behøver ikke have en bestemt baggrund eller alder – det vigtigste er, at du har lysten og personligheden til at tage opgaverne på dig.

Vi tilbyder

·      En uformel arbejdsplads, hvor vi arbejder hårdt, men husker at more os

·      Afvekslende arbejdsopgaver – ikke to dage er ens

·      En timelønnet fuldtidsstilling

·      Frokosten spiser vi samlet.


Sådan søger du

Kan du se dig selv som RENTEQ’s lagermedarbejder?
Kom forbi RENTEQ på A. P. Møllers Allé 41 i Dragør og medbring eller send os en kort ansøgning samt cv, hvor du fortæller lidt om dig selv og din motivation for at søge stillingen – fristen er 1. november 2026 kl. 12.
Opstart hurtigst muligt. Vi holder løbende samtaler og ansætter, så snart vi har fundet det rette match.


Du sender din ansøgning til Sanne Munk på e-mail: sanne@ren-teq.com

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.description:
Haemme Keski-Suomen hyvinvointialueen henkilökohtaisen avun keskuksen kautta avustajaa määräaikaiseen sijaisuuteen 83-vuotiaalle naiselle. Hän asuu Jyväskylässä palvelutalossa. Kyseessä on äitiysloman sijaisuus, joka alkaisi viimeistään 12.1.2027 ja päättyisi näillä näkymin elokuussa 2028.

Työnantaja on täysin kuurosokea, ja liikkumisessa hänellä on apuna rollaattori. Työ vaatii avustajalta suomenkielisen viittomakielen viittomien osaamista (vähintään hyvää perustasoa), sillä työnantaja vastaanottaa kielen taktiiliviittomalla. Hän pitää käsiään avustajan käsien päällä ja tuntee viittomien liikkeet, muodot ja paikat. Työnantaja itse käyttää enimmäkseen puhuttua suomenkieltä, joten kommunikaation sujuvuuden vuoksi toiveena on ensisijaisesti kuuleva avustaja, mutta kaikki hakijat huomioidaan. Kokemus taktiilista viittomisesta on iso etu, mutta tärkeintä olisi aito halu ja rohkeus oppia tämä taito. Työ ei sisällä vaativia nostoja tai siirtoja.

Työtä tarjotaan vaihtelevasti 30 h/kk, tarvittaessa myös iltaisin ja viikonloppuisin, vapaa-ajan avustamiseen työnantajan toiveiden mukaisesti. Työ sisältää esim. ulkoilua, asioimisapua, kerhoja, tilaisuuksia sekä tulkki- ja taksitilausten hoitelua. Työvuorot suunnitellaan yhdessä. Työ on tempoltaan rauhallista.

Työkokemus esimerkiksi henkilökohtaisesta avustamisesta katsotaan eduksi, mutta tarkkoja koulutusvaatimuksia ei ole. Tärkeintä on luotettavuus, rohkeus viittoa taktiilisti, joustavuus ja hyvä tilannetaju.

Palkkaus: Heta TES C 14,73 €/h + mahdolliset kokemuslisät.

Työsuhteet ovat aina yksityisiä. Työsuhteeseen valittu henkilö on työsuhteessa avustettavaan, ja mukana käytännön asioiden hoitamisessa on tarvittaessa myös työnantajan perheenjäsen. Nykyinen avustaja voi perehdyttää työhön.

Haastatteluun / työsuhteeseen valitulle tieto ilmoitetaan henkilökohtaisesti.

Työ alkaa viimeistään tammikuussa sopivan avustajan löydyttyä, mutta työhön pääsee tutustumaan jo aiemmin.

Työnantajalla on oikeus pyytää iäkkäiden ja vammaisten henkilöiden kanssa työhön valitulta työntekijältä rikosrekisteriote nähtäväksi kerran työsuhteen alkaessa (Laki sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta 741/2023, 28 §).

Rikosrekisteriote on salassa pidettävää tietoa ja sitä ei tule lähettää hakemuksen yhteydessä.

Hae työpaikkaa lähettämällä hakemuksesi osoitteeseen havu.keskus@hyvaks.fi. Liitä hakemukseesi tämän työpaikkailmoituksen oma viitetieto. Välitämme hakemuksesi työnantajalle.

jobs.title: Keittiön vuoropäällikkö, Break Sokos Hotel Tahko
jobs.description:
Primary location:
KUOPIO

BREAK SOKOS HOTEL TAHKO etsii nyt KEITTIÖN VUOROPÄÄLLIKKÖÄ vakituiseen osa-aikaiseen työsuhteeseen - ihan tavallisiin töihin, poikkeuksellisen mukavien työkavereiden joukkoon


Sopimustunnit: keskimäärin 90 t / 3 vko

Työ alkaa: 1.11.2026 tai sopimuksen mukaan


Haluatko työskennellä upeissa maisemissa Tahkolla ja olla mukana luomassa makuelämyksiä keskellä vilkasta matkailukeskusta?


Break Sokos Hotel Tahko sijaitsee Tahkon sydämessä, keskellä ympärivuotista matkailukeskusta. Hotellin yhteydessä toimiva Ravintola Hillside tunnetaan rennosta tunnelmastaan, sesonkien mukaan elävästä ruokalistastaan ja lämminhenkisestä palvelustaan. Meillä pääset osaksi tiimiä, jossa yhteistyö, tekemisen meininki ja laadukas asiakaskokemus ovat arjen ytimessä. Voit tutustua tunnelmaamme somessa ja bongata samalla tulevia työkavereitasi!


Vuoropäällikkönä olet avainroolissa varmistamassa, että keittiö toimii laadukkaasti ja sujuvasti jokaisessa vuorossa. Johdat tiimiä esimerkilläsi, organisoit työvuoron kulun ja huolehdit siitä, että jokainen löytää oman roolinsa arjen tilanteissa. Osallistut itse aktiivisesti ruoanvalmistukseen ja varmistat, että esivalmistelut, raaka-aineet ja tilaukset ovat kunnossa sekä että annosten tasalaatuisuus ja esillepano vastaavat Hillsiden konseptia.


Tehtäviisi kuuluu myös hävikin ja kustannusten seuranta, hygienia- ja omavalvontavaatimusten toteutuminen sekä tilausten tekeminen ja raportointi esihenkilöille. Työvuorot ovat vaihtelevia ja sijoittuvat pääsääntöisesti klo 06.00 - 24.00 välille, painottuen iltoihin, viikonloppuihin ja juhlapyhiin. Meillä Hillsidessa pääset kehittymään sekä kehittämään tiimin osaamista osana isoa, ammattitaitoista työporukkaa.


Vaikka työskentelet pääosin keittiössä, olet aina asiakaspalvelija: jokainen annos ja työvaihe vaikuttaa asiakkaan kokemukseen. Työssä ei myöskään tulla koskaan täysin valmiiksi, vaan odotamme sinulta halua oppia, ottaa palautetta vastaan ja kehittää tekemistä yhdessä tiimin kanssa. Työssä arvomme näkyvät käytännössä: pidämme asiakkaan kokemuksen mielessä jokaisessa annoksessa, tartumme tehtäviin ja muuttuviin tilanteisiin toimeliaasti, kannamme ylpeydellä vastuun työn laadusta ja autamme koko tiimiä onnistumaan yhdessä.


Tämä työ sopii sinulle, jos olet positiivinen, ratkaisukeskeinen ja hyvän paineensietokyvyn omaava keittiöammattilainen, joka viihtyy vauhdikkaassa työympäristössä ja haluaa ottaa vastuuta vuoron sujuvuudesta. Onnistut tehtävässä, kun sinulla on kokemusta keittiön käytännön työstä, ymmärrys hyvästä keittiöprosessista sekä kyky johtaa ja motivoida tiimiä esimerkillä. Sinulta sujuu vuorovaikutus niin keittiön kuin salin kanssa, hallitset kokonaisuuksia myös kiireessä ja pidät huolta laadusta sekä yksityiskohdista. Olet oma-aloitteinen tekijä, joka haluaa kehittää toimintaa, tukea tiimin onnistumista ja toimii arvojemme mukaisesti #tunteella #toimeliaasti #ylpeästi #yhdessä.


Edellytämme hygieniapassia, sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa ja kokemusta keittiötyöstä.

Arvostamme tehtävään sopivaa ammatillista koulutusta ja kokemusta esihenkilötyöstä tai muusta ohjaustyöstä.


Mitä se ihan tavallinen työ meillä on

- Henkilökuntaetuja: alennuksia ruoasta, juomasta, meikeistä, elektroniikasta, ravintoloista, hotelleista, pankkipalveluista ja monesta muusta mukavasta asiasta.

- Epassin etuja: jopa 250 € arvosta vuodessa.

- Rahaa: MaRaVa esihenkilöiden työehtosopimuksen palkkaryhmän 3 mukainen tuntipalkka 15,60–16,93 €, kokemusvuosista riippuen. Lisäksi maksamme työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät.

- Tulospalkkaus: mahdollisuus ansaita ylimääräinen jopa 2 kuukauden palkka vuodessa.

- Työpaikka, johon on kiva tulla ja olla. Meillä ei tarvitse olla yhtä iloista perhettä, mutta älä ylläty, jos työkavereista tulee myös ystäviä.

- Mahdollisuus vaihtaa tehtäviä tai alaa - jos itse haluat.


Työtä kuvataan usein korulauseilla, mutta meidän mielestämme tavallisuudessa ei ole mitään pahaa. Me Osuuskauppa PeeÄssällä sanomme olevamme ihan tavallisissa töissä - eikä se tarkoita tylsää porukkaa, päinvastoin. Työ on hyvää ja sujuvaa arkea, jossa teemme myös muiden arjesta - ja välillä juhlastakin - vähän parempaa. Ja joskus juhlitaan itsekin. Jos työpaikkailmoitusten kliseet kyllästyttävät, tule meille ihan tavallisiin töihin.


Jos ihan tavallinen työ houkuttaa, laita hakemusta tulemaan - me odotamme sinua.

Hakuaika päättyy: 18.10.2026. Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana ja täytämme paikan heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Lisätietoja: ravintolapäällikkö Krista Mattila, puh. 050577 2229, krista.mattila@sok.fi

Osuuskauppa PeeÄssä on yli 136 000 asiakasomistajan omistama palvelualan yritys Pohjois-Savossa. Tavoitteenamme on olla Parhaan Elämän Edelläkävijä Savossa. Meille se tarkoittaa merkityksellistä työtä, reilua työnantajuutta ja arjen sujuvuutta. Olemme ylpeitä siitä, että voimme tuottaa osuustoiminnallista hyötyä ja kehittää toimintaamme jatkuvasti arvojemme mukaisesti: #tunteella, #toimeliaasti, #ylpeästi ja #yhdessä.

jobs.description:
Rattaché à la Production, vous assurez la gestion opérationnelle de l'établissement, son fonctionnement de façon pérenne et la qualité de ses services dans le respect des valeurs et des orientations stratégiques du Groupe.

Ainsi vos missions sont les suivantes :
Pilotage de l'établissement
- Piloter l'établissement, sur la base du projet de l'association
- Coordonner l'ensemble des activités de l'établissement (classes, séjours, familles, vacanciers, clients, CE, Evènementiel etc.)
- Appliquer la réglementation légale, juridique et administrative relative aux activités
- Assurer la continuité de la qualité des services et prestations proposées

Gestion administrative
- Tracer le suivi des activités de la réservation jusqu'au paiement
- Produire les rapports d'activité
- Transmettre les variables de paie au siège
- Signaler les événements indésirables
- Assurer le suivi et la mise à jour des documents réglementaires

Gestion architecturale, bâtimentaire et des équipements
- Respecter la législation liée à la sécurité des locaux et des équipements
- Préparer et accompagner les visites de la commission de sécurité
- Assurer l'hygiène des locaux
- Entretenir les extérieurs et prévenir les risques liés notamment aux incendies
- Entretenir les équipements
- Veiller aux contrôles périodiques obligatoires
- Valoriser le patrimoine
- Moderniser et améliorer le cadre de vie

Gestion financière
- Gérer les budgets alloués en maitrisant les coûts
- Accroitre les taux de fréquentation et de remplissage
- Suivi des ratios et tableaux de bord
- Développer le chiffre d'affaires pour garantir l'indépendance financière

Gestion des Ressources Humaines
- Manager les professionnels et les bénévoles
- Recruter le personnel
- Intégrer le personnel
- Organiser les plannings en prenant en compte les besoins de l'établissement dans le respect de textes législatifs en matière de droit du travail et de l'application de la Convention Collective
- Procéder aux entretiens annuels d'évaluation
- Promouvoir la formation du personnel et des bénévoles
- Instaurer un climat social apaisé

Gestion commerciale
- Développer la diversification des publics en prenant en compte leurs besoins spécifiques
- Développer la diversification des prestations
- Trouver la bonne adéquation entre les réalités financières des publics et les coûts des prestations
- Proposer des formules innovantes
- Entretenir des relations durables avec les clients

Communication, partenariat, réseaux

jobs.description:
**Haemme työntekijöitä talvikaudelle Ylläsjärvelle!**

Vuokraamoomme Ylläsjärvellä etsitään **1–2 reipasta ja asiakaspalveluhenkistä työntekijää talvikaudelle 2026–2027**.

**Keitä olemme?**

TunturiFlow on Ylläsjärven kylällä toimiva välinevuokraamo, jonka tavoitteena on tehdä Ylläksen luonnosta ja aktiviteeteista helposti saavutettavia kaikille. Meiltä voi vuokrata monipuolisesti välineitä ympäri vuoden – talvikaudella valikoimaamme kuuluvat muun muassa moottorikelkat, E-fatbiket, maastohiihtovälineet ja lumikengät. Vuokraamoltamme pääsee suoraan Ylläksen upeille reiteille, ja asiakkaitamme palvelemme rennolla ja asiantuntevalla otteella.

Työssä pääset palvelemaan matkailijoita upeissa Lapin maisemissa. Työpäiväsi koostuvat asiakaspalvelusta ja vuokraamon monipuolisista tehtävistä – moottorikelkkojen, pyörien ja muiden välineiden vuokrauksesta asiakkaiden opastamiseen ja välineistä huolehtimiseen.

**Toivomme sinulta:**

· suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa – molemmat ovat tehtävässä välttämättömiä

· hyvää asiakaspalveluasennetta ja reipasta otetta tekemiseen

· kiinnostusta ja mielellään myös osaamista moottorikelkoista ja pyöristä

· oma-aloitteisuutta, luotettavuutta ja valmiutta vaihteleviin työtehtäviin

· kykyä pysyä rauhallisena myös kiireisen sesongin keskellä.

Kokemus moottorikelkoista, pyöristä, välinevuokrauksesta tai oppaan työstä katsotaan eduksi, samoin muu kielitaito. Aikaisempaa kokemusta alalta ei kuitenkaan edellytetä – tärkeintä on reipas asenne, halu oppia uutta ja valmius tarttua monipuolisesti erilaisiin tehtäviin.

**Tarjoamme mielenkiintoisen ja vaihtelevan työn Lapin talvikaudelle sekä hyvän ja rennon työporukan.**

**Työpaikka:** Ylläsjärvi **Työsuhde:** joulukuu 2026 – huhtikuu 2027 **Haemme:** 1–2 työntekijää

Laita meille viestiä osoitteeseen **info@tunturiflow.fi** ja kerro lyhyesti, kuka olet, millaista kokemusta sinulla on ja miksi olisit hyvä lisä tiimiimme. Kerro myös, milloin voisit aloittaa ja etsitkö kokoaikaista vai osa-aikaista työtä.

jobs.title: Junior Product Manager (Entry Level)
jobs.description:
Join Efore and Shape the Future of Power Solutions

Efore is looking for a motivated and business-oriented **Junior Product Manager** to join our Product Solutions team.

This role offers an excellent opportunity for an early-career professional or recent graduate to develop expertise in product management within an international technology environment. You will work closely with customers, sales teams, R&D, and operations to support the development, lifecycle management, and commercialization of Efore's power solutions.

As a Junior Product Manager, you will gain hands-on experience in customer-facing activities, market analysis, product development processes, and strategic product planning while working with leading technologies in telecommunications, industrial, and energy applications.

Your Responsibilities

In this role, you will:

- Support product lifecycle management from product introduction to phase-out.

- Participate in RFQ and RFI processes together with Sales and Quotation teams.

- Assist in defining customer requirements and translating them into internal product requirements.

- Support technical and commercial evaluations of customer solutions.

- Participate in customer meetings and technical discussions.

- Monitor product performance, quality, profitability, and market competitiveness.

- Conduct market and competitor analysis to identify trends and business opportunities.

- Support product roadmap planning and technology development activities.

- Collaborate closely with R&D, Operations, Supply Chain, Quality, and Sales teams.

- Support New Product Introduction (NPI) activities and customer qualification processes.

- Prepare presentations, reports, and product-related documentation.

- Contribute to continuous product improvement initiatives.


What We Are Looking For

Education

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in:


- Electrical Engineering

- Electronics

- Telecommunications

- Business & Technology

- Or a related field


Experience

- DC Power Systems basic knowledge

- Recent graduates are encouraged to apply.

- Previous experience through internships, thesis work, student projects, or employment in product management, engineering, sales support, or project coordination is considered an advantage.

- Experience within telecommunications, power electronics, energy solutions, batteries, or related industries is beneficial.


Skills & Competencies

We are looking for someone who:

- Has strong interest in technology, products, and business development.

- Is analytical and curious about customer and market needs.

- Enjoys working with cross-functional teams.

- Has strong communication and presentation skills.

- Takes initiative and demonstrates a proactive attitude.

- Is organized and able to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.

- Has a commercial mindset and customer-focused approach.

- Is eager to learn and develop within product management.

- Is fluent in written and spoken Finnish and English.

- Additional European language skills are considered an advantage (eg. Spanish or Swedish).


Why Join Efore?

At Efore, you will have the opportunity to:

- Build a long-term career in product management.

- Work in an international business environment.

- Collaborate with industry-leading customers and technology experts.

- Participate in developing innovative power and energy solutions.

- Gain exposure to global markets, customers, and technologies.

- Grow professionally through challenging projects and continuous learning opportunities.


About Efore

Efore is a leading provider of advanced power electronics and energy solutions. We serve customers globally by delivering innovative, reliable, and sustainable solutions for telecommunications, industrial applications, and emerging energy markets.

**Interested?**

Please send your application, CV, and salary expectation to careersfinland@efore.com by October 18, 2026. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, so early applications are encouraged and the position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate is found.

If you have any questions about the role, please don't hesitate to get in touch with Mikael Tötterman +358405906018 **9.10. at 13.00-14.30 or 14.10. at 13.00-14.30**.

**Join Efore and start your journey in Product Management!**

jobs.title: Elektriker til elbilsbatterier
jobs.description:
Er du uddannet elektriker med et stærkt teknisk mindset, og har du lyst til at arbejde med en af den grønne omstillings mest bemærkelsesværdige vækstsektorer? Trives du i en hverdag med høj grad af frihed under ansvar, hvor du er med til at forme og optimere de daglige arbejdsgange? Så er det dig, vi søger på vegne af vores kunde, Stena Recycling!

En anderledes og fremtidssikret elektrikerrolle

I denne rolle slipper du for de traditionelle bygge- og installationsopgaver. I stedet bliver du en nøgleperson i Stenas nye, banebrydende projekt omkring modtagelse, test, afladning og genanvendelse af elbilsbatterier.

Da området er i rivende udvikling, forventer vi ikke, at du er ekspert i højspændingsbatterier fra dag ét – Stena sørger for grundig oplæring og faglig opkvalificering. Det vigtigste er din faglige nysgerrighed, din høje sikkerhedsforståelse og dit engagement i at tage ansvar for opbygningen af et nyt felt.

Dine primære opgaver:

- Modtagelse, tilstandstest og registrering af elbilsbatterier fra hele Danmark.

- Styre og overvåge sikker afladning samt energihåndtering af højspændingsbatterier.

- Præcis af- og demontering af batteripakker ned på modul- og celleniveau.

- Klargøring af batterikomponenter til henholdsvis genanvendelse, destruktion eller second-life brug.

- Medvirke til at udvikle og optimere sikkerhedsrutiner, testudstyr og daglige arbejdsgange på værkstedet.

Hvad leder vi efter hos dig?

- Du er uddannet elektriker, automatiktekniker eller har en lignende el-teknisk baggrund.

- Du har en høj sikkerhedsforståelse og arbejder struktureret og omhyggeligt.

- Du trives i en pionerrolle, hvor procedurer og arbejdsgange løbende udvikles og tilpasses.

- Du tager naturligt initiativ og er en god holdspiller.

Stena tilbyder:

- En unik chance for at opbygge en specialistprofil inden for et område i massiv vækst.

- En arbejdsplads med højt til loftet, frihed under ansvar og stærkt sammenhold.

- Grundig oplæring, relevante kurser og løbende kompetenceudvikling.

- Oprigtig frihed under ansvar og stor tidslig fleksbilitet

¤praktisk info¤

- Lønnen afgøres efter dine kvalifikationer og kompetencer

- Arbejdstiderne er på daghold - 07:00 - 15:15 mandag - torsdag og fredag 07:00 - 13:00 (Stena betaler din pause)

- Arbejdet er dækket under Industriens Overenskomst

- Arbejdet foregår på Stenas lokation i Farum, men forventes at rykke til deres lokation i Roskilde, når det tekniske anlæg er oppe og køre.

Hos Stena Recycling bliver du en del af en arbejdsplads, hvor din sikkerhed, tryghed og trivsel altid kommer i første række. Vi tilbyder et job med gode rotationsmuligheder og hjælpsomme kolleger i et stærkt fællesskab, hvor kvalitet og hjælpsomhed er i højsædet. Du får rig mulighed for at tage ansvar og udvikle dig personligt i takt med, at deres afdeling vokser.

Stillingen starter som et Try & Hire-forløb med gode muligheder for efterfølgende fastansættelse for den rette kandidat. Som ansat får du naturligvis stillet arbejdstøj til rådighed.

Ansøgning og kontakt

Søg stillingen ved at klikke på "ansøg". Randstad varetager rekrutteringsprocessen på vegne af Stena Recycling. Alle ansøgninger behandles fortroligt, og der afholdes løbende interviews. Så send gerne din ansøgning så hurtigt som muligt, hvis du vil med på holdet.

Hvis du har spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte konsulent Liv Nielsen på liv.nielsen@randstad.dk.

Om Randstad

Randstad er verdens største HR-udbyder og ‘partner for talent’. Vi giver lige muligheder til alle, uanset baggrund, og hjælper kandidater med at forblive relevante på et hastigt skiftende arbejdsmarked. Vi tror på et inkluderende arbejdsmarked, hvor alle kan være sig selv og føle sig velkomne.

Vores markedsindsigt og store kendskab til arbejdsmarkedet hjælper virksomheder med at opbygge en kvalificeret, mangfoldig og fleksibel arbejdsstyrke, og vi støtter mennesker og virksomheder i at nå deres fulde potentiale. Det er det, vi er her for, og det er det, der motiverer os hver dag.

Randstad DK er en del af den internationale Randstad Group. Vi formidler dagligt arbejde til over 600.000 mennesker verden over og er førende inden for rekruttering, karriererådgivning og fleksibel arbejdskraft i Danmark med afdelinger i København, Aarhus, Aalborg og Kolding.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow at the interaction between information systems and machine learning
jobs.employer: OSLO UNIVERSITETSSYKEHUS HF BEDRIFTSHELSETJENESTE OSLO UNIVERSITETSSYKEHUS
jobs.description:
About the position

We invite applications for a Postdoctoral Research Fellow position in action-oriented modeling for trustworthy AI, available at the Department of Informatics, University of Oslo.

The starting date is no later than 01.03.2027 and as soon as possible after the appointment.

The appointment is a full-time position for a period of three years.

The fellowship is funded in full by TRUST for the whole period. No teaching, supervision, or research-assistance duties are required in the position, and the fellowship period can therefore not be extended to four years on that basis.

No one can be appointed for more than one Postdoctoral Research Fellowship at the University of Oslo.

The place of work is the Department of Informatics at the University of Oslo. The successful candidate will be part of the daily research and social life of TRUST – the Norwegian Centre for Trustworthy AI, and of the information systems research group.


Project description

The position is funded by TRUST, the Norwegian Centre for Trustworthy AI, which is a research centre dedicated to developing trustworthy AI systems that are accurate, fair, transparent, safe, and well-governed. The centre brings together researchers from computational and data science, law, social sciences, and philosophy to develop new AI technologies and study their societal impact in areas such as healthcare, industry, governance, security, and climate. TRUST is led by University of Oslo, SINTEF, and Norwegian Computing Center. With a consortium of over 70 partners from academia, industry, government, and civil society in Norway and internationally, TRUST’s research is theoretical, methodological, legal, and empirical in nature.

The postdoc will conduct the research project Action-Oriented Modeling for Trustworthy AI in Practice. The project addresses a persistent problem in applied AI: statistically accurate models routinely fail when they meet the organizations and ecosystems meant to use them. Models are misaligned with local procedures and decision processes, too rigid for resource-constrained operational systems, and opaque to the decision-makers who must act based on them. We treat this as a methodological problem rather than a technical one.

The primary deliverable of this position is a theoretical and methodological template that we call Action-Oriented Modeling. Rather than delivering finished algorithms, the template specifies how to build deliberately context-agnostic model architectures that expose methodological choices as parameters, and how local actors then configure, tune, and operate them. Its novelty lies in integrating three dimensions normally treated separately: configurable architectures that let domain experts shape model behavior without machine learning expertise; iterative field validation inside operational workflows; and governance mechanisms that transfer model ownership to local users.

The successful candidate will lead the development of this template into a generic, transferable, and theoretically grounded contribution. Your main tasks are to:

  • Develop, formalize, and publish the Action-Oriented Modeling template. This is the central output
  • Validate the template empirically through an action research design approach supplemented by participatory design methods
  • Define governance principles for model ownership that let stakeholders revise models as operational contexts change
  • Coordinate collaboration between the core development team, implementation partners, and local stakeholders, and act as a competence hub for action-oriented AI across TRUST

Two contrasting cases provide the empirical ground. The primary case is climate-sensitive disease prediction supporting public health decisions in low- and middle-income countries, built on DHIS2 and the action research network of the Health Information Systems Programme (HISP), with national health teams in ten countries. The complementary case is KoSy, the DHIS2-based municipal surveillance platform run by the Norwegian Institute of Public Health. We seek a candidate motivated by the methodological contribution to these and other empirical settings.

The main purpose of a postdoctoral fellowship is to provide candidates with enhanced skills to pursue a scientific top position within or beyond academia. To promote a strategic career path, all postdoctoral research fellows are required to submit a professional development plan no later than one month after commencement of the postdoctoral period.


What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Applicants must hold a degree equivalent to a Norwegian doctoral degree in information systems, informatics, computer science, science and technology studies, or another relevant field. The applicant must document that the degree corresponds to the requirement. The doctoral dissertation must be submitted for evaluation by the closing date. Only applicants with an approved doctoral thesis and public defense are eventually eligible for appointment
  • Documented experience with engaged, qualitative research methods in organizational settings, such as action research, design science research, or participatory design
  • Documented ability to publish conceptual, theoretical, or methodological contributions in high-ranking peer-reviewed journals or conferences
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English

Desired qualifications:

  • Demonstrated experience conducting sociotechnical research on information systems, examining how technology, people, and organizational contexts interact
  • Understanding of machine learning and predictive modeling sufficient to engage critically and constructively with data scientists, for example on data quality and model assumptions
  • Technical skills sufficient to deploy and test models

UiO is subject to the Security Act, which governs the organisation's protection of security-sensitive objects and knowledge, in addition to other relevant legislation concerning access to and handling of sensitive information. Based on this, it is a requirement that successful applicants are security-eligible. We may use background checks as part of our recruitment process.


What are we looking for in you?

In terms of personal skills:

  • You are motivated by methodological questions, enjoy qualitative fieldwork, and are excited about the academic challenge of turning messy empirical data into clear theoretical contributions
  • You work well both independently and as part of an interdisciplinary team, and you communicate across the boundary between technical and institutional expertise
  • You collaborate respectfully and effectively with practitioners and decision-makers who are not researchers
  • You work in a professional and structured manner and adapt quickly to new tasks
  • You are dependable and high-performing, also in hectic periods
  • You prefer being present at work and contribute actively to the professional and social environment you are part of

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal skills.


We can offer you
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development
  • A position at the centre of a national research effort on trustworthy AI, with access to the TRUST network and to operational partners in ten countries
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.  
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities
  • Postdoctoral development programmes.
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes
  • Salary in position as Postdoctoral Fellow, position code 1352 in salary range NOK 595 000 - 690 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund

We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. 

We hope you will apply for the position with us.


How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter, stating your motivation, summarizing your scientific work, and describing your research interests. The cover letter should not be written with the help of AI
  • A research statement of no more than three pages, setting out how you would approach the development and validation of the Action-Oriented Modeling template. The statement must connect clearly to the development of the template, and it is the main basis on which the evaluation committee will assess your fit for the position
  • CV summarizing education, positions, pedagogical experience, administrative experience, and other qualifying activity
  • Copies of educational certificates and academic transcript of records
  • A complete list of publications and up to 5 academic works that you wish to be considered by the evaluation committee. Please link these 5 publications, do not send them, except if they are still in manuscript format
  • Names and contact details of 2 to 3 references, with name, relation to candidate, e-mail, and telephone number

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

The best qualified candidates will be invited for interviews.

Please see the guidelines and regulations for appointments to Postdoctoral fellowships at the University of Oslo.

If an applicant has applied for and been granted funding for a fulltime research stay abroad while being employed as a Postdoctoral Research Fellow, the employment will be prolonged with the equivalent time as the research stay, but for no longer than of twelve months ( thus extending the employment to a maximum of four years).

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we can't, you will hear from us.

The University of Oslo has an agreement for all employees, aiming to secure rights to research results a.o.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society. 

The Department of Informatics (IFI) is one of nine departments belonging to the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences. IFI is Norway’s largest university department for general education and research in Computer Science and related topics. 

The Department has more than 1800 students on bachelor level, 600 master students, and over 240 PhDs and postdocs. The overall staff of the Department is close to 370 employees, about 280 of these in full time positions. The full time tenured academic staff is 75, mostly Full/Associate Professors.

jobs.title: Experienced Data Engineer Consultant
jobs.description:
Experienced Data Engineer Consultant

  • Kampmannsgade 2, 1604 København, Denmark

  • Full-time

  • Contract type: Permanent contract

Job Description

Are you an experienced Data Engineer ready for your next challenge? Would you like to lead technical architecture, mentor junior talent, and work directly with clients while staying at the forefront of modern data technologies? Then read on and apply to join our dynamic young team of 50 data experts who help companies gain new insights using a wide palette of modern tools. 

  • Contract: Full-time 

  • Location: Central Copenhagen, near Vesterport Station

Work Assignments

As an Experienced Data Engineer, you will operate at the intersection of deep technical expertise and business advisory. You will be responsible for:

  • Technical Design & Development: Designing and developing modern data solutions, ensuring our team implements the highest standards of data engineering.

  • Advisory & Collaboration: Acting as a trusted partner for our clients’ decision makers, ensuring good collaboration with their engineers, analysts, & business users.

  • Mentorship & Growth: Elevating our team of less experienced engineers through mentoring and fostering a culture of continuous technical improvement.

You will collaborate with our experienced data engineers, while quickly taking a mentoring role for our many less experienced consultants. 

What You Bring to the Team

Ideally, you have:

  • Solid experience working as a Data Engineer. 

  • Proficiency in Python, SQL, or APIs. 

  • Previous experience with some of these technologies: Snowflake, Databricks, Fabric, dbt, Azure, AWS, or GCP. 

  • An analytical approach to problem-solving, with a strong interest in how to drive business improvement using data.

  • Clear communication skills and the curiosity to engage with clients on projects.

  • A relevant degree.

  • A base near Copenhagen and fluency in English.

If you're excited about this role but you don’t tick all the boxes, we still encourage you to apply.

Why Devoteam Data Driven?

You will join a fantastic team of talented, curious data experts in a collaborative and dynamic workplace. Beyond working with nice colleagues on impactful projects, we offer comprehensive benefits to support your growth:

  • Continuous Growth & Community: We invest in your talent and dedicate time for learning to ensure you have up-to-date certifications in our technologies.

  • Work-Life Balance: We prioritize your personal time. In addition to your six weeks of paid vacation, we offer the flexibility of taking unlimited unpaid time off.

  • Social Events: We offer a variety of social events throughout the year. Recently we have done Lasertag, Pottery, Disc Golf, Book Club, Curling, Board Game Night, Foosball Tournament, Ice Hockey, among many other things.

Our Impact

Below are a few examples of our work:

  • Migrated Novo's global supply chain analytics solution from Alteryx-based workflows to a governed, cloud-native architecture using dbt, Snowflake, and Azure DevOps to support enterprise-scale analytics and collaboration.

  • Developed a comprehensive end-to-end data warehouse solution, featuring automated pipelines that structured dimensional data from diverse operational systems for unified analytics for a client.

  • Assessed the current data landscape in Novonesis and implemented a new self-service framework to enable business users to utilise the power of the modern data stack.

Application Process

Apply by uploading your CV no later than October 18th.

We review applications and invite selected candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. 

We encourage all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, or disability.

About Devoteam

Devoteam is a leading digital consultancy represented in 25 countries in Europe with +11,000 employees. In Denmark, our team is around 350 people and spread across four business teams - Data Driven (our team), a ServiceNow team, a Digital Management Consultancy team & a Google Cloud team - each focused on different aspects of digital transformation.

Oslo Business School is located in downtown Oslo and is part of the Oslo Metropolitan University. The school is currently working on obtaining international accreditations and is strongly focusing on enhancing research output in high quality journals. 

Oslo Business School is expanding and invites applications for 1-2 faculty positions in accounting. The positions are within the Finance and Accounting group, and the person(s) appointed will contribute to Oslo Business School's research and teaching in accounting and auditing and related subjects. The formal recruitment will be at the associate professor level with tenure. Candidates who qualify may be promoted to full professor following their appointment.


Your main duties and areas of responsibility will be
  • teaching and supervision at the Bachelor, Master, and PhD level 
  • active contribution to the development of a high-quality education 
  • initiating and carrying out high quality academic research 
  • contributing to the continued development of the research group in accounting and auditing and the department’s study programmes 
  • academic-administrative tasks 
  • active contribution to the development of Oslo Business School, and OsloMet in general 
  • disseminating research outcomes to the academic community and to the broader society

Qualification requirements

The ranking of qualified applicants is based on scientific merits. Teaching experience, personal qualities and suitability for the position are also important factors. We mainly consider recent publications and the potential for future publications in high-quality journals. The candidates we hire should fit the profile of our bachelor and master programs and must be able to contribute to the school’s long-term academic development. We encourage women to apply.

Applicants must:

  • hold a PhD in accounting or related fields (or be close to completion) 
  • have published in international journals and/or document the potential for quality publications in accounting 
  • have good teaching skills 
  • written and oral proficiency in Norwegian, Swedish or Danish (minimum level B2), and English (Language requirements for employees at OsloMet)

Applicants who do not have adequate proficiency in Norwegian or another Scandinavian language, will be offered Norwegian courses, and must acquire Norwegian skills corresponding to at least level B2 within three years of appointment.

The applicant must document relevant educational competence in accordance with OsloMet’s Guidelines for the assessment of educational competence at OsloMet. Applicants who do not possess the required educational qualifications must obtain them within two years of employment.

General criteria for appointments to academic positions are covered by the Regulations for appointment and promotion to academic posts.


It will be an advantage if you have
  • high quality research in recognized international journals
  • experience with research networks and externally funded projects
  • teaching and supervision experience from different degree levels
  • quantitative skills, related to empirical research or teaching
  • proficiency in Norwegian or another Scandinavian language
  • capability in communicating and cooperating with students and colleagues
  • a relevant professional credential (such as statsautorisert revisor)
  • ability to teach Norwegian accounting standards (GRS norsk regnskapslov)
  • personal qualities that contribute positively to the working environment

Personal qualities

OsloMet evaluates teaching qualifications in conjunction with interviews. It is important for OsloMet to reflect the population in our region, and all qualified candidates are welcome to apply. We make active endeavours to further develop OsloMet as an inclusive workplace and to adapt the workplace if required. If there are periods where you have not been in work, under education or in training, you are also welcome to apply.


We offer
  • engaging professional opportunities at Norway’s third largest university
  • an exciting job opportunity at a new and fast-growing business school in the middle of downtown Oslo 
  • participation in a dynamic professional environment, research groups, and unique academic community
  • a possibility to help map out the direction of a new and growing business school
  • opportunities for academic development in a professional research environment
  • interaction with a diverse student group
  • loan and pension arrangements through the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund 
  • beneficial welfare schemes and a wide range of sports and cultural offers
  • free Norwegian language classes to employees 
  • working location in downtown Oslo with multiple cultural offers

The salary for the position is in accordance with the Basic Collective Agreement for state employees and OsloMet’s pay policy for Associate Professor in code 1011, corresponding to 708 000 – 923 000 NOK per year. A higher salary may be considered for particularly well-qualified applicants. The salary depends on the qualifications of the applicant. From the salary, 2% will be deducted in pension contributions for the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK).

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SHi5avzdHIkApplication Process and Expert Committee

If you wish to apply for the position, you must do so through our recruitment system.
An expert committee will conduct the assessment of relevant applications. Before the application documents are sent to the expert committee, all applications will be reviewed by the faculty. Applications from unqualified candidates will not be forwarded to the expert committee for assessment. If the number of applications requires it, an internal screening committee at OsloMet will carry out an initial selection of candidates. The selected applicants will then be assessed by the expert committee. 

Please upload the following documents by the application deadline: 

  • application letter 
  • CV, letters of recommendations, and all pages of certificates/diplomas. Foreign education should be pre-approved, and a letter of approval must be attached. Information is available via the following link: Recognition of foreign education - to work in Norway | HK-dir 
  • a list of scientific publications/working papers 
  • up to 5 scientific publications (from the last five years), including your PhD thesis 
  • documentation of educational competence including a profiling document

For applicants who cannot document the required competencies in teaching in higher education have to develop this within two years from accession. OsloMet offers courses in teaching and learning in higher education which covers this requirement.

We only consider applications submitted through our electronic recruitment system, and all documents must be uploaded for your application to be considered. The documents must be in English or a Scandinavian language. Translations must be authorized, and you will be asked to present originals if you are invited for an interview. OsloMet verifies documents to give candidates a proper evaluation and ensure fair competition. Incomplete applications will not be considered. If you have documents that cannot be uploaded electronically, please contact stale.bie@oslomet.no

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow in Stochastic Analysis and Computational Methods
jobs.description:
About the position

A position as Postdoctoral Research Fellow in Stochastic Analysis and Computational Methods is available at Department of Mathematics, within the section of Risk and Stochastics.

Starting date no later than January 31st, 2027.

The appointment is a full-time position and is for a period of three years (10% of which is devoted to other career-promoting work, usually in the form of teaching activities). 

Depending upon the qualification of the applicant and the current needs of the department, a fourth year may be considered. In this case, a workload of 25% is devoted to career promoting work, usually in the form of teaching and/or supervision duties. In this case, Postdoctoral fellows who are appointed for a period of four years are expected to acquire basic pedagogical competency in the course of their fellowship period within the duty component of 25%.

No one can be appointed for more than one Postdoctoral Research Fellowship at the University of Oslo.

The position is bounded to the SURE-AI consortium agreement and its research scopes. The Centre for Sustainable, Risk-Averse, and Ethical AI or SURE-AI is a Norwegian AI centre funded by the Research Council of Norway (2025-2030). The primary objective is to create a new generation of algorithms for inference and decision-making by pushing the boundaries of the underlying computational techniques. SURE-AI researchers will drive a transformative leap in AI through a groundbreaking Centre initiative dedicated to making Artificial Intelligence more efficient, transparent and safe, addressing the critical challenges of resource consumption, behaviour unpredictability and ethical alignment with human and societal values. The centre involves senior researchers from well-renowned national and international research institutions, in close collaboration with industry and public sector. Overall, SURE-AI includes 19 national Norwegian partners, as well as researchers from 15 international institutions.

Six national research centres for Artificial Intelligence (AI) were launched in the Fall of 2025. These centres will foster interdisciplinary collaboration among researchers to address both scientific and societal challenges, develop new technologies, understand the impact of AI, and drive innovation across both the business and public sectors. This initiative is established and financed through the government's significant investment in artificial intelligence over the next five years

The present postdoctoral position is hosted at the Department of Mathematics, at Blindern campus in Oslo, which is the place of work.


Project description

The position is framed in the strongly interdisciplinary research group of Risk and Stochastics and the Community of SURE-AI. The focus is on the development of original mathematical methods for AI and its applications aimed at the modelling and analysis of complex phenomena particularly within economics and finance, energy finance, sustainable and ethical economics and insurance. 

We are interested in research projects that are deeply grounded in stochastic analysis and show also development of computational methods towards machine learning. The projects will focus on applications to risk-sensitive decision making and control, with the potential to address ethical and human alignment in machine learning research.

For this, candidates with a strong background in the areas of stochastic analysis, Malliavin calculus, forward and backward stochastic differential equations, signature methods, filtering, machine learning and computational stochastics are particularly welcome and are prioritized. Clear interest in computational methods towards applications is appreciated.

We are interested in candidates that can merge into an internationally oriented group with high ambitions in research excellency. It is expected that the fellow takes active part in both the research development and the group’s activities. 

The main purpose of a postdoctoral fellowship is to provide the candidates with enhanced skills to pursue a scientific top position within or beyond academia. To promote a strategic career path, all postdoctoral research fellows are required to submit a professional development plan no later than one month after commencement of the postdoctoral period.


What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Applicants must hold a degree equivalent to a Norwegian doctoral degree in stochastic analysis, probability or mathematical statistics, numerical methods for stochastics, forward and/or backward stochastic differential equations, stochastic control, stochastic filtering. Doctoral dissertation must be submitted for evaluation by the closing date. Only applicants with an approved doctoral thesis and public defence are eligible for appointment.
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English.

Desired qualifications:

  • Interdisciplinary research experience and/or attitude in the relevant areas is an advantage. 
  • Knowledge of computational methods for stochastics and programming skills.
  • Knowledge in one or more of the following areas: Malliavin calculus, stochastic filtering, risk measures, signature methods.
  • Knowledge of a Scandinavian language may be an advantage for teaching and supervision (if applicable)

UiO is subject to the Security Act, which governs the organisation's protection of security-sensitive objects and knowledge, in addition to other relevant legislation concerning access to and handling of sensitive information. Based on this, it is a requirement that successful applicants are security-eligible. We may use background checks as part of our recruitment process.


What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

The fellow is expected to take part in the activities of the Section of Risk and Stochastics. We are expecting a person able to work in structured manner both independently and as part of a team, swiftly adapting to new tasks. In general, a positive attitude and the ability to handle hectic periods is an advantage. A genuine interest in taking part in the various aspects of the academic life with collaborative and pro-active attitude is highly appreciated. 
Good communication skills are important.

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal skills.


We can offer you
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.  
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities
  • Postdoctoral development programmes.
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes
  • Salary in position as Postdoctoral Fellow, position code 1352 in salary range NOK 595 000 - 690 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund

We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. 

We hope you will apply for the position with us.


How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter (statement of motivation, summarizing scientific work and research interest)
  • Project description (no more than 3 pages, excluding references)
  • CV (summarizing education, positions, pedagogical experience, administrative experience and other qualifying activity)
  • Copies of educational certificates, academic transcript of records
  • A complete list of publications and up to 5 academic works that the applicant wishes to be considered by the evaluation committee
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and telephone number)

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

The best qualified candidates will be invited for interviews.

Please see the guidelines and regulations for appointments to Postdoctoral fellowships at the University of Oslo.

If an applicant has applied for and been granted funding for a fulltime research stay abroad while being employed as a Postdoctoral Research Fellow, the employment will be prolonged with the equivalent time as the research stay, but for no longer than of twelve months ( thus extending the employment to a maximum of four years)

No one can be appointed twice as a Postdoctoral fellow financed with funds from The Research Council of Norway (NFR).

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we can't, you will hear from us.

The University of Oslo has an agreement for all employees, aiming to secure rights to research results a.o.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society. 

The Department of Mathematics is part of the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences at the University of Oslo. The Department is engaged in teaching and research covering a wide spectrum of subjects within mathematics, mechanics and statistics. The research is on theory, methods and applications. The areas represented include: fluid mechanics, biomechanics, statistics and data science, computational mathematics, combinatorics, partial differential equations, stochastics and risk, algebra, geometry, topology, operator algebras, complex analysis and logic.

We have almost 50 persons in permanent academic positions and a large number of post docs and Ph.D. students. We also have an administrative and technical staff. The department represents a leading research environment in mathematical areas in Norway, and has a highly international profile.

Ruukki Construction aims to drive the construction industry towards carbon neutrality with its products. Our 1,350 employees in 10 European countries and 14 specialized manufacturing sites provide steel-based building products and services for roofs and walls in sustainable buildings. We serve our customers locally under our main brands Ruukki and Plannja. Our net sales in 2024 were approximately EUR 481 million. We are of Nordic origin and share our values and long experience in the steel and construction industry with our parent company SSAB.

Do you want to be part of building a more sustainable future and be part of a professional and successful team in an international company? Maybe this is your new challenge!

We are looking fora strategic minded and hands-on Area IT Manager to manage local IT development and support activities in Finland and to oversee our regional IT operations across Ruukki locations in Central Eastern Europe. This role combines leadership, operational responsibility, and strategic execution in a dynamic international environment.

We are looking for a strategic minded and hands-on Area IT Manager to manage local IT development and support activities in Finland and to oversee our regional IT operations across Ruukki locations in Central Eastern Europe. This role combines leadership, operational responsibility, and strategic execution in a dynamic international environment.

The role has two main managerial responsibility areas; Firstly, oversee local IT development and support activities in Finland, ensuring business continuity from the IT perspective. And in this context act as line manager for the area IT team: manage performance, recruitment, budgeting, and other HR responsibilities. Secondly, you will lead a team of regional IT managers in Central and Eastern Europe: you will set goals, monitor progress, optimize resource allocation and ensure that best practices are evaluated and implemented as part of the knowledge sharing process.

All in all, you will contribute to the implementation of Ruukkis IT and business strategies and roadmaps. And when fit for purpose act as project manager for selected initiatives, such as IT and production capability development, acquisitions, and carve-outs.

The preferred location is Alajärvi, or any of our location in South Ostrobothnia, Finland.

Ensure day-to-day IT support and development activities are aligned with Ruukki and SSAB IT policies (executed by internal teams and external vendors).

Lead the development of the Area Europe IT roadmap and resource planning.

Manage team-level IT costs, including annual budgeting and development proposals.

Oversee contracts and vendor management, including invoicing.

Collaborate with SSAB common IT on infrastructure and application development.

Define and implement collaboration models with business stakeholders across Europe.

Act as a general point of contact for infrastructure-related topics within Ruukki Construction IT management.

What we are looking for

· Strong knowledge of business applications and IT infrastructure (including security).

· Experience in strategy and roadmap execution.

· Solid understanding of business process development.

· Strong project management skills.

· Familiarity with agile methodologies and service delivery frameworks (e.g., ITIL).

· Proven vendor management skills.

· Strong leadership and team management capabilities.

· Has excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.

· The ideal candidate communicates fluently in Finnish and in English both written and oral.

We Offer

Our workplace fosters collaboration and personal growth, and everything we do is guided by our commitment to sustainability. Safety, innovation and reliability are at the heart of our business and ensure that everyone in our community thrives. Great colleagues and a supportive work community. Healthy work-life-balance and flexibility (hybrid working model). Lunch and wellbeing benefits. Occupational health services and much more!

Location

Your home base will be Ruukki Alajärvi (South Ostrobothnia) Finland. Some domestic and international travel is required.

jobs.title: Bilklargjører søkes til Innlandet Bilutleie – 60 % stilling, førerkort klasse B kreves

Vi søker en effektiv og pålitelig bilklargjører til vårt team i Gjøvik. Hos oss får du en variert og fysisk arbeidshverdag med klargjøring av leiebiler, og vi ser etter deg som liker å jobbe praktisk, effektivt og nøye. Erfaring er ikke nødvendig – opplæring gis.

Hva vi ser etter

Vi ser etter deg som er nøye, pålitelig og tar stolthet i arbeidet du gjør. En bil skal ikke bare se ren ut -- den skal være ordentlig klargjort og klar for neste kunde.

Du må være grundig og ha et godt øye for detaljer, både når det gjelder vask og når du kontrollerer bilen for skader eller andre avvik. Vi ser også etter deg som tar ansvar, jobber selvstendig og sier ifra dersom du oppdager noe som ikke er som det skal.

Du trenger ikke ha erfaring fra bilutleie eller bilpleie fra før. Det viktigste er at du er lærevillig, effektiv og opptatt av å gjøre en skikkelig jobb.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Innlandet Bilutleie søker bilvasker / bilklargjører i Gjøvik

Vi søker en pålitelig og effektiv medarbeider til vask og klargjøring av våre leiebiler.

Arbeidsdagen vil hovedsakelig bestå av:

  • Innvendig og utvendig vask av biler

  • Støvsuging og rengjøring

  • Klargjøring og enkel kontroll av biler før utleie

  • Flytting av biler og andre praktiske oppgaver knyttet til bilparken

Vi ser etter deg som:

  • Er pålitelig og møter til avtalt tid

  • Jobber effektivt og er opptatt av et godt resultat

  • Trives med fysisk arbeid og høyt tempo

  • Kan jobbe selvstendig, men også fungerer godt sammen med andre

  • Har førerkort klasse B -- dette er et krav

Tidligere erfaring med bilpleie eller klargjøring er en fordel, men ikke nødvendig. Du vil få nødvendig opplæring.

Stillingen er i utgangspunktet ca. 60 %, tilsvarende omtrent tre arbeidsdager i uken. Arbeidstid og konkrete dager avtales nærmere.

Vi ønsker en person som kan starte så snart som mulig.

Du trenger ikke skrive en lang søknad. Send oss noen korte ord om deg selv, når du kan starte og telefonnummeret ditt.

Arbeidssted: Gjøvik

jobs.title: Raskaan kaluston asentaja (Pohjois-Pirkanmaa)
jobs.description:
Etsimme Pohjois-Pirkanmaalla sijaitsevalle asiakasyrityksellemme RASKAAN KALUSTON ASENTAJAA kokoaikaiseen ja vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Mikäli sinulla on kokemusta raskaan kaluston huolto- ja asennustöistä sekä vahva ymmärrys hydrauliikasta ja mekaniikasta, saatat olla juuri etsimämme osaaja.

Työtehtäväsi koostuvat kuorma-autojen katsastusremonteista, joissa vastaat mm. jarrujen ja ohjauslaitteiden tarkastamisesta, asentamisesta ja huoltamisesta. Työnkuva sisältää myös hitsaamista, joten MIG-hitsaustaitoa tarvitaan, ja mahdollinen puikkohitsaustaito koetaan eduksesi. Työaika on joustava arkisin maanantaista perjantaihin (40 h/vko), joten sinulla on mahdollista sovitella itse työaikasi viikkotuntien sisälle.

Toivomme sinulta:

\- kokemusta raskaan kaluston asennuksesta ja huollosta

\- kykyä etsiä ja ratkaista teknisiä ongelmia

\- osaamista hydrauliikasta ja mekaniikasta

\- kokemusta vianhausta sekä koneiden testauksesta

Tarjoamme sinulle:

\- kokoaikaisen ja vakituisen työsuhteen vakaassa yrityksessä

\- monipuoliset ja teknisesti mielenkiintoiset työtehtävät

\- kattavan työterveyshuollon

\- osaamisesi huomioivan palkan, kerrothan rohkeasti palkkatoiveesi

\- tarvittavat työvarusteet ja -vaatteet

\- mukavan työyhteisön

\- Clickiltä asianmukaisen ja tunnetusti hyvän tuen koko työsuhteesi ajaksi

Kiinnostuitko tehtävästä? Jos kyllä, niin kuulisin sinusta mielelläni! Täytä hakemus pikimmiten oheisen linkin kautta. Kerro hakemuksessasi mahdollisimman tarkasti osaamisestasi ja aikaisemmasta työkokemuksestasi. Jos sinulla tulee mitä vain kysyttävää työtehtävään liittyen, soita rohkeasti! Kaikki lisätiedot tehtävästä puhelimitse arkisin klo 9.00-16.00 rekrytointikonsultti Noora Aleniukselta 050 411 6508 tai voit myös laittaa hakemuksesi CV:n kera sähköpostiini joka on muotoa etunimi.sukunimi@click-hp.fi.

jobs.title: Assistant or Associate Professor in Social Work (Tenure Track Levels 1-2) or Professor of Social Work
jobs.description:
The University of Lapland invites applications for the position of Assistant or Associate Professor in Social Work (Tenure Track Levels 1-2) or Professor of Social Work.

The research profile of the position focuses on social and health care service systems, the effectiveness of social work, and information and knowledge practices in social work. Global and societal transformations are reshaping professional social work practice and welfare service systems. At the same time, digital technologies and artificial intelligence are significantly changing knowledge practices, information management, and the organization of social work within service systems.

These developments raise new questions related to social justice, ethics, and professional values, creating a need for critical scholarly inquiry and the strengthening of the research base of social work through interdisciplinary and international collaboration. The Assistant/Associate Professor/Professor is expected to provide academic leadership in research, monitor developments in the discipline, and contribute to societal engagement, international collaboration, and scholarly networks in social work. The position includes responsibility for teaching and curriculum development, particularly in courses related to social and health care service systems and social policy at the bachelor's, master's, and doctoral levels. The successful candidate will supervise theses and doctoral dissertations and contribute to the development of teaching in collaboration with the degree programme staff.

The duties also include active collaboration with other faculties of the University of Lapland. The appointee will further strengthen international networks in research and education and participate in programme planning, administration, and academic governance. The position is located in the Discipline of Social Work, Faculty of Social Sciences, University of Lapland. The discipline provides a multidisciplinary and dynamic academic environment. The Faculty of Social Sciences offers nationally recognized education and research in several social science disciplines through four degree programmes and seven major fields of study. The position offers an opportunity to build and lead a nationally and internationally high-quality research in collaboration with the faculty's research communities and other faculties of the University. The successful candidate will be actively supported in applying for competitive research funding, building international research networks, and preparing interdisciplinary research projects.

The position requires regular presence at the University of Lapland campus in Rovaniemi.

We offer

- An excellent academic community

- Diverse and inspiring tasks in research and education

- The stability and support of a well-established university

- Modern working facilities and tools

- Opportunities for professional development and career advancement

- Support from experienced colleagues and expert teams

- Comprehensive occupational health care

- Sports, culture, and wellbeing benefits.

The University of Lapland offers a unique research and working environment characterized by northern social issues, the development of welfare services, international collaboration, and Arctic perspectives in social science research.

We expect

Applicants are required to hold a doctoral degree in Social Work and possess expertise in social work acquired through academic education and research. The position further requires the ability and motivation to develop multidisciplinary and interdisciplinary research collaboration within the university community as well as nationally and internationally.

In addition, applicants are expected to demonstrate experience in research projects related to:

- social and health care service systems

- the effectiveness of social work

- information management

- information and knowledge practices or

- digital environments and transformations in social work.

Applicants are expected to have a good command of English. Knowledge of Finnish or strong motivation to learn Finnish is also required. For an international applicant or a non-native Finnish speaker, reasonable proficiency in Finnish may be required within five years of appointment, if necessary. The University of Lapland supports international staff members in their integration into the university community and in learning Finnish. According to Section 30 of the University of Lapland Regulations, the criteria and evaluation procedures for Assistant Professorships (Assistant Professor and Associate Professor levels) are defined within the University's Tenure Track model.

Additional merits include

- University pedagogical studies, teacher education studies, or other demonstrated pedagogical merits

- Evidence of multidisciplinary or interdisciplinary research collaboration within the academic community, nationally, or internationally

Recruitment level and evaluation criteria

The position may be filled at the level of Assistant/Associate Professor (Tenure Track Level 1 or Level 2) or Professor, depending on the qualifications, achievements, and career stage of the selected candidate.

Application

The following documentation must be submitted along with the application:

- Curriculum Vitae according to the [model of the Finnish Advisory Board on Research Integrity](https://tenk.fi/en/advice-and-materials/template-researchers-curriculum-vitae) (TENK)

- List of publications according to the guidelines of the Research Council of Finland

- [Teaching portfolio](https://lucit.sharepoint.com/sites/Julkisettiedostot/Lapin%20yliopiston%20julkiset%20tiedostot/Forms/AllItems.aspx?id=%2Fsites%2FJulkisettiedostot%2FLapin%20yliopiston%20julkiset%20tiedostot%2FHenkil%C3%B6st%C3%B6palvelut%2FInstructions%20for%20the%20teaching%20portfolio%2Epdf&parent=%2Fsites%2FJulkisettiedostot%2FLapin%20yliopiston%20julkiset%20tiedostot%2FHenkil%C3%B6st%C3%B6palvelut&p=true&ga=1) containing a development plan concerning future activity

jobs.title: Myyjä S-market Viinijärvi määräaikainen työsuhde
jobs.description:
Primary location:
LIPERI

Haemme myyjää S-market Viinijärvelle määräaikaiseen työsuhteeseen 31.10.2027 saakka. Työtunteja tarjoamme sinulle 25 h/viikko. Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan mahdollisimman pian.

Haemme henkilöä, joilla hymy tulee luonnostaan, onhan meillä PKO:n vähittäiskaupassa kantavana ajatuksena hyvä mieli hymyllä. Ajattelemme, että hymy on asiakaskokemuksen mittari ja hymyn positiiviset vaikutukset eivät jää ainoastaan sen kantajaan.
Toivomme siis, että sinä nautit asiakaskohtaamisista ja siitä, että saat työskennellä ihmisten parissa. Sinun asenteesi on positiivinen ja reipas, oma-aloitteinen työote on osa jokaista työpäivääsi.

Odotamme, että sinulla on hyvät asiakaspalvelu- ja vuorovaikutustaidot sekä kyky itsenäiseen työskentelyyn. Työ marketissamme on vuorotyötä, joka tarjoaa sinulle mahdollisuuden vaihteleviin työvuoroihin ja joustavaan arkeen.
Kaupallinen koulutus antaa hyvän perustan tekemiselle, mutta arvostamme erityisesti oikeaa asennetta ja tahtotilaa palvella asiakkaita laadukkaasti. Katsomme eduksi aiemman kokemuksen asiakaspalvelutyöstä vähittäiskaupassa ja kaupan erilaisista tehtävistä, kuitenkaan aikaisempi kokemus ei ole välttämätöntä. Tärkeintä on oma-aloitteinen ote työhön, joustavuus ja halu tehdä työtä tiimissämme. Perehdytämme sinut kaikkiin tehtäviin ja erilaisiin työvuoroihin sekä opastamme onnistumisiin pitkin matkaa.

Me tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen työnkuvan, kivan työporukan sekä mahdollisuuden edetä halutessasi urallasi. Sinä saat käyttöösi sekä S-ryhmän että PKO:n erittäin hyvät, jopa Suomen parhaaksi kutsutut, henkilöstöedut (https://pko.fi/toissa-meilla/palkka-ja-edut).
PKO tarjoaa myös keskimääräistä laajemmat ja kattavammat työterveyspalvelut ja työntekijämme ovat vakuutettu myös työajan ulkopuolella vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutuksella.

Hakuaika tehtävään päättyy 16.10.2026. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa marketpäällikkö Sanna-Riina Rouvari p. 010762 2820 arkisin 9-15 välillä tai sähköpostitsesanna-riina.rouvari@sok.fi.
