jobs.title: (Senior) Data Engineer (Snowflake) – Building and Technical Trade, K Group
jobs.description:
Snowflake is becoming the foundation of Building and Technical Trade's future data ecosystem. As a (Senior) Data Engineer, you'll help define how data is modelled, built and utilized across analytics, AI and business development. Rather than joining a fully established environment, you'll have a rare opportunity to influence the development practices, data models and technical standards that will shape our future data platform. We are open to candidates from experienced Data Engineer to Senior Data Engineer level. The exact scope and level of responsibility can be shaped based on your background and expertise.

You will work as part of Kesko's Central Data & Analytics Platforms team while collaborating closely with Building and Technical Trade's Data, AI and ESG team. Together with BI analysts, analytics engineers, data experts and business stakeholders, you'll turn business needs into scalable and reliable data solutions that support both daily decision-making and future growth. We are working in a hybrid workplace model where we combine office days at K Kampus in Kalasatama and remote work to best suit both the role and the team. Come and join our professional team and start building your own kind of career in K Group!

What is the role about?

As a (Senior) Data Engineer, you will be a key data expert helping BTT build a modern Snowflake-based data foundation for analytics, AI and business development. This is a hands-on senior role with strong architectural influence: you will help shape how Snowflake development is done in BTT, while working closely with the BTT Data, AI and ESG team and Keskos central data platform experts. In addition to building solutions, you will help grow the teams Snowflake capabilities through collaboration, mentoring and practical examples.

Your key responsibilities include:
- Technical ownership: owning the technical direction of BTTs Snowflake solutions and ensuring that solutions are reliable, maintainable and aligned with agreed platform principles - Best practices and architecture: defining BTTs Snowflake development practices, including modelling approach, warehouse strategy, documentation, quality and maintainability, while contributing to the broader data architecture and innovation - Mentoring and collaborating: coaching BTT data team members towards stronger Snowflake competence, collaborating with BI analysts, analytics engineers and business stakeholders, and translating business needs into practical data solutions - Building solutions: designing, building and optimizing scalable dbt-based data pipelines, transformations and logical and physical data models



Who are we looking for?

We are looking for an experienced data engineer who enjoys hands-on building but also thinks about the bigger picture, and who genuinely wants to help others grow.

We are not looking for unicorns, but the more of below capabilities are found the better youd fit to the ideal candidate profile:
- Snowflake, dbt and SQL: strong hands-on experience in data engineering with Snowflake, proficiency with dbt for transformations, efficient SQL skills and solid data modelling capability. (This one is actually mandatory) - Modern engineering practices: experience with version control, CI/CD pipelines and a DevOps mindset in a data context; what we develop, we also support. - Background in data warehousing/ETL: You have designed or maintained data pipelines with different technologies. Experience with SAP BW data models and transformations is beneficial, as it helps in understanding our legacy environment. - Data management mindset: Familiarity with data cataloging, lineage tools, semantic views, or overall data governance frameworks. You care about documentation and data quality. - Big picture view: the ability to make sound technical choices across source data, data modelling, transformations and reporting needs, not just build individual pipelines. - Mentoring ability: experience and motivation in sharing knowledge, supporting colleagues and contributing to the development of data engineering practices - AI mindset: interest in leveraging AI to speed up and improve development and maintenance processes - Communication: excellent teamwork and communication skills, and the ability to explain complex data topics to both technical and non-technical colleagues. Fluency in English is required (our working language). Finnish or other Nordic language skills are beneficial but not necessary. - Self-driven and proactive attitude: You take initiative to improve things and arent afraid to suggest new ideas. You are solution-oriented and able to work independently when needed, but also know when to ask for help or input. - Relevant experience with SAP, Aspect4 or web-based business application data as well as familiarity with chain-operated wholesale and/or merchant-led retail business models, especially in the building and technical trade sector










Please note that the role is in Finland and you will need the existing right to work here. Kesko is unable to sponsor work permits or visas.

Why join us?

We offer you the chance to work in a key role, building a modern data platform in a large and diverse organization. Rather than stepping into a fully established environment, you'll have a rare opportunity to help define the development standards, modelling principles and engineering practices that will shape how BTT utilizes Keskos Snowflake platform.

With us you get:
- a genuinely impactful, hands-on role in building our Snowflake data platform from the ground up - a supportive community of expert colleagues in both BTT and Keskos central data teams - the opportunity to influence the technical direction, best practices and ways of working of our future data platform - modern work tools and numerous opportunities to learn, develop and grow your career in a large, international organization - extensive K Group employee benefits, including a mobile-phone benefit, culture, well-being and sports benefit (ePassi Flex), staff discounts in K Group stores, own occupational health care, leisure-time accident insurance, and a car benefit according to our company policy. - partner benefits related to optical stores, accommodation and travel, as well as sports and wellbeing services - a flexible hybrid working model with at least one office day per week

jobs.description:
Har du lyst til at arbejde med installationsopgaver hos nogle af Danmarks største industrivirksomheder? Og sætter du en ære i at levere solidt håndværk, hvor kvalitet og samarbejde er i fokus? Så kan du blive en del af vores voksende industriafdeling hos Viftrup Jespersen A/S.

Et arbejde med mening og ansvar

Vi har travlt og udvider derfor teamet i vores industriafdeling. Her arbejder vi tæt sammen med store fødevareproducenter og leverer tekniske løsninger, der holder produktionen i gang. Det kræver faglighed og ansvarlighed – og det er netop dét, vi leder efter.

Du får din daglige base i Videbæk og bliver en del af et stærkt hold, hvor samarbejde, ordentlighed og godt håndværk går hånd i hånd. Dine opgaver vil primært være hos én af vores største industrikunder.

”Hos os får du mere indflydelse på dine opgaver og en tættere relation til både kolleger og ledelse, end du finder mange andre steder.”
– Anders Elkjær, ejer

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Som en del af industriafdelingen vil du arbejde med:

  • Installation og montage af el-tekniske løsninger

  • Opsætning af føringsveje og kabelføring

  • Automationsopgaver og mindre styretavlearbejde

  • Servicering og vedligehold af installationer

  • Deltagelse i både projekter og løbende drift

Du vil samarbejde med både vores egne teknikere og kundens projektledere. Vi sørger for grundig oplæring og introduktion til opgaver og arbejdsgange.

Faglig udvikling og et stærkt fællesskab

Hos os er der plads til at udvikle sig. Vi starter dig op med mindre opgaver og bygger gradvist på, i takt med at du bliver fortrolig med arbejdsgangene. Har du ambitioner, støtter vi gerne op med relevante kurser og efteruddannelse.

Vi er et team, der hjælper hinanden – både fagligt og socialt. Vores personaleforening arrangerer jævnligt aktiviteter, og vi prioriterer et arbejdsmiljø, hvor alle trives.

Hvad vi forventer af dig

Vi leder efter en kollega, som:

  • er fagligt stærk og arbejder med kvalitet og struktur

  • er mødestabil og ansvarsbevidst

  • har lyst til at samarbejde og tage ejerskab i opgaverne

Du har sandsynligvis en baggrund som elektriker, industrielektriker eller automatiktekniker – og gerne erfaring med industriinstallationer.

Det får du hos os

Udover spændende opgaver og et godt fællesskab tilbyder vi:

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer

  • Fastansættelse i en stabil virksomhed

  • Overenskomst, pension og sundhedsforsikring

  • Lokale goder som fx rabat på fitness og svømmehal

  • Mulighed for efteruddannelse

 

Interesseret?

Er du klar til at tage ansvar for, at vi lever op til vores kunders høje forventninger? Så send CV og ansøgning til Jette på jcl@viftrup.dk Vi vurderer kandidater og indkalder til samtaler løbende. Vi ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat, så send din ansøgning hurtigst muligt.

Vil du vide mere om dit nye job, så er du meget velkommen til at kontakte os på jcl@viftrup.dk eller 51200268.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Salgsassistent til Imerco Vordingborg - deltid
jobs.description:
Kunne du tænke dig at blive en del af Danmarks største kæde indenfor køkken, gaver og bord?

Hos Imerco Vordingborg bliver du en del af et team, som engagerer sig for at skabe gode og mindeværdige oplevelser for vores kunder.

Har du appetit på Imerco?

Så tilbyder vi dig en stilling som salgsassistent hvor du: 

  • Får en uforudsigelig hverdag med masser af udfordringer
  • Bliver en del af et ambitiøst og fagligt stærkt team
  • Skal sælge nogle af Danmarks stærkeste brands.

Din hverdag som salgsassistent:

Som salgsassistent i Imerco Vordingborg bliver det din opgave, at henvende dig til vores kunder og yde en førsteklasses service, hvor du rådgiver dem om vores produkter, så de forlader butikken med en god oplevelse – og alle de relevante produkter.

Andre opgaver vil være at:

  • Være med til salgsfremmende aktiviteter
  • Sikre at butikken fremstår salgs- og kampagneklar, herunder indbydende udstillinger
  • Modtage og fylde varer op i butikken, samt holde orden på lager og baglokaler
  • Stå for lagerstyring og behandling af reklamationer

Bidrag med din erfaring:

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har gode salgsevner. Du ved, hvordan man sælger mere en blot et produkt ved at skabe en unik kundeoplevelse - du aflæser kundens behov og guider dem til det rigtige valg.
  • Trives i at arbejde i højt tempo og kan bevare overblikket, selv når der er travlt.
  • Har erfaring med detailhandel
  • Har kendskab til isenkram – det er en fordel, men er ikke et krav.

Hvis du er vores nye kollega i Imerco Vordingborg, glæder vi os til at nyde stor gavn af din viden indenfor detailhandel samt din evne til at arbejde selvstændigt og gribe de daglige udfordringer. Vi kan tilbyde en stilling på 32 timer ugentligt.

Vi tilbyder desuden:

  • Pensionsordning
  • Sundhedsforsikring
  • Personalekøbsordning
  • Øvrige rabatordninger

Hvis du har spørgsmål til jobbet, er du velkommen til at kontakte os. Du finder kontakt informationerne til højre i annoncen. 

Vi forbeholder os retten til at fjerne jobopslag før sidste frist, såfremt den rette kandidat er fundet.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Architect
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Forward Deployed Architect on Notion’s Services team, you will help customers turn AI ambition into operational reality and unlock the full potential of our platform. You will partner directly with customers to design, build, and launch AI-native workflows that drive adoption, usage, and measurable business outcomes.

This role sits at the center of Notion’s workflow-led GTM motion. You will partner directly with customers to understand their business goals, operating processes, technical environment, governance needs, and adoption barriers, then translate that context into scalable Notion architectures that drive measurable value.

You will be hands-on across discovery, solution design, workspace architecture, workflow build, AI implementation, launch planning, adoption and handoff. You will work deeply with customers to define what Notion should own, where it should integrate with existing systems, and how Notion can become a durable operating layer for their teams.

The best candidates combine strong consultative discovery, systems thinking, technical fluency, AI-native workflow design, implementation judgment and exceptional customer presence. You should be comfortable reasoning through technical tradeoffs, designing scalable solutions, and partnering closely with Forward Deployed Engineering when deeper engineering support is required.

In this role, you own the engagement outcome. You will lead our most complex, multi-workstream engagements in Korea, decide when Forward Deployed Engineers are needed for code-intensive work, and coach others to raise the bar across our Services practice.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Lead Notion’s most complex, multi-workstream customer engagements in Korea end to end, from scoping and discovery through launch, adoption and handoff, often where the future state and success measures are not yet defined.

 - Shape Services scope, effort estimates and implementation strategy with account teams during pre-sales, then deliver against the agreed scope, timeline and outcomes, recovering engagements that go off track.

 - Drive executive alignment on ambiguous, high-stakes decisions: facilitate discovery and architecture workshops, frame tradeoffs clearly and deliver hard messages directly.

 - Decide where Notion should own, complement or connect to existing systems, and design scalable architectures and AI-native workflows to a production quality bar, including permission design, AI evaluation, human-in-the-loop controls and operational ownership.

 - Orchestrate Forward Deployed Engineers, partners and internal teams: define when deeper engineering is required and set clear scope, ownership and handoffs.

 - Lead change management and adoption through stakeholder alignment, champion programs, phased rollouts and enablement, so customer teams sustain usage and realize measurable value.

 - Coach other architects and partners, and scale the Korea Services practice through reusable reference architectures, packaged solutions and localized enablement.

 - Turn field patterns into evidence-backed product signals (customer pain, business impact, expected outcome and frequency) that influence Notion’s roadmap.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - 5+ years of experience in tech services/consulting, solutions architecture, implementation, customer engineering, or a similar customer-facing role.

 - Proven ability to translate ambiguous customer goals into clear workflows, implementation plans, solution architectures, and measurable success criteria.

 - Strong consultative discovery skills, including the ability to map current-state workflows, identify customer pain, understand operating models, surface technical constraints, and define practical future-state solutions.

 - Hands-on AI builder mindset, with experience using AI tools to design, prototype, automate, or improve real business workflows.

 - Proven track record of designing and deploying AI-powered workflows or agents in production for customers.

 - Hands-on technical depth in data modeling and permission design, API and integration patterns, agent design and evaluation, enterprise security and governance, and data validation with SQL or scripts. You do not need to write production code.

 - Strong experience delivering implementations that drive adoption, change management and long-term customer value.

 - Strong project and engagement management skills, including ownership of scope, timeline, deliverables, stakeholder alignment, risks, decisions, dependencies and launch readiness.

 - Experience scoping Services work, estimating effort and delivering within agreed commercial boundaries.

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for business, technical, and executive audiences.

 - Strong executive presence and customer judgment, with the ability to build trust, frame tradeoffs clearly, and move ambiguous decisions forward.

 - Experience coaching consultants or architects, and building methods, reference architectures or packaged services that others adopt.

 - Bias toward action, high learning velocity, and comfort building in fast-changing AI-native product environments.

 - Professional fluency in Korean and English.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience with Notion, APIs, MCPs, Workers, coding agents or developer platform workflows.

 - Experience delivering for large Korean enterprises and navigating complex, multi-stakeholder decision processes.

 - Experience enabling or co-delivering with implementation partners.

 - Previous experience in a fast-paced, high-growth technology environment.




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: AUTOMEKAANIKKO – EKODRIVE OY, KERAVA
jobs.description:
**AUTOMEKAANIKKO – EKODRIVE OY, KERAVA**

Ekodrive Oy etsii **itsenäistä ja vastuullista automekaanikkoa** pitkäaikaiseen työsuhteeseen Keravalle.

Työvoiman tarve on arviolta **loka–marraskuussa 2026**, mutta etsimme sopivaa henkilöä jo nyt. Jos olet tällä hetkellä töissä mutta harkitset työpaikan vaihtoa myöhemmin syksyllä, voit myös ottaa yhteyttä.

Etsimme mekaanikkoa, joka pystyy hoitamaan tavallisia korjaamotöitä itsenäisesti, tekee työnsä loppuun sovitussa ajassa ja **kantaa vastuun työnsä lopputuloksesta**.

Työhön kuuluu mm.

- määräaikaishuollot ja öljynvaihdot

- jarrujen huolto ja korjaus

- alustan ja ohjauksen korjaukset

- katsastuskorjaukset

- moottori- ja vaihteistoöljyjen vaihdot

- jakohihnojen ja jakopään osien vaihdot

- vikojen etsintä ja perusdiagnostiikka

- rengastyöt

- ilmastointihuollot

- muut tavalliset henkilöautojen korjaamotyöt


Sinun ei tarvitse osata kaikkea, mutta **tavalliset korjaamotyöt pitää pystyä tekemään itsenäisesti**.

Arvostamme mekaanikkoa, joka osaa ajatella käytännöllisesti: vika tutkitaan, korjataan järkevällä tavalla ja työ saatetaan loppuun ilman tarpeetonta asioiden monimutkaistamista.

Odotamme sinulta

- B-luokan ajokorttia

- vastuullisuutta ja luotettavuutta

- oma-aloitteista työotetta

- kykyä tehdä päätöksiä oman työn yhteydessä

- kiinnostusta autoihin ja korjaamiseen

- halua kehittää omaa ammattitaitoa

- kykyä työskennellä normaalisti osana pientä työporukkaa


**Autosähkön, diagnostiikan ja hitsauksen osaaminen on selvä etu.**

Aikaisempi työkokemus autokorjaamolta ja suomen kielen taito ovat plussaa. Työpaikalla voidaan kommunikoida **suomeksi tai venäjäksi**.

Meillä arvostetaan hyvää työilmapiiriä, keskinäistä kunnioitusta ja sitä, että jokainen hoitaa oman työnsä kunnolla.

Meille asiakkaan auto on tärkeä riippumatta sen merkistä, iästä tai arvosta. **Jokainen auto on asiakkaalle tärkeä ja meille työtä.**

Tarjoamme

- vakituisen työn sopivalle henkilölle

- työajan **37,5 h/vko**

- ma–pe **klo 8.00–16.00**

- 6 kuukauden koeajan

- pienen ja kehittyvän työyhteisön

- mahdollisuuden saada enemmän vastuuta ja kehittyä yrityksen kasvaessa

- palkka: **kerro palkkatoiveesi**


Myös **oppilaitoksen kautta tuleva työharjoittelu tai virallinen työkokeilu** voi olla mahdollinen, jos hakijalla on hyvä tekninen perusta, oikea asenne ja realistinen mahdollisuus jatkaa myöhemmin työntekijänä.

HAKEMINEN – VAIN SÄHKÖPOSTITSE

Puhelinhakemuksia emme käsittele.

Pitkää hakemusta ei tarvita. Lähetä lyhyt sähköposti **suomeksi tai venäjäksi** ja vastaa seuraaviin kysymyksiin:

1. Kuinka paljon sinulla on kokemusta automekaanikon työstä?

2. Mitkä korjaukset pystyt tekemään täysin itsenäisesti?

3. Oletko tehnyt jakohihnan/jakopään vaihtoja itsenäisesti?

4. Millainen kokemus sinulla on diagnostiikasta ja autosähköstä?

5. Onko sinulla kokemusta rengastöistä ja ilmastointihuolloista?

6. Onko sinulla voimassa oleva B-ajokortti?

7. Mikä on palkkatoiveesi?

8. Milloin voisit aloittaa?

9. Miksi etsit uutta työpaikkaa ja millaista työpaikkaa etsit pidemmällä aikavälillä?


**Hakemukset ja yhteydenotot ainoastaan sähköpostitse ekodrivepro@gmail.com**

**Ekodrive Oy Kerava**

jobs.description:
Are you a MIG MAG welder in the Salo Region? You could be the right fit for the role!

Location: Salo Region, Finland
Employment Type: Fixed-term contract, a possibility of permanent employment
Salary: 14 - 18 € / hour

We are looking for a MIG/MAG Welder for our client company for a long-term position in the Salo region. Our client is a manufacturer specializing in steel structures, turning their customers' ideas into finished products – from design and production to assembly and delivery. In this role, you will work with bigger metal products in a modern industrial environment.

Your role

You will get to MIG MAG weld in project that consists of large metal components with material thicknesses ranging from 5 to 25 mm. The work is performed in a clean and safe production environment in a two-shift system, Monday to Friday, 40 hours per week.

You will have access to high-quality tools and equipment and receive a thorough introduction to the company's products and working methods. If you are relocating from another area, we can assist with accommodation arrangements when needed.

As part of the recruitment process, candidates will complete a welding test at the client's premises.

What we expect from you

* Proven experience in MIG/MAG welding

* An unwavering commitment to attention to detail and quality

* Flexibility to work both morning and evening shifts

* English and/or Finnish language skill

* A valid work permit for Finland is a must

* Ability to read technical drawings

Considered an advantage

* Previous experience with welding heavy products and thick materials.

What we offer

* A stable, long-term position with a respected company in the metal industry

* Competitive hourly pay based on your experience and skills

* Salary and employment conditions based on the Finnish Technology Industry Collective Agreement

* Clean and safe working facilities with high-quality equipment

* Comprehensive onboarding and opportunities to further develop your skills

* Assistance with accommodation arrangements if needed

* Salary 14-18 € / hour depending on skills

About Wellpack

You will be employed by Wellpack, a personnel services company established in 2013. Wellpack is known as a trusted partner, particularly within the industrial and defence industry sectors. We connect skilled professionals with quality employers and contribute to building sustainable employment in Finland.

Apply now!

This is an ongoing recruitment process, and we fill positions as production grows and staffing needs arise. We review applications as they arrive and contact suitable candidates as positions become available.

Submit your application through the "Apply" link in the job advertisement. Your application will be stored in our recruitment system. In your application, be sure to tell about your previous work experience and skills.

For more information about the position, please contact Wellpack's recruitment team by email at wellpack@wellpack.fi [wellpack@wellpack.fi].

jobs.title: PhD Research Fellow in Bioinformatics and Computational Biology
jobs.description:
About the position

We invite applications for a position as PhD Research Fellow in bioinformatics and computational biology available at the Department of Clinical Molecular Biology (EpiGen), Campus Ahus, University of Oslo.

 

The preferred starting date is as soon as possible.

 

The fellowship period is three years and is free of any teaching obligations. No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo.

 

The position is based at the Department of Clinical Molecular Biology (EpiGen; https://epigenahuscom.wordpress.com/) at the University of Oslo, Ahus Campus, Lørenskog. EpiGen is a joint research unit established by the University of Oslo (UiO) and Akershus University Hospital (Ahus). It is actively involved in several major national research initiatives and provides an outstanding research environment with state-of-the-art laboratories and dedicated research facilities. The position is funded by the Research Council of Norway.

 

 

The successful candidate will join an interdisciplinary team of molecular biologists, bioinformaticians, physicists, and pathologists to develop a biophysically interpretable machine learning model that integrates diverse biological data—including transcription factor (TF)–DNA interactions, epigenetic features, and three-dimensional (3D) genome organization—to identify functional long-range gene regulatory interactions in cancer. The candidate will work with researchers at UiO, Ahus, and Oslo University Hospital (OUS), as well as by international collaborators in the United States. The research conducted during the appointment is expected to culminate in a PhD thesis submitted to the University of Oslo.

 

We seek a highly motivated candidate with a strong background in molecular biology, human genetics/genomics, data mining, machine learning, and computational programming. The ideal candidate will hold a Master's degree in bioinformatics or computational biology. Applicants with an MSc in physics, computer science, applied mathematics, or statistics are also encouraged to apply, provided they can demonstrate a strong interest and aptitude for learning molecular biology and human genetics.


More about the position

The project aims to develop novel computational methods and tools for predicting functional non-coding mutations in the cancer genome. These methods will integrate diverse sources of information, including the biophysical principles of protein–DNA interactions, the genetic and epigenetic features of DNA sequences, and the three-dimensional (3D) organization of the genome and its regulatory landscape. A particular focus will be on integrating multi-omics data generated from single-cell experiments to improve both predictive accuracy and biological interpretability.

 

The PhD research fellow will primarily focus on developing data mining methods such as network analysis in 3D genome regulation that integrate diverse biological information, including transcription factor (TF)–DNA interactions, epigenetic features, and 3D genome organization, to identify functional non-coding mutations and their targets in long-distance regions. Subsequently, the predictions will be validated in cancer by using both in vivo and in vitro experimental data.

 

Depending on the candidate's qualifications and the progress of the project, there may be an opportunity to undertake a 3–6-month research visit to the laboratory of one of our international collaborators in the United States. This visit will provide advanced training in computational approaches for studying single-cell 3D genome regulation and further strengthen the international collaboration.


What skills are important in this role?

Candidates for the PhD fellowships will be expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

 

Required qualifications:

  • To be admitted to the PhDprogramme at the University ofOslo, an applicant musthave a five-year master'sdegree or equivalent studiesthat the faculty have recognised as forminga sufficient basisfor admission.
  • The facultiesmay stipulate additional admission requirements.
  • To be employed as aPhD ResearchFellow, admission toa doctoral program is required,or a binding agreementfor admission must be in place. Normally, one must apply foradmission to a Ph.D. program within3 months after thestart of the research project leading tothe Ph.D. degree.
  • Good written and oral Englishproficiency.
  • Master's degree in bioinformatics or computational biology. Applicants with an MSc in physics, computer science, applied mathematics, or statistics are also encouraged to apply, provided they can demonstrate a strong interest and aptitude for learning molecular biology and the human genome.
  • Documented knowledge of statistical theory and methods, data mining, and machine learning methods.
  • Documented shell script, R, Python, and C programming skills. 
  • Documented experience in big data analysis.
  • Documented experience in high-throughput sequencing data analysis.

 

Language requirement:

  • Good written and oral English proficiency.
  • English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/ EEA countries and exemptions from the requirements:
  • https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8

 

Grade requirements:

  • The average grade point for the course in the Bachelor's degree must be C or better (Norwegian educational system)
  • The average grade point for the course in the Master's degree must be B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The Master's thesis must have the grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system

 

 

 

Personal qualities 

  • Academic and personal ability to finish tasks on time
  • Ability to work either independently or collaboratively in an interdisciplinary team
  • Self-motivated to learn, easily adapted to new tasks, and interested in solving challenging scientific problems.
  • Good communication skills and openness to new perspectives

 

Desired qualifications

  • Experience with ChIP-seq, ATAC-seq/scATAC-seq, RNA-seq/scRNA-seq, WGS, WGBS, or Hi-C data analysis.
  • Experience in computational genome studies (e.g., TF-DNA interactions, gene networks, DNA mutations, and histone modifications). 
  • Experience with integrated multi-omics data analysis.aaa

 

Employment in the position is basedon a comprehensive assessment of allqualification requirements applicable tothe position, including 

personal qualifications.


We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will provide appropriate accommodations should you need them. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us.

This is a remote role based in the United States, with travel to Notion offices, events, and other locations expected—up to 50% based on operational needs.




A GREAT TUESDAY:

 - Review regional differences in access control or visitor management and turn them into clear priorities for the global parity project.

 - Work with a vendor or building manager to resolve a security gap, balancing local context with global standards.

 - Draft an incident update, using AI to improve clarity, then validate the details and judgment behind the message.

 - Coordinate international project work while responding thoughtfully to an urgent operational issue.
   

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - By your 90th day, kick off a global physical security parity project that creates shared visibility into regional practices, gaps, and priorities.

 - By your 90th day, use AI to accelerate clear, effective communications, reduce busywork, and keep detail-heavy work accurate and reviewable.

 - By the end of your first year, take ownership of Notion’s physical security technology program, improving how systems, data, and operating practices support safe and resilient workplaces.

 - By the end of your first year, demonstrate program ownership in one major physical security or safety pillar, such as business continuity and disaster recovery, event security, travel risk management, monitoring operations, crisis management, guard force operations, or governance.

 - By the end of your first year, deliver multiple international projects with clear plans, sound judgment, and effective coordination across regions, vendors, and cross-functional partners.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Demonstrated ability to own physical security or safety programs across multiple sites or regions, including security technology, access control, incident response, or vendor operations.

 - Effective project management skills, with the ability to move multiple international projects from ambiguity to clear plans, decisions, and delivery.

 - Clear, thoughtful communication with internal partners, vendors, building management, and local stakeholders—especially when translating security requirements into practical action.

 - A service-oriented approach and eagerness to help create secure, welcoming workplace experiences; you bring curiosity, ownership, and sound judgment to how you work with others.

 - Novice AI proficiency and a willingness to use AI as a practical collaborator for communication, accuracy checks, documentation, and reducing repetitive work.

jobs.title: Change Management Specialist - Accounting and Corporate Services Transformation (m/f)
jobs.description:
Change Management Specialist - Accounting and Corporate Services Transformation

BDO Luxembourg is looking for a Change Management Specialist to support the transformation of its Accounting, Corporate, Fund and Payroll practices.

Who are we?

BDO is present in over 169 countries and we offer an extensive range of services in the areas of Audit, Tax, Advisory, Accounting, Business Services and Outsourcing. At BDO Luxembourg, our mission is to provide our clients with the expertise of our global network tailored to the unique needs of the Luxembourgish market, delivering personalized services and building valued relationships. With over 700 employees representing more than 40 nationalities, we embrace diversity and encourage skills and people development among our employees. Our core values, honesty, integrity, quality, respect and responsibility, define our culture. Hence, our People can expect to grow in a stimulating work environment that supports professional development and fosters inclusivity.

What will you do?

As Change Management Specialist, you will:
• Support the transformation core team in organising, monitoring and steering the overall transformation agenda.
• Contribute to the definition and implementation of change management plans across departments.
• Assess the impact of transformation initiatives on teams, roles, responsibilities, processes, behaviours and client service delivery.
• Work closely with sponsors, department representatives, managers and operational teams to ensure that change is understood, accepted and adopted.
• Identify adoption risks, resistance points, communication needs, training needs and operational readiness issues.
• Prepare stakeholder communications, internal updates, user engagement material and change adoption reporting.
• Support the preparation of change impact assessments, stakeholder maps, readiness assessments and adoption dashboards.
• Coordinate with the central IT Business Application team, project teams and other internal stakeholders to align implementation plans with business change needs.
• Promote a pragmatic and user-oriented approach to transformation, focused on operational adoption and sustainable change.

This position is for you if:

• You have 4 to 6 years of experience in change management, business transformation, organisational change, consulting, operational excellence or a similar field.
• You have contributed to transformation programmes involving several stakeholders, business teams or departments.
• Experience with accounting, corporate services, fund administration or professional services environments.
• You can translate strategic objectives into practical change actions.
• You are able to assess how change impacts people, processes, roles, responsibilities and ways of working.
• You are comfortable facilitating discussions, structuring feedback and turning complex situations into clear action plans.
• You have strong communication skills and can adapt your message to partners, managers and operational teams.
• You are structured, autonomous and pragmatic, with the ability to monitor progress without taking ownership of each individual project.
• You have a good understanding of digital transformation, business applications and the role technology can play in improving processes, collaboration and service delivery.
• You are familiar with the potential of AI in a business environment and have already used, tested or contributed to practical AI-related use cases.
• You are fluent in English and French.
…then this offer is probably made for you!

It would be an advantage if you also have:

• Exposure to software implementation or digital transformation programmes.
• Knowledge of change management methodologies such as Prosci, ADKAR, Kotter or similar approaches.
• Experience preparing change plans, communication plans, adoption material, training support or stakeholder engagement plans.
• Good command of Microsoft 365 tools, including PowerPoint, Excel, Teams and SharePoint. Experience with project or collaboration tools would be an asset.

What we offer

• A key role in a strategic transformation programme within one of BDO Luxembourg's core business practices.
• The opportunity to work closely with senior stakeholders, business teams and technology specialists.
• A varied role combining change management, stakeholder engagement, communication and transformation monitoring.
• A collaborative, multicultural and entrepreneurial working environment.
• The opportunity to contribute to the future operating model of our Accounting, Corporate, Fund and Payroll practices.
• Ongoing learning and development opportunities in line with your strengths and career aspirations.

What´s in it for you:

• Competitive remuneration package including
- a 13th month (representing a mobility budget offering a car leasing opportunity),
- a discretionary performance bonus
• Pension plan
• Lunch vouchers
• Extra days of annual leave
• Flexible working hours and homeworking options
• Parking spots available for a fee within our building
• Possibility to charge electric vehicles in our parking
• On-site employee restaurant with preferential prices
• Free access to our fitness room
• Sports sessions for small additional charge
• Internal sports groups (e.g. running, cycling and football)
• Career development opportunities through a wide range of trainings (e.g. technical and soft skills, language courses)

Our main office is ideally located in the modern and rapidly expanding Cloche d'Or area. This dynamic area offers easy access to public transport, stores and park-and-ride facilities.

Are you willing to grow your career in a multicultural, pleasant and dynamic environment? Then, take your chance!

In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description.

Fixed term contract | Belval | 18 Months
Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organization (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. • Contributing to system-level integration and ground-based demonstration activities validating the communication architecture.

jobs.title: Securities Lending Product Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Securities Lending Product Manager (f/m/d)

Location: Luxembourg, LU
Company: Deutsche Börse Group

Your area of work

As a Senior Securities Lending Product Manager, you will play a leading role in shaping, developing, and commercializing Clearstream's securities lending and borrowing proposition within the broader Collateral, Lending & Liquidity Solutions (CLLS) franchise. The role combines strategic product leadership with practical product ownership across securities lending and borrowing, aligned with collateral management and liquidity, settlement efficiency, regulation, risk, digital transformation, and commercial growth.

You will drive the evolution of securities lending solutions for various clients' segments, ensuring the proposition remains competitive, scalable, risk-aware, operationally robust, and aligned with client demand, market structure, regulatory expectations, and digital capabilities. You will work closely with Trading, Sales and Relationship Management, Client Service, Collateral Management and Liquidity Products, Operations, Technology, Legal, Risk, Compliance, Tax, Finance, and Pricing to translate market opportunities into deliverable product outcomes and resilient day-to-day operating models.

Your responsibilities

• Define, support and execute the strategic roadmap for securities lending and borrowing solutions, aligning product development with client needs, market trends, regulatory change, operational resilience, and the wider CLLS growth strategy.
• Identify opportunities across securities lending, funding and financing, balance-sheet optimization, and settlement efficiency, translating overlapping needs into scalable product capabilities and commercial solutions.
• Lead end-to-end product initiatives from concept and business case through design, governance, implementation, launch, operational readiness, post-launch performance review, and continuous enhancement.
• Develop clear product positioning, value propositions, pricing approaches, commercial proposals, and go-to-market materials that support client adoption and differentiate Clearstream in the securities finance market.
• Act as a senior subject matter expert on securities lending market structure, lender and borrower dynamics, collateral flows, settlement efficiency, and regulatory developments including SFTR, CSDR, T+1, and evolving capital and liquidity requirements.
• Translate regulatory and market changes, into practical product, operational, legal, and control requirements. Coordinate the alignment across Product, Legal, Operations, Risk, Compliance, and client-facing teams.
• Drive digital transformation across the securities lending proposition, including data-led decision-making, automation, workflow optimization, digital client channels, analytics, AI-enabled use cases, APIs, KPIs, and platform scalability.
• Use market data, client feedback, trading insights, operational metrics, incident trends, and performance analytics to identify opportunities for revenue growth, risk reduction, operational efficiency, and improved client experience.
• Maintain strong awareness of risk, credit, collateral eligibility, control frameworks, and operational dependencies to ensure the robustness of the securities lending proposition
• Represent Clearstream at industry conferences, client events, market forums, trade associations, and working groups, contributing to thought leadership and strengthening the firm's market presence.
• Prepare and coordinate cross-functional stakeholders across Sales and Relationship management, Trading, Client Service, Operations, Technology, Legal, Risk, Compliance, Tax, Finance, and Pricing to ensure successful product delivery, adoption, and operational sustainability.
• Mentor colleagues and contribute to a collaborative, commercially focused, risk-aware, and innovation-oriented product culture.

Your profile

• University degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Financial Markets, or a related discipline; an MBA or relevant professional qualification is an advantage.
• 7+ years of experience in securities lending, securities finance, collateral management, market infrastructure, product management, or related capital markets activities.
• Good understanding of securities lending and borrowing, funding and financing market dynamics
• High awareness of the links between securities lending, collateral management, liquidity, funding, capital efficiency, risk, credit, control frameworks, and regulatory constraints in a financial market infrastructure environment.
• Proven track record of executing product strategy, building business cases, managing roadmaps, defining pricing approaches, and delivering complex cross-functional initiatives in regulated financial services.
• Ability to translate market and regulatory change into clear product impacts, operational requirements, legal documentation needs, control considerations, and implementation priorities.
• Commercial mindset with the ability to convert market intelligence, client feedback, trading insights, operational metrics, and industry developments into practical product enhancements and revenue opportunities.
• Strong digital and data orientation, with practical understanding of analytics, automation, workflow tools, dashboards, AI-enabled use cases, APIs, platform transformation, KPIs, and Agile delivery concepts.
• Experience engaging in industry forums, client events, working groups, conferences, or market associations,
• Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders, build consensus across matrix teams, and drive clarity in complex, technical, or ambiguous situations.
• Strong analytical, written, and verbal communication skills,
• Fluency in English is essential; additional European languages are considered an advantage.

jobs.title: Market Head for Central and Northern Europe (m/f)
jobs.description:
Market Head for Central and Northern Europe

Permanent contract

At HSBC, we're a trusted international organisation with a global customer base of around 39 million customers worldwide through a network that covers 62 countries and territories. In Europe, our ambition is to become the leading international wholesale bank and we need talent like you to help us meet our ambition. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top or in an exciting new direction—we offer opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

The HSBC Group in Luxembourg is a significant employer and operates several businesses including asset management, securities services, private banking and corporate banking.

By joining us, you'll help evolve and grow our private banking business.

What you will do:

As Market Head for Central and Northern Europe, you'll directly manage the Netherlands Desk based in Luxembourg and build profitable long-term client relationships. The role focuses on generating Net New Money (NNM), growing Assets Under Management (AUM) and increasing gross revenue through high-quality new client acquisition and deeper client solutions. You'll partner across Global Private Banking (GPB) and Commercial Banking (CMB) to bring the right products and services to clients and prospects. Success means delivering agreed financial targets through a strong pipeline, effective referrals across the Group and consistently high standards of client service. You'll also shape a strong risk and control environment with clear expectations on KYC, sales quality and compliance.

In this role, you will (but not limited to):

• Lead and manage the Netherland Market composed of Senior Relationship Managers (hunters), as well based out of PBLU.
• Drive business development efforts through the focus on new client acquisition of UHNW and Family Office segments in the Netherlands and other key International markets related to your business.
• Stir share of wallet increase discipline with the existing UHNW client base through systematic client planning, sales management, client connectivity and other means.
• Ensure collaboration with other markets and locations within HSBC Private Banking, as well as enhance connectivity with HSBC Commercial and Global Banking business lines in the Netherlands and other key International markets.
• Promote brand visibility of HSBC Private Banking in the Netherlands and other key International markets through various initiatives, including proactive marketing, communication, collaboration with business introducers.
• Actively promote, manage, train, develop and assess all members of the team within assigned area of responsibility.

You should apply if you have:

• Min. 10 years of relevant experience in Private Banking within UHNW Netherlands and other key International client segments.
• Strong hunter mindset, proven track record of growing the business and driving acquisition of new clients.
• Demonstrated track record of leading a team of Relationship Managers.
• Decision maker, capable of providing judgment and clear direction within the established framework.
• Fluency in English and Dutch. French and/or German would be an asset.

Even if you feel you do not meet 100% of our qualifications, we encourage you to apply, if you believe this role is right for you.

What you'll get in return:

The pay range for this role is €200,000 – €350,000.

HSBC operates multiple variable pay plans, to reflect the diverse nature of the businesses, roles and markets in which we operate. Variable pay is designed to reward colleagues for their individual performance and contribution, as well as the performance of their relevant Business / Infrastructure, and the overall Group.

We offer a comprehensive and competitive package of benefits usually covering health support, life assurance, pension, and family friendly leaves, as well as many other benefits to support your wellbeing.

HSBC has been certified “Top Employer 2026” in Europe. This recognition from the Top Employers Institute rewards our HR practices and recognises HSBC as an HR Leader in France, Germany, Italy, Ireland, Luxembourg, The Netherlands, Poland and Spain.

If you're looking for a career where you will be respected as an individual and valued for the contributions you make, please visit our career page, and discover how diversity drives our success.

Being open to different points of view is important for our business and the communities we serve. At HSBC, we're dedicated to creating diverse and inclusive workplaces. We are committed to removing barriers and ensuring careers at HSBC are inclusive and accessible for everyone to be at their best. If you have a need that requires accommodations or changes during the recruitment process, please let us know.

Please note that every selected candidate will have to provide us with a valid criminal record check in due time.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website. For any GDPR request, please send it to: lux.data.privacy@hsbc.com

ABOUT THE ROLE:

We’re looking for a Strategic Finance Business Partner to support our AI team and other business functions. Our Strategic Finance Business Partnership team serves as a trusted advisor to the company, driving our financial planning, forecasting, and review processes, and guiding critical decisions through insightful analyses and strategic thought partnership.

This is a high-impact role on a lean team: you’ll partner deeply across Engineering and Product to strengthen executive-level visibility into financial performance, improve forecast accuracy, and evaluate strategic investments across our product.

This role is based San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

 - Deliver thoughtful analyses to support strategic decisions with strong judgment, speed, and attention to detail.

 - Support the monthly close and reporting process with Accounting, vendor and PO tracking, budget-versus-actuals cost analyses, and flux reviews

 - Partner with the AI team, Product, Data Science, Engineering, and other cross-functional teams to deliver accurate forecasts and budgets.

 - Strengthen AI cost data and reporting infrastructure by identifying data gaps, improving recurring workflows, and using AI and automation to make reporting more durable, scalable, and timely.

jobs.title: Global Head of Land Revenue
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As Global Head of Land Revenue, you’ll be the global owner for technical new-business strategy, pipeline, and conversion—a customer-facing, technical revenue leadership role, not a RevOps or sales operations role. You’ll own Notion’s Land number (net-new and upgrade iARR across regions), work closely with EPD and Product, and step into high-stakes technical conversations with customers and partners as Notion shifts from product-led to sales-led selling in an AI-native world.

This role is the global owner for new business standards, pipeline programs, and operating cadence. You’ll set the way for landing new business revenue globally, partner with Regional GMs who own regional P&L outcomes, and ensure consistent execution through scalable programs, playbooks, enablement, and governance.

You’ll partner closely with Marketing, RevOps, Enablement, EPD, Partnerships, Sales leadership, and regional teams to improve pipeline quality, win rates, conversion, and time-to-productivity. You’ll also design operating standards that balance regional accountability with global program consistency.

You’ll be measured on qualified pipeline creation, coverage, conversion, program ROI, velocity, handoff quality, and BDR/SC ramp outcomes—requiring you to operate with strong systems thinking, executive presence, and cross-functional influence.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Build and lead the global net-new business motion: define strategy, program portfolio, operating cadence, governance, and performance standards across regions

 - Own the global net new business strategy for Land, including ICP and segmentation guardrails, plays, coverage model assumptions, annual and quarterly planning, sequencing, and investment trade-offs

 - Establish global definitions and standards for stages, qualification, handoffs, pipeline math assumptions, and reporting integrity

 - Build and run global pipeline generation programs in partnership with Marketing and regional leaders, including campaign-to-pipeline motions, partner-sourced pipeline programs, ABM or named-account plays, and field event program standards

 - Define the measurement framework for new business programs, connecting inputs to outputs and outcomes across cost, pipeline, iARR, velocity, and win-rate lift

 - Own the Land-side technical selling motion and set the technical bar for sales: SC plays, discovery and demo standards, scalable demo environments, certification paths, and ramp mechanisms

 - Run the global new business operating cadence, including weekly program reviews, monthly pipeline health inspection, quarterly planning, escalation paths, and decision-rights models

 - Partner with Regional GMs, Marketing, RevOps, Enablement, EPD, Product, and Partnerships to align new business programs, systems, content, enablement, feedback loops, and change management


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - Deeply technical SaaS background with meaningful customer-facing experience—solutions engineering, solutions consulting, field or customer engineering, or technical sales—plus ownership of a revenue, quota, pipeline, or conversion outcome

 - Deep understanding of pipeline mechanics and how to influence conversion levers end-to-end, including qualified pipeline creation, coverage ratios, lead response, handoff quality, stage progression, win-rate lift, and velocity

 - Strong program-building instincts: you can design scalable plays, instrument them with data, and run an inspection cadence that drives behavior change

 - Experience building operating systems for global teams, including cadences, dashboards, governance, playbooks, definitions, and change-management mechanisms

 - Executive presence and cross-functional leadership: able to align and influence Regional GMs, Marketing, RevOps, Enablement, EPD, Partnerships, and regional teams without relying on direct reporting lines for every dependency

 - Ability to balance regional autonomy with global craft excellence: you set the bar, create standards, and drive consistency while enabling local execution

 - Strong enablement and role-design instincts, with the ability to define expectations, onboarding paths, certification standards, and time-to-productivity mechanisms for BDR and SC motions

 - Builder orientation and comfort in ambiguity: you create the playbook while the org is executing, and you iterate quickly based on market, customer, and performance signals

 - Hands-on with AI tools, and able to credibly explain how AI and agents change workflows for technical teams


NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience with solution-led selling motions and technical or product-adjacent go-to-market

 - Track record building global programs that still allow regional adaptation

 - Experience partnering deeply with Marketing, Partnerships, RevOps, and Enablement to create measurable net new business impact

 - Experience designing partner-sourced pipeline programs, ABM or named-account motions, or field event program standards at scale

We hire talented and passionate people from a variety of backgrounds because we want our global employee base to represent the wide diversity of our customers. If you're excited about a role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every bullet point listed in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. If you're a builder at heart, share our company values, and enthusiastic about making software toolmaking ubiquitous, we want to hear from you.

jobs.description:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the worldâs largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary:

As an Enterprise Sales Development Representative (SDR), you will drive business growth by identifying opportunities with target clients. Youâll play a pivotal role in identifying potential customers, generating new business opportunities, and providing support to both customers and our team. You will set the stage for successful sales interactions through cold outreach efforts and nurturing relationships to secure qualified meetings for our sales team. If youâre a self-motivated individual with a passion for sales, we encourage you to join our team!

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Sales: Understand current and future demand. Enable, educate, and directly support the sales force to best position this practice with Toptal clients and win new business. Lead client conversations, presenting Toptalâs perspective on innovation and experience topics, and ask exploratory questions to better understand client needs.
  • Begin the Relationship: Through lead-generation activities and cold-calling, you will prospect, educate, qualify, and develop sales-ready leads and opportunities from unsigned clients and accounts. You will enthusiastically explain Toptalâs vision, pinpoint opportunities, and generate interest.
  • Client and Industry Knowledge: Clients are at the heart of everything we do. As the first point of contact for future Enterprise clients, you will be building rapport through strategic outreach and a well-rounded client and industry knowledge. Researching clients and staying informed on industry trends will be key to your success.
  • Collaborate with Team Members: You will collaborate with your team and Sales Executives to pursue opportunities, recommend appropriate follow-up actions, and schedule qualified meetings. Communicating via Zoom and Slack is critical to maintaining a high level of collaboration and clear communication within the team.
  • Growth and Development: Our team has an aversion to complacency. We are always looking to improve both individually and as a team. Being open to and implementing feedback will be critical success factors in this role and at Toptal. As you become more comfortable in the role, you will help evolve our demand generation strategy and tactics.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Onboard and integrate into Toptal.
  • Learn Toptalâs model, our value proposition, and our story.
  • Work with cross-functional teams to understand how you can utilize our incredible global team to build client relationships and drive success.
  • Learn the breadth of Toptalâs impact on the worldâs largest companies.
  • Grasp the importance of the SDR function to the success of Toptal.
  • Understand our sales method and our selling process to set you up for success.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Complete our personalized sales training program with mock calls, cold calls, and role-play scenarios.
  • Learn how to use Salesforce.com (our CRM) and other SaaS outreach tools (ZoomInfo, SalesLoft, LinkedIn Sales Navigator).
  • Integrate into your pod, partner with Enterprise Sales Executives and Client Partners, and begin targeting strategic accounts.
  • Learn the process for outreach, including calling, emailing, and LinkedIn messaging. Implement an outreach process and hit 1-month objectives.
  • Learn how to analyze industry drivers, business problems, and target buyers.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Become fully ramped on the SDR team, attaining your metrics, which include calls, emails, and other sales activities.
  • Exercising discretion and independent judgment, uncover new opportunities within existing accounts and target accounts that result in revenue-generating engagements for Toptal.
  • Hit call/email quotas and fully ramped objectives.
  • Become proficient in using our SaaS tools.
  • Learn how to maintain excellent data integrity in Salesforce.com.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Continuously hit fully ramped quotas and objectives.
  • Assist with training and onboarding new SDRs.
  • Build new and existing client relationships, expand Toptalâs partnerships, and continue to execute account plans.
  • Suggest, implement, and experiment with new lead and demand generation activities.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Have built a portfolio of net new accounts from the strategic account list.
  • Become a mentor to new members of the team, helping them learn about Toptal, our model, and how proper sales development practices can improve relationships and increase revenue.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • Bachelorâs degree is required.
  • 1-3 years of experience as an Enterprise SDR.
  • Knowledgeable. Broad understanding of business challenges encountered by Enterprise clients.
  • Critical thinking. Critically think through the challenges clients face to create new opportunities from unsigned clients and accounts.
  • Perseverance. Be relentless and push towards your goal.
  • Passion. Enthusiasm and ambition to succeed in this role, as it can be difficult if you hate rejection.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Curiosity. A desire to understand people, their problems, their companies, and their industries.
  • Conscientiousness. Weâre not doing a simple SaaS sale, so discussions may get technical. Understanding sophisticated issues and explaining them to clients is important.
  • Motivated. Be highly motivated and continuously strive for personal and professional improvement.
  • Resourceful. Think about target accounts as your own business - we want self-starters who are passionate about hunting for new accounts, and who thrive with the freedom and accountability of leading their portion of the business.
  • Proactive. Understand our mission and do the work required to drive us to that goal, by following a process and being creative.
  • Communication. You must exhibit outstanding written and verbal communication skills. Communication is the lifeblood of both internal and external relationships. Demonstrate excellent communication in all forms, across a wide variety of personality types, roles, and geographies.
  • Team. Nothing we do is done in isolation. Success depends on your ability to work as a team both within Toptal and within your client accounts.
  • Ownership. Exhibit ownership of accounts, successes, and failures.
  • Problem Solver. Life throws in minor challenges beyond the primary problems this role is meant to solve. You must have the ability to take those in stride and persist despite setbacks.
  • Prioritization. The nature of this role requires that you understand the priorities and timelines associated with each of your accounts and execute appropriately with those in mind.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.
